text: The ESA sample(s) shall be clearly and indelibly marked with the manufacturer's trade name or mark and the type designation.
quote: The sample(s) shall be clearly and indelibly marked with the manufacturer's trade name or mark and the type designation.
test_case: Inspect the submitted lamp samples for a clear, indelible trade name/mark and type designation.

text: ESA which are brought to the market as replacement parts do not need a type approval only if they are obviously marked as a replacement part by an identification number and if they are identical and from the same manufacturer as the corresponding original equipment.
quote: ESA which are brought to the market as replacement parts do not need a type approval if they are obviously marked as a replacement part
condition: Lamp is supplied as a replacement part without its own type approval
test_case: Check replacement lamp carries a replacement-part identification number and is identical to and from the same manufacturer as the OE part.

text: For components sold as aftermarket equipment not related to immunity related functions and without type approval, a declaration shall be issued by the manufacturer that the ESA fulfils the requirements of this Regulation and in particular the limits defined in paragraphs 6.5., 6.6., 6.7., 6.8. and 6.9.
quote: In this case a declaration shall be issued by the manufacturer that the ESA fulfils the requirements of this Regulation
condition: Lamp is sold as aftermarket equipment without type approval
test_case: Verify existence of the manufacturer's declaration of compliance with paragraphs 6.5 to 6.9 limits.

text: In case the ESA is (part of) a light source, the applicant shall specify the approval number according to Regulation No. 37, Regulation No. 99 or Regulation No. 128 granted to this ESA, or provide a test report by a Technical Service stating that this ESA is not mechanically interchangeable with any light source according to Regulation No. 37, Regulation No. 99 or Regulation No. 128.
quote: In case of an ESA is (part of) a light source, the applicant shall: (a) Specify the approval number according to Regulation No. 37
condition: The LED module/ESA is (part of) a light source
test_case: Check documentation provides R37/R99/R128 approval number or Technical Service report of non-interchangeability.

text: In case the ESA is (part of) a light source and the documentation as specified in paragraph 3.2.10. is missing, approval of this ESA according to Regulation No. 10 shall not be granted.
quote: In case of an ESA is (part of) a light source and if the documentation as specified in paragraph 3.2.10. above is missing
condition: The LED module/ESA is (part of) a light source
test_case: Confirm paragraph 3.2.10 documentation is present before approval.

text: The representative ESA system(s) shall fulfil the requirements of paragraph 6. and, if applicable, paragraph 7. of this Regulation for type approval to be granted.
quote: If the representative ESA system(s) fulfil(s) the requirements of paragraph 6. and, if applicable, paragraph 7. of this Regulation, type approval shall be granted.
test_case: Review test report showing the lamp ESA meets all paragraph 6 requirements.

text: An approval mark described in paragraph 5.3. shall be affixed to every ESA conforming to a type approved under this Regulation, except that no marking is required for electrical/electronic systems built into vehicles which are approved as units.
quote: An approval mark described in paragraph 5.3. below shall be affixed to every ESA conforming to a type approved under this Regulation.
test_case: Inspect each lamp for the R10 approval mark per paragraph 5.3.

text: The international approval mark shall be affixed in a conspicuous and easily accessible place specified on the approval communication form.
quote: An international approval mark shall be affixed, in a conspicuous and easily accessible place specified on the approval communication form
test_case: Verify mark location matches the place specified on the communication form.

text: The approval mark shall comprise a circle containing the letter "E", followed by the distinguishing number of the country granting the approval.
quote: A circle containing the letter "E", followed by the distinguishing number of the country granting the approval.
test_case: Inspect mark for circle with E and the approving country's number.

text: The approval mark shall comprise the number of this Regulation, followed by the letter "R", a dash and the approval number to the right of the circle specified in paragraph 5.3.1.
quote: The number of this Regulation, followed by the letter "R", a dash and the approval number to the right of the circle
test_case: Inspect mark for "10R-" followed by the approval number to the right of the circle.

text: The ESA(s) shall be designed, constructed and fitted in such a way as to enable the vehicle, in normal conditions of use, to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.
quote: A vehicle and its electrical/electronic system(s) or ESA(s) shall be designed, constructed and fitted in such a way as to enable the vehicle
test_case: Review EMC design and test results showing compliance in normal conditions of use.

text: The ESA(s) shall be tested for radiated and conducted emissions, for immunity to radiated and conducted disturbances.
quote: ESA(s) shall be tested for radiated and conducted emissions, for immunity to radiated and conducted disturbances.
test_case: Confirm test report covers radiated and conducted emissions and radiated and conducted immunity of the lamp.

text: Before testing, a test plan shall be prepared in conjunction with the manufacturer, which contains at least mode of operation, stimulated function(s), monitored function(s), pass/fail criterion(criteria) and intended emissions.
quote: the Technical Service shall prepare a test plan in conjunction with the manufacturer, which contains at least mode of operation, stimulated function(s)
test_case: Verify the test plan lists operating modes, stimulated/monitored functions, pass/fail criteria and intended emissions.

text: The electromagnetic radiation generated by the ESA representative of its type shall be measured by the method described in Annex 7.
quote: The electromagnetic radiation generated by the ESA representative of its type shall be measured by the method described in Annex 7.
condition: Lamp contains electronic content (LED driver/control electronics) qualifying it as an ESA
test_case: Measure broadband radiated emissions of the lamp per Annex 7 (ALSE method) and confirm a test report exists.

text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the ESA broadband limits shall be 62 to 52 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz, and 52 to 63 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 6.
quote: the limits shall be 62 to 52 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically
condition: Lamp contains electronic content qualifying it as an ESA
test_case: Compare Annex 7 broadband measurement over 30-400 MHz against the Appendix 6 limit line; pass if all values are below it.

text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the ESA broadband limit in the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band shall remain constant at 63 dB microvolts/m.
quote: In the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band the limit remains constant at 63 dB microvolts/m.
condition: Lamp contains electronic content qualifying it as an ESA
test_case: Check Annex 7 broadband measurement in 400-1,000 MHz is below 63 dBµV/m.

text: On the ESA representative of its type, the measured broadband values, expressed in dB microvolts/m, shall be below the type approval limits.
quote: On the ESA representative of its type, the measured values, expressed in dB microvolts/m, shall be below the type approval limits.
condition: Lamp contains electronic content qualifying it as an ESA
test_case: Verify all broadband measured values in the test report are below the limit curve.

text: The electromagnetic radiation generated by the ESA representative of its type shall be measured by the method described in Annex 8.
quote: The electromagnetic radiation generated by the ESA representative of its type shall be measured by the method described in Annex 8.
condition: Lamp contains an electronic oscillator with operating frequency greater than 9 kHz (otherwise deemed to comply per 6.10.1)
test_case: Measure narrowband radiated emissions of the lamp per Annex 8 and confirm a test report exists.

text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8, the ESA narrowband limits shall be 52 to 42 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz, and 42 to 53 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 7.
quote: the limits shall be 52 to 42 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically
condition: Lamp contains an electronic oscillator with operating frequency greater than 9 kHz
test_case: Compare Annex 8 narrowband measurement over 30-400 MHz with the Appendix 7 limit line; pass if all values are below it.

text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8, the ESA narrowband limit in the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band shall remain constant at 53 dB microvolts/m.
quote: In the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band the limit remains constant at 53 dB microvolts/m.
condition: Lamp contains an electronic oscillator with operating frequency greater than 9 kHz
test_case: Check Annex 8 narrowband measurement in 400-1,000 MHz is below 53 dBµV/m.

text: On the ESA representative of its type, the measured narrowband value, expressed in dB microvolts/m, shall be below the type approval limits.
quote: On the ESA representative of its type, the measured value, expressed in dB microvolts/m shall be below the type approval limits.
condition: Lamp contains an electronic oscillator with operating frequency greater than 9 kHz
test_case: Verify all narrowband measured values in the test report are below the limit curve.

text: The emission of transient conducted disturbances of the ESA representative of its type on 12/24 V supply lines shall be tested by the method(s) according to ISO 7637-2 as described in Annex 10 for the levels given in Table 1.
quote: The emission of ESA representative of its type shall be tested by the method(s) according to ISO 7637-2 as described in Annex 10
condition: Lamp is switched, contains switches or includes an inductive load (otherwise deemed to comply per 6.10.5)
test_case: Perform ISO 7637-2 transient emission test per Annex 10 and record pulse amplitudes.

text: The maximum allowed positive pulse amplitude of transient conducted emissions generated by the ESA shall be +75 V for vehicles with 12 V systems and +150 V for vehicles with 24 V systems, as given in Table 1.
quote: Maximum allowed pulse amplitude for Polarity of pulse amplitude Vehicles with 12 V systems Vehicles with 24 V systems Positive +75 V +150 V
condition: Lamp is switched, contains switches or includes an inductive load
test_case: Check measured positive transient amplitudes do not exceed +75 V (12 V) / +150 V (24 V).

text: The maximum allowed negative pulse amplitude of transient conducted emissions generated by the ESA shall be -100 V for vehicles with 12 V systems and -450 V for vehicles with 24 V systems, as given in Table 1.
quote: Negative -100 V -450 V
condition: Lamp is switched, contains switches or includes an inductive load
test_case: Check measured negative transient amplitudes do not exceed -100 V (12 V) / -450 V (24 V).

text: The immunity to electromagnetic radiation of the ESA representative of its type shall be tested by the method(s) chosen from those described in Annex 9.
quote: The immunity to electromagnetic radiation of the ESA representative of its type shall be tested by the method(s) chosen from those described in Annex 9.
condition: Lamp has immunity related functions (e.g. stop lamp) and electronic content qualifying it as an ESA
test_case: Perform radiated immunity test per a chosen Annex 9 method and confirm a test report exists.

text: When tested with the stripline method as described in Annex 9, the ESA shall be tested at 60 V/m in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 400 MHz frequency band (Table 2a) and at a minimum of 50 V/m over the whole 20 to 400 MHz frequency band (Table 2b).
quote: Test severity in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band are given in Table 2a.
condition: Stripline method chosen; lamp has immunity related functions
test_case: Verify stripline test levels of 60 V/m (>90 % of band) and minimum 50 V/m over 20-400 MHz were applied.

text: When tested with the TEM cell method as described in Annex 9, the ESA shall be tested at 75 V/m in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 200 MHz frequency band (Table 2a) and at a minimum of 62,5 V/m over the whole 20 to 200 MHz frequency band (Table 2b).
quote: Test severity for the minimum test Level over the whole 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band given in Table 2b.
condition: TEM cell method chosen; lamp has immunity related functions
test_case: Verify TEM cell test levels of 75 V/m (>90 % of band) and minimum 62,5 V/m over 20-200 MHz were applied.

text: When tested with the BCI method as described in Annex 9, the ESA shall be tested at 60 mA in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 400 MHz frequency band (Table 2a) and at a minimum of 50 mA over the whole 20 to 400 MHz frequency band (Table 2b).
quote: Test severity in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band are given in Table 2a.
condition: BCI method chosen; lamp has immunity related functions
test_case: Verify BCI test levels of 60 mA (>90 % of band) and minimum 50 mA over 20-400 MHz were applied.

text: When tested with the ALSE method as described in Annex 9, the ESA shall be tested at 30 V/m in over 90 per cent of the 80 to 2,000 MHz band and 10 V/m in over 90 per cent of the 2,000 to 6,000 MHz band (Table 2a), and at a minimum of 25 V/m over the whole 80 to 2,000 MHz band and 8 V/m over the whole 2,000 to 6,000 MHz band (Table 2b).
quote: Test severity for the minimum test Level over the whole 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band given in Table 2b.
condition: ALSE method chosen; lamp has immunity related functions
test_case: Verify ALSE test levels of 30/10 V/m (>90 % of band) and minimum 25/8 V/m were applied over 80-6,000 MHz.

text: When tested with the reverberation chamber method as described in Annex 9, the ESA shall be tested at 21 V/m in over 90 per cent of the LUF to 2,000 MHz band and 7 V/m in over 90 per cent of the 2,000 to 6,000 MHz band (Table 2a), and at a minimum of 18 V/m over the whole LUF to 2,000 MHz band and 6 V/m over the whole 2,000 to 6,000 MHz band (Table 2b).
quote: Test severity in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band are given in Table 2a.
condition: Reverberation chamber method chosen; lamp has immunity related functions
test_case: Verify reverberation chamber test levels of 21/7 V/m (>90 % of band) and minimum 18/6 V/m were applied.

text: While tests are performed in accordance with Annex 9, the ESA representative of its type shall be considered as complying with immunity requirements if there is no degradation of performance of "immunity related functions".
quote: there shall be no degradation of performance of "immunity related functions".
condition: Lamp has immunity related functions and electronic content
test_case: Monitor stop/position/reversing lamp outputs during Annex 9 tests; pass if no degradation of immunity related functions.

text: The immunity of ESA representative of this type shall be tested by the method(s) according to ISO 16750-2 for starting profile and ISO 7637-2 for pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b, as described in Annex 10, with the test levels given in Tables 3a and 3b.
quote: The immunity of ESA representative of this type shall be tested by the method(s) according to ISO 16750-2 for starting profile and ISO 7637-2
condition: Lamp contains electronic content qualifying it as an ESA
test_case: Perform conducted transient immunity tests per Annex 10 and confirm a test report exists.

text: The starting profile shall be tested according to the functional status classification as defined in ISO 16750-1.
quote: Starting profile shall be tested according to the functional status classification as defined in ISO 16750-1.
condition: Lamp contains electronic content and may be installed in vehicles with ICE started by a 12V/24V starter motor
test_case: Check the test report classifies starting profile results per ISO 16750-1.

text: The Functional Performance Status Classification (FPSC) as in ISO 7637-1 shall be applied for pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b.
quote: Functional Performance Status Classification (FPSC) as in ISO 7637-1 shall be applied for pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b.
condition: Lamp contains electronic content qualifying it as an ESA
test_case: Check the test report classifies pulse results per ISO 7637-1 FPSC.

text: For the 12 V system starting profile (ISO 16750-2, test level II, 10 pulses), an ESA that shall be operational during engine start phases shall reach functional status class B if it performs immunity-related functions and class D if it does not, and any other ESA shall reach class C, as given in Table 3a; the starting profile applies only to ESAs that may be installed in vehicles with an internal combustion engine started by a 12 V / 24 V starter motor.
quote: Starting profile is only applicable to ESAs that could be installed in vehicles with internal combustion engines which are started with a 12V/24V starter motor.
condition: Lamp may be installed in ICE vehicles with 12 V starter motor
test_case: Apply 12 V starting profile level II, 10 pulses; verify the required functional status class is achieved.

text: For the 24 V system starting profile (ISO 16750-2, test level II, 10 pulses), an ESA that shall be operational during engine start phases shall reach functional status class B if it performs immunity-related functions and class D if it does not, and any other ESA shall reach class C, as given in Table 3a; the starting profile applies only to ESAs that may be installed in vehicles with an internal combustion engine started by a 12 V / 24 V starter motor.
quote: Starting profile is only applicable to ESAs that could be installed in vehicles with internal combustion engines which are started with a 12V/24V starter motor.
condition: Lamp may be installed in ICE vehicles with 24 V starter motor
test_case: Apply 24 V starting profile level II, 10 pulses; verify the required functional status class is achieved.

text: For pulse 1, the ESA shall meet immunity test level -75 V (12V system) or -450 V (24V system) for 500 pulses with FPSC III for functions related to immunity and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity as specified in Table 3b.
quote: 1 -75 V -450 V 500 pulses III III
condition: Lamp contains electronic content qualifying it as an ESA
test_case: Apply pulse 1 at specified level for 500 pulses; verify FPSC III achieved.

text: For pulse 2a, the ESA shall meet immunity test level +37 V (12V system) or +37 V (24V system) for 500 pulses with FPSC I for functions related to immunity and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity as specified in Table 3b.
quote: 2a +37 V +37 V 500 pulses I III
condition: Lamp contains electronic content qualifying it as an ESA
test_case: Apply pulse 2a at +37 V for 500 pulses; verify FPSC I for immunity related functions.

text: For pulse 2b, the ESA shall meet immunity test level +10 V (12V system) or +20 V (24V system) for 10 pulses with FPSC II for functions related to immunity and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity as specified in Table 3b.
quote: 2b +10 V +20 V 10 pulses II III
condition: Lamp contains electronic content qualifying it as an ESA
test_case: Apply pulse 2b at specified level for 10 pulses; verify FPSC II for immunity related functions.

text: For pulse 3a, the ESA shall meet immunity test level -112 V (12V system) or -150 V (24V system) for 1 h with FPSC I for functions related to immunity and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity as specified in Table 3b.
quote: 3a -112 V -150 V 1 h I III
condition: Lamp contains electronic content qualifying it as an ESA
test_case: Apply pulse 3a at specified level for 1 h; verify FPSC I for immunity related functions.

text: For pulse 3b, the ESA shall meet immunity test level +75 V (12V system) or +150 V (24V system) for 1 h with FPSC I for functions related to immunity and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity as specified in Table 3b.
quote: 3b +75 V +150 V 1 h I III
condition: Lamp contains electronic content qualifying it as an ESA
test_case: Apply pulse 3b at specified level for 1 h; verify FPSC I for immunity related functions.

text: Where the ESA does not include an electronic oscillator with an operating frequency greater than 9 kHz, it shall be deemed to comply with paragraph 6.3.2. or 6.6.2. and with Annexes 5 and 8.
quote: does not include an electronic oscillator with an operating frequency greater than 9 kHz, it shall be deemed to comply with paragraph 6.3.2. or 6.6.2.
condition: Lamp has no electronic oscillator with operating frequency greater than 9 kHz
test_case: Review schematic/BOM to confirm absence of oscillators >9 kHz; if confirmed, narrowband test is waived.

text: ESAs with no immunity related functions need not be tested for immunity to radiated disturbances and shall be deemed to comply with paragraph 6.8. and with Annex 9.
quote: ESAs with no immunity related functions need not be tested for immunity to radiated disturbances and shall be deemed to comply with paragraph 6.8.
condition: Lamp has no immunity related functions
test_case: Review function analysis; if no immunity related functions, radiated immunity test is waived.

text: ESAs that are not switched, contain no switches or do not include inductive load need not be tested for transient conducted emission and shall be deemed to comply with paragraph 6.7.
quote: ESAs that are not switched, contain no switches or do not include inductive load need not be tested for transient conducted emission
condition: Lamp is not switched, contains no switches or has no inductive load
test_case: Review circuit design; if no switching or inductive load, transient emission test is waived.

text: The electromagnetic radiation generated by the ESA representative of its type shall be measured by the method described in Annex 7.
quote: The electromagnetic radiation generated by the ESA representative of its type shall be measured by the method described in Annex 7.
condition: The lamp contains electronics (e.g. LED driver/control electronics) and is not exempted as a passive ESA
test_case: Perform the broadband radiated emission measurement on the lamp per Annex 7 and confirm the test report references that method.

text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the broadband limits for the ESA shall be 62 to 52 dBµV/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz, as shown in Appendix 6.
quote: the limits shall be 62 to 52 dBµV/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz
condition: The lamp contains electronics (e.g. LED driver/control electronics) and is not exempted as a passive ESA
test_case: Measure broadband emissions per Annex 7 from 30 to 75 MHz and verify all values are below the logarithmically decreasing 62 to 52 dBµV/m limit.

text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the broadband limits for the ESA shall be 52 to 63 dBµV/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz, as shown in Appendix 6.
quote: and 52 to 63 dBµV/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 6
condition: The lamp contains electronics (e.g. LED driver/control electronics) and is not exempted as a passive ESA
test_case: Measure broadband emissions per Annex 7 from 75 to 400 MHz and verify all values are below the logarithmically increasing 52 to 63 dBµV/m limit.

text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, in the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band the broadband limit for the ESA remains constant at 63 dBµV/m.
quote: In the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band the limit remains constant at 63 dBµV/m.
condition: The lamp contains electronics (e.g. LED driver/control electronics) and is not exempted as a passive ESA
test_case: Measure broadband emissions per Annex 7 from 400 to 1,000 MHz and verify all values are below 63 dBµV/m.

text: On the ESA representative of its type, the measured broadband values, expressed in dBµV/m, shall be below the type approval limits.
quote: On the ESA representative of its type, the measured values, expressed in dBµV/m, shall be below the type approval limits.
condition: The lamp contains electronics (e.g. LED driver/control electronics) and is not exempted as a passive ESA
test_case: Compare all measured broadband emission values from the Annex 7 test against the paragraph 7.10.2.1 limits; pass if every value is below the limit.

text: For the frequency range 30-75 MHz, the broadband radiated emissions of the electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) shall not exceed the reference limit E = 62 - 25.13 log (F/30) dBµV/m (F in MHz), measured with a 120 kHz bandwidth (see paragraphs 6.5.2.1. and 7.10.2.1.).
quote: Limit E (dBµV/m) at frequency F (MHz) for a 120 kHz bandwidth 30-75 MHz 75-400 MHz 400-1,000 MHz E = 62 - 25.13 log (F/30)
test_case: Measure ESA broadband radiated emissions per Annex 7 with 120 kHz bandwidth over 30-75 MHz and verify all values are below E = 62 - 25.13 log (F/30) dBµV/m.

text: For the frequency range 75-400 MHz, the broadband radiated emissions of the electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) shall not exceed the reference limit E = 52 + 15.13 log (F/75) dBµV/m (F in MHz), measured with a 120 kHz bandwidth (see paragraphs 6.5.2.1. and 7.10.2.1.).
test_case: Measure ESA broadband radiated emissions with 120 kHz bandwidth over 75-400 MHz and verify all values are below E = 52 + 15.13 log (F/75) dBµV/m.

text: For the frequency range 400-1,000 MHz, the broadband radiated emissions of the electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) shall not exceed the reference limit E = 63 dBµV/m, measured with a 120 kHz bandwidth (see paragraphs 6.5.2.1. and 7.10.2.1.).
test_case: Measure ESA broadband radiated emissions with 120 kHz bandwidth over 400-1,000 MHz and verify all values are below 63 dBµV/m.

text: For the frequency range 30-75 MHz, the narrowband radiated emissions of the electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) shall not exceed the reference limit E = 52 - 25.13 log (F/30) dBµV/m (F in MHz), measured with a 120 kHz bandwidth (see paragraph 6.6.2.1.).
quote: Limit E (dBµV/m) at frequency F (MHz) for a 120 kHz bandwidth 30-75 MHz 75-400 MHz 400-1,000 MHz E = 52 - 25.13 log (F/30)
condition: Applies if the lamp contains electronics (e.g. LED driver/ECU with oscillator) that can generate narrowband emissions.
test_case: Measure ESA narrowband radiated emissions per Annex 8 with 120 kHz bandwidth over 30-75 MHz and verify all values are below E = 52 - 25.13 log (F/30) dBµV/m.

text: For the frequency range 75-400 MHz, the narrowband radiated emissions of the electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) shall not exceed the reference limit E = 42 + 15.13 log (F/75) dBµV/m (F in MHz), measured with a 120 kHz bandwidth (see paragraph 6.6.2.1.).
condition: Applies if the lamp contains electronics (e.g. LED driver/ECU with oscillator) that can generate narrowband emissions.
test_case: Measure ESA narrowband radiated emissions with 120 kHz bandwidth over 75-400 MHz and verify all values are below E = 42 + 15.13 log (F/75) dBµV/m.

text: For the frequency range 400-1,000 MHz, the narrowband radiated emissions of the electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) shall not exceed the reference limit E = 53 dBµV/m, measured with a 120 kHz bandwidth (see paragraph 6.6.2.1.).
condition: Applies if the lamp contains electronics (e.g. LED driver/ECU with oscillator) that can generate narrowband emissions.
test_case: Measure ESA narrowband radiated emissions with 120 kHz bandwidth over 400-1,000 MHz and verify all values are below 53 dBµV/m.

text: For an ESA powered by LV, a 5 µH / 50 Ω artificial network (AN) as defined in Figure 1 shall be used.
quote: For an ESA powered by LV, a 5 µH / 50 Ω AN as defined in Figure 1 shall be used.
test_case: Check the ESA test set-up records show a 5 µH / 50 Ω AN per Figure 1 in the LV supply lines.

text: For an ESA powered by LV, the AN(s) shall be mounted directly on the ground plane.
quote: The AN(s) shall be mounted directly on the ground plane.
test_case: Inspect the test set-up to confirm the AN(s) are mounted directly on the ground plane.

text: For an ESA powered by LV, the grounding connection of the AN(s) shall be bonded to the ground plane.
quote: The grounding connection of the AN(s) shall be bonded to the ground plane.
test_case: Inspect the test set-up to confirm the AN grounding connection is bonded to the ground plane.

text: For an ESA powered by LV, the measurement ports of AN(s) shall be terminated with a 50 Ω load.
quote: Measurement ports of AN(s) shall be terminated with a 50 Ω load.
test_case: Inspect the test set-up to confirm each AN measurement port is terminated with a 50 Ω load.

text: The AN impedance ZPB (tolerance ± 20 %) in the measurement frequency range of 0,1 MHz to 100 MHz shall be as shown in Figure 2, measured between the terminals P and B with a 50 Ω load on the measurement port with terminals A and B short circuited.
quote: The AN impedance ZPB (tolerance ± 20 %) in the measurement frequency range of 0,1 MHz to 100 MHz is shown in Figure 2.
test_case: Review AN calibration data to confirm ZPB is within ±20 % of the Figure 2 curve over 0,1-100 MHz.

text: If the ESA carries an approval mark, the approval mark affixed to the ESA shall follow the layout of Model A (see paragraph 5.2.), with the dimension a of at least 6 mm.
quote: Model A (See paragraph 5.2. of this Regulation) a = 6 mm min The above approval mark affixed to a vehicle or ESA
condition: The lamp contains electronics that make it an ESA and it is type-approved and marked under UN R10.
test_case: Inspect the approval mark on the lamp and measure the characteristic dimension a; pass if the layout matches Model A and a ≥ 6 mm.

text: If not otherwise stated in Annex 7, the test measuring broadband electromagnetic emissions from the ESA shall be performed according to CISPR 25.
quote: This test is intended to measure broadband electromagnetic emissions from ESAs (e.g. ignition systems, electric motor, onboard battery charging unit, etc.). If not otherwise stated in this Annex the test shall be performed according CISPR 25.
condition: The lamp contains active electronics (LED driver/control) and is not exempted as passive from the broadband emission requirements.
test_case: Review the test report to confirm the broadband radiated emission test was carried out to CISPR 25.

text: During the radiated broadband emission tests, the ESA under test shall be in normal operation mode, preferably in maximum load.
quote: The ESA under test shall be in normal operation mode, preferably in maximum load.
condition: The lamp contains active electronics (LED driver/control) and is not exempted as passive from the broadband emission requirements.
test_case: Verify in the test report that all lamp functions (position, stop, reversing) were operated in normal mode at maximum load during measurement.

text: For an ESA other than one involved in "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid", the radiated broadband emission test shall be performed according to the ALSE method described in Clause 6.4 of CISPR 25.
quote: For ESA other than involved in "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid" the test shall be performed according to the ALSE method described in Clause 6.4 of CISPR 25.
condition: The lamp contains active electronics (LED driver/control) and is not exempted as passive from the broadband emission requirements.
test_case: Check the test set-up record shows the CISPR 25 Clause 6.4 ALSE arrangement (or permitted OATS alternative).

text: To ensure that there is no extraneous noise or signal of a magnitude sufficient to affect materially the measurement, ambient measurements shall be taken before or after the main test, and the extraneous noise or signal shall be at least 6 dB below the limits of interference given in paragraph 6.5.2.1. of this Regulation, except for intentional narrowband ambient transmissions.
quote: In this measurement, the extraneous noise or signal shall be at least 6 dB below the limits of interference given in paragraph 6.5.2.1. of this Regulation
condition: The lamp contains active electronics (LED driver/control) and is not exempted as passive from the broadband emission requirements.
test_case: Confirm the ambient scan recorded before or after the test is at least 6 dB below the paragraph 6.5.2.1. limits.

text: The radiated broadband emission limits shall apply to the ESA throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz for measurements performed in an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE) or open area test site (OATS).
quote: The limits apply throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz for measurements performed in an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE) or open area test site (OATS).
condition: The lamp contains active electronics (LED driver/control) and is not exempted as passive from the broadband emission requirements.
test_case: Measure radiated broadband emissions from 30 to 1,000 MHz and verify all readings are below the paragraph 6.5 limits.

text: If peak detectors are used for the radiated broadband emission measurements, a correction factor of 20 dB as defined in CISPR 12 shall be applied to the quasi-peak limits given in paragraphs 6.5. and 7.10.
quote: The limits given in paragraphs 6.5. and 7.10. of this Regulation are for quasi-peak detectors. If peak detectors are used a correction factor of 20 dB as defined in CISPR 12 shall be applied.
condition: The lamp contains active electronics and peak detectors are used for the measurement.
test_case: Check that peak-detector results were compared against the quasi-peak limits corrected by 20 dB.

text: The radiated broadband emission measurements shall be performed with a spectrum analyser or a scanning receiver using the parameters defined in Table 1 and Table 2 (30 to 1,000 MHz: 120 kHz bandwidth; peak minimum scan time 100 ms/MHz or 5 ms dwell with 60 kHz step; quasi-peak minimum scan time 20 s/MHz or 1 s dwell with 60 kHz step).
quote: The measurements shall be performed with a spectrum analyser or a scanning receiver. The parameters to be used are defined in Table 1 and Table 2.
condition: The lamp contains active electronics (LED driver/control) and is not exempted as passive from the broadband emission requirements.
test_case: Review the receiver settings in the test report against Table 1/Table 2 values.

text: Unless otherwise specified, the configuration with the LV harness closer to the antenna shall be tested and the phase centre of the antenna shall be in line with the centre of the longitudinal part of the wiring harnesses for frequencies up to 1,000 MHz.
quote: Unless otherwise specified the configuration with the LV harness closer to the antenna shall be tested. The phase centre of the antenna shall be in line
condition: The lamp contains active electronics (LED driver/control) and is not exempted as passive from the broadband emission requirements.
test_case: Inspect set-up photos/drawings to confirm LV harness nearest the antenna and antenna centred on the harness.

text: In the event that the limit is exceeded during the radiated broadband emission test, investigations shall be made to ensure that this is due to the ESA and not to background radiation.
quote: In the event that the limit is exceeded during the test, investigations shall be made to ensure that this is due to the ESA and not to background radiation.
condition: The lamp contains active electronics (LED driver/control) and is not exempted as passive from the broadband emission requirements.
test_case: Where an exceedance occurs, verify the report documents an investigation (e.g. ESA off ambient check) attributing the source.

text: The maximum of the readings relative to the limit (horizontal/vertical polarization) in each of the 14 frequency bands shall be taken as the characteristic reading at the frequency at which the measurements were made.
quote: The maximum of the readings relative to the limit (horizontal/vertical polarization) in each of the 14 frequency bands shall be taken as the characteristic reading
condition: The lamp contains active electronics and the 14-band test method is used.
test_case: Check that the reported characteristic reading per band is the maximum of horizontal and vertical polarisation readings and is below the limit.

text: If not otherwise stated in Annex 8, the measurement of radiated narrowband electromagnetic emissions from the ESA shall be performed according to CISPR 25.
quote: If not otherwise stated in this Annex the test shall be performed according to CISPR 25.
condition: The lamp contains active electronics (e.g. LED driver or microprocessor with an oscillator) generating narrowband emissions.
test_case: Review the narrowband emission test report and confirm the test set-up and procedure follow CISPR 25.

text: During the narrowband emission test, the ESA under test shall be in normal operation mode, preferably in maximum load.
quote: The ESA under test shall be in normal operation mode, preferably in maximum load.
condition: The lamp contains active electronics (e.g. LED driver or microprocessor with an oscillator) generating narrowband emissions.
test_case: Verify in the test report that the lamp functions were operated in normal mode with all functions at maximum load during measurement.

text: The narrowband emission test shall be performed according to the ALSE method described in paragraph 6.4. of CISPR 25.
quote: The test shall be performed according to ALSE method described in paragraph 6.4. of CISPR 25.
condition: The lamp contains active electronics (e.g. LED driver or microprocessor with an oscillator) generating narrowband emissions; an OATS complying with CISPR 16-1-4 may be used as an alternative.
test_case: Confirm the test report shows an ALSE set-up per CISPR 25 clause 6.4 (or a CISPR 16-1-4 compliant OATS).

text: To ensure that there is no extraneous noise or signal of a magnitude sufficient to affect materially the measurement, ambient measurements shall be taken before or after the main narrowband emission test.
quote: measurements shall be taken before or after the main test.
condition: The lamp contains active electronics generating narrowband emissions.
test_case: Check the test report contains an ambient scan recorded before or after the ESA measurement.

text: In the ambient measurement, the extraneous noise or signal shall be at least 6 dB below the limits of interference given in paragraph 6.6.2.1. of this Regulation, except for intentional narrowband ambient transmissions.
quote: the extraneous noise or signal shall be at least 6 dB below the limits of interference given in paragraph 6.6.2.1. of this Regulation
condition: The lamp contains active electronics generating narrowband emissions.
test_case: Compare the ambient scan with the paragraph 6.6.2.1 limits; pass if ambient is at least 6 dB below the limits (excluding intentional narrowband transmissions).

text: The narrowband emission limits apply throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz for measurements performed in an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE) or open area test site (OATS).
quote: The limits apply throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz for measurements performed in an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE)
condition: The lamp contains active electronics generating narrowband emissions.
test_case: Verify the measured narrowband emissions across 30-1,000 MHz are below the applicable limits.

text: The narrowband emission measurements shall be performed with an average detector.
quote: Measurements shall be performed with an average detector.
condition: The lamp contains active electronics generating narrowband emissions.
test_case: Confirm in the test report that the average detector was used for all narrowband readings.

text: The narrowband emission measurements shall be performed with a spectrum analyser or a scanning receiver, using the parameters defined in Tables 1 and 2.
quote: The measurements shall be performed with a spectrum analyser or a scanning receiver. The parameters to be used are defined in Tables 1 and 2.
condition: The lamp contains active electronics generating narrowband emissions.
test_case: Check the instrument type and settings recorded in the test report against Tables 1 and 2.

text: FFT-based measuring instruments shall continuously record and evaluate the signal during the measurement time.
quote: FFT-based measuring instruments shall continuously record and evaluate the signal during the measurement time.
condition: The lamp contains active electronics generating narrowband emissions and an FFT-based instrument is used.
test_case: Verify the FFT instrument was configured for continuous recording and evaluation over the measurement time.

text: If using FFT-based instruments, the minimum measurement time shall be 1 s per analysis frequency band (in real-time mode) of the FFT instrument.
quote: If using FFT-based instruments, the minimum measurement time shall be 1 s per analysis frequency band (in real-time mode)
condition: The lamp contains active electronics generating narrowband emissions and an FFT-based instrument is used.
test_case: Check the measurement time per FFT analysis band is at least 1 s.

text: When a spectrum analyser is used for the narrowband measurement in the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz, the average detector shall use a RBW at -3 dB of 100/120 kHz and a minimum scan time of 100 ms/MHz, as given in Table 1.
quote: Table 1 Spectrum analyser parameters Frequency range MHz Average detector RBW at -3 dB Minimum scan time 30 to 1,000 100/120 kHz 100 ms/MHz
condition: The lamp contains active electronics generating narrowband emissions and a spectrum analyser is used.
test_case: Verify spectrum analyser settings: RBW 100/120 kHz at -3 dB and scan time at least 100 ms/MHz.

text: If a spectrum analyser is used for peak measurements, the video band width shall be at least three times the resolution band width (RBW).
quote: If a spectrum analyser is used for peak measurements, the video band width shall be at least three times the resolution band width (RBW)
condition: The lamp contains active electronics generating narrowband emissions and a spectrum analyser is used for peak measurements.
test_case: Check VBW setting is at least 3 x RBW for peak measurements.

text: When a scanning receiver is used for the narrowband measurement in the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz, the average detector shall use a BW at -6 dB of 120 kHz, a maximum step size of 60 kHz and a minimum dwell time of 5 ms, as given in Table 2.
quote: Table 2 Scanning receiver parameters Frequency range MHz Average detector BW at -6 dB Maximum step size Minimum dwell time 30 to 1,000 120 kHz 60 kHz 5 ms
condition: The lamp contains active electronics generating narrowband emissions and a scanning receiver is used.
test_case: Verify receiver settings: BW 120 kHz at -6 dB, step size at most 60 kHz, dwell time at least 5 ms.

text: The narrowband emission test shall be performed at the intervals specified in the CISPR 12 standard throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz, or alternatively, with accredited manufacturer data, at the 14 frequencies giving the highest emission levels within each of the 14 frequency bands.
quote: The Technical Service shall perform the test at the intervals specified in the CISPR 12 standard throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz.
condition: The lamp contains active electronics generating narrowband emissions.
test_case: Confirm the test report covers 30-1,000 MHz at CISPR 12 intervals or at the highest-emission frequency in each of the 14 bands.

text: In the event that the limit is exceeded during the narrowband emission test, investigations shall be made to ensure that this is due to the ESA and not to background radiation including broadband radiation from the ESA.
quote: In the event that the limit is exceeded during the test, investigations shall be made to ensure that this is due to the ESA
condition: The lamp contains active electronics generating narrowband emissions.
test_case: For any limit exceedance, check the report documents investigation distinguishing ESA narrowband emission from background or broadband radiation.

text: The maximum of the readings relative to the limit (horizontal/vertical polarisation) in each of the 14 frequency bands shall be taken as the characteristic reading at the frequency at which the measurements were made.
quote: The maximum of the readings relative to the limit (horizontal/vertical polarisation) in each of the 14 frequency bands shall be taken as the characteristic reading
condition: The lamp contains active electronics generating narrowband emissions.
test_case: Verify the characteristic reading per band is the maximum of horizontal and vertical polarisation readings relative to the limit.

text: The ESA may comply with the requirements of any combination of the test methods (absorber chamber test according to ISO 11452-2, TEM cell testing according to ISO 11452-3, bulk current injection testing according to ISO 11452-4, stripline testing according to ISO 11452-5, reverberation chamber test according to ISO 11452-11) at the manufacturer's discretion only provided that these result in the full frequency range specified in paragraph 3.1. of this Annex being covered.
quote: ESAs may comply with the requirements of any combination of the following test methods at the manufacturer's discretion provided that these results in the full frequency range
test_case: Review the immunity test report and confirm that the selected method(s) together cover 20 to 6,000 MHz without gaps.

text: For the immunity test of the ESA to electromagnetic radiation, the frequency range and general test conditions shall be based on ISO 11452-1.
quote: (Frequency range and general test conditions shall be based on ISO 11452-1).
test_case: Check that the test plan and report reference ISO 11452-1 for the frequency range and general conditions.

text: During the immunity test of the ESA to electromagnetic radiation, the test conditions shall be according to ISO 11452-1.
quote: The test conditions shall be according to ISO 11452-1.
test_case: Verify in the test report that the test conditions (temperature, supply voltage, etc.) follow ISO 11452-1.

text: The ESA under test shall be switched on and shall be stimulated to be in normal operation condition.
quote: The ESA under test shall be switched on and shall be stimulated to be in normal operation condition.
test_case: Confirm that during the test the lamp functions (position, stop, reversing) are energised and operating normally.

text: The ESA under test shall be arranged as defined in Annex 9 unless individual test methods dictate otherwise.
quote: It shall be arranged as defined in this Annex unless individual test methods dictate otherwise.
test_case: Inspect the test set-up photos and description against the Annex 9 arrangement.

text: Any extraneous equipment required to operate the ESA under test shall not be in place during the calibration phase.
quote: Any extraneous equipment required to operate the ESA under test shall not be in place during the calibration phase.
test_case: Check the calibration records to confirm that no ESA support equipment was present during field calibration.

text: No extraneous equipment shall be closer than 1 m from the reference point during calibration.
quote: No extraneous equipment shall be closer than 1 m from the reference point during calibration.
test_case: Verify from the calibration set-up that all extraneous equipment was at least 1 m from the reference point.

text: To ensure reproducible measurement results, the test signal generating equipment and its layout shall be to the same specification as that used during each appropriate calibration phase.
quote: the test signal generating equipment and its layout shall be to the same specification as that used during each appropriate calibration phase.
test_case: Compare the equipment and layout records for the calibration and test phases and confirm they are identical.

text: If the ESA under test consists of more than one unit and the wiring harnesses intended for use in the vehicle are not available, the length between the electronic control unit and the AN shall be as defined in the standard.
quote: If these are not available, the length between the electronic control unit and the AN shall be as defined in the standard.
condition: ESA consists of more than one unit (e.g. lamp with separate LED driver/ECU) and the vehicle harness is not available
test_case: Measure the interconnecting cable length between the ECU and the AN and compare it with the ISO standard value.

text: Immunity measurements on the ESA shall be made in the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency range with frequency steps according to ISO 11452-1.
quote: Measurements shall be made in the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency range with frequency steps according to ISO 11452-1.
test_case: Confirm that the test report covers 20 to 6,000 MHz with ISO 11452-1 step sizes.

text: Unless otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer, the test signal modulation shall be AM (amplitude modulation), with 1 kHz modulation and 80 per cent modulation depth in the 20 to 400 MHz frequency range.
quote: AM (amplitude modulation), with 1 kHz modulation and 80 per cent modulation depth in the 20 to 400 MHz frequency range
test_case: Verify that the signal generator settings for 20 to 400 MHz are AM at 1 kHz with 80 % depth.

text: Unless otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer, the test signal modulation shall be PM2 (pulse modulation type 2), Ton 3 µs, period 3,333 µs in the 2,700 to 3,100 MHz frequency range.
quote: PM2 (pulse modulation type 2), Ton 3 µs, period 3,333 µs in the 2,700 to 3,100 MHz frequency range
test_case: Verify that the modulation in the 2,700 to 3,100 MHz band is PM2 with Ton 3 µs and period 3,333 µs.

text: Unless otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer, the test signal modulation shall be PM3 (pulse modulation type 3), Ton 500 µs, period 1,000 µs in the 380 to 2,700 MHz and the 3,100 to 6,000 MHz frequency ranges.
quote: PM3 (pulse modulation type 3), Ton 500 µs, period 1,000 µs in the 380 to 2,700 MHz and the 3,100 to 6,000 MHz frequency ranges.
test_case: Verify that the modulation in 380 to 2,700 MHz and 3,100 to 6,000 MHz is PM3 with Ton 500 µs and period 1,000 µs.

text: The frequency step size and dwell time for the ESA immunity test shall be chosen according to ISO 11452-1.
quote: Frequency step size and dwell time shall be chosen according to ISO 11452-1.
test_case: Check the test report step size and dwell time against ISO 11452-1.

text: The ESA shall be tested at the intervals specified in ISO 11452-1 throughout the frequency range 20 to 6,000 MHz, or alternatively at a reduced number of spot frequencies where the manufacturer provides full-band data from an ISO 17025 accredited laboratory recognized by the Type Approval Authority.
quote: The Technical Service shall perform the test at the intervals specified in ISO 11452-1, throughout the frequency range 20 to 6,000 MHz.
test_case: Confirm full-band testing, or the accredited full-band data plus the spot-frequency confirmation test.

text: If the ESA fails the tests defined in Annex 9, it shall be verified as having failed under the relevant test conditions and not as a result of the generation of uncontrolled fields.
quote: If an ESA fails the tests defined in this Annex, it shall be verified as having failed under the relevant test conditions
test_case: On any failure, review the field monitoring data to confirm that the field conditions were controlled.

text: For the absorber chamber test, the "substitution method" shall be used to establish the test field conditions according to ISO 11452-2.
quote: The "substitution method" shall be used to establish the test field conditions according to ISO 11452-2.
condition: Absorber chamber test method (ISO 11452-2) is selected
test_case: Check that the field calibration in the absorber chamber used the ISO 11452-2 substitution method.

text: The absorber chamber test shall be performed with vertical polarization.
quote: The test shall be performed with vertical polarization.
condition: Absorber chamber test method (ISO 11452-2) is selected
test_case: Verify in the test report that the antenna polarization was vertical.

text: The TEM cell test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-3, with the method of maximum field coupling to the ESA or to the wiring harness inside the TEM-cell chosen depending on the ESA to be tested.
quote: The test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-3. Depending on the ESA to be tested the Technical Service shall chose the method
condition: TEM cell test method (ISO 11452-3) is selected
test_case: Check that the TEM cell test followed ISO 11452-3 and that the coupling orientation chosen is documented.

text: The bulk current injection test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-4 on a test bench, using either the BCI substitution method with the injection probe positioned at 150 mm distance to the ESA, or the BCI closed loop method with the injection probe positioned at 900 mm distance to the ESA.
quote: BCI test method with substitution method and injection probe positioned at 150 mm distance to the ESA;Or BCI test method with closed loop method
condition: Bulk current injection test method (ISO 11452-4) is selected
test_case: Verify the BCI method used and measure the probe distance: 150 mm for substitution or 900 mm for closed loop.

text: If the ESA is alternatively tested for bulk current injection while installed in the vehicle, the test shall be performed according to ISO 11451-4 using the BCI substitution method with the injection probe positioned at 150 mm distance to the ESA.
quote: the ESA may be tested while installed in the vehicle according to ISO 11451-4 with the following characteristics: BCI test method with substitution method
condition: BCI test performed with the ESA installed in the vehicle
test_case: Confirm that the in-vehicle BCI test used ISO 11451-4 with the substitution method and a 150 mm probe distance.

text: The stripline test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-5.
quote: Test methodology The test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-5.
condition: Stripline test method (ISO 11452-5) is selected
test_case: Check that the stripline test set-up and procedure in the report follow ISO 11452-5.

text: The reverberation chamber test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-11.
quote: The test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-11.
condition: Reverberation chamber test method (ISO 11452-11) is selected
test_case: Check that the reverberation chamber test followed ISO 11452-11.

text: Unless otherwise specified, the reverberation chamber testing method shall be carried out using a test setup with ground plane.
quote: Unless otherwise specified, the reverberation chamber testing method shall be carried out using a test setup with ground plane.
condition: Reverberation chamber test method (ISO 11452-11) is selected
test_case: Inspect the reverberation chamber set-up to confirm that a ground plane was used.

text: The test method for the ESA shall ensure the immunity of the ESA to conducted transients on the vehicle power supply and limit conducted transients from the ESA to the vehicle power supply.
quote: This test method shall ensure the immunity of ESAs to conducted transients on the vehicle power supply and limit conducted transients
test_case: Perform the Annex 10 transient immunity and emission tests on the lamp and confirm that the immunity criteria and emission limits are met.

text: For immunity against transient disturbances conducted along 12/24 V supply lines, the test pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b according to ISO 7637-2 shall be applied to the supply lines as well as to other connections of the ESA which may be operationally connected to supply lines.
quote: Apply the test pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b according to the International Standard ISO 7637-2 to the supply lines
test_case: Apply ISO 7637-2 pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b to the lamp supply lines and to connections that may be operationally connected to them, then check the functional status against the required FPSC.

text: For immunity against transient disturbances conducted along 12/24 V supply lines, the starting profile according to ISO 16750-2 shall be applied to the supply lines as well as to other connections of the ESA which may be operationally connected to supply lines, except for ESAs that are exclusively reserved for mounting on electric vehicles (vehicles without 12V/24V starter motor).
quote: Apply the starting profile according to the International Standard ISO 16750-2 to the supply lines as well as to other connections
condition: The lamp is not exclusively reserved for mounting on electric vehicles without a 12V/24V starter motor
test_case: Apply the ISO 16750-2 starting profile to the lamp supply lines and check the functional status class, unless the lamp is shown to be for EV-only use.

text: The emission of transient conducted disturbances generated by the ESA on 12/24 V supply lines shall be measured according to ISO 7637-2 on supply lines as well as on other connections of the ESA which may be operationally connected to supply lines.
quote: Measurement according to the International Standard ISO 7637-2 on supply lines as well as to other connections of ESAs
test_case: Measure the conducted transient emissions of the lamp per ISO 7637-2 on its supply lines and compare them with the limits of the Regulation.

text: The lighting and light-signalling devices shall be so fitted that under normal conditions of use as defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and notwithstanding any vibrations to which they may be subjected, they retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation and enable the vehicle to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.
quote: The lighting and light-signalling devices shall be so fitted that under normal conditions of use as defined in paragraphs 2.3.10.
test_case: Inspect the lamp mounting and verify after vibration/use that the position, orientation and photometric characteristics remain within the Regulation's requirements.

text: It shall not be possible for the lamps to be inadvertently maladjusted.
quote: In particular, it shall not be possible for the lamps to be inadvertently maladjusted.
test_case: Inspect the fixings and verify that the lamp cannot be moved out of its fitted orientation without deliberate action or tools.

text: For all light-signalling devices, the reference axis of the lamp when fitted to the vehicle shall be parallel to the bearing plane of the vehicle on the road, with a tolerance of ±3°.
quote: the reference axis of the lamp when fitted to the vehicle shall be parallel to the bearing plane of the vehicle on the road
test_case: Measure the installed reference axis of each function relative to the road plane and confirm it is parallel within ±3°.

text: For the rear position, stop and reversing lamps and rear retro-reflector (signalling devices other than side retro-reflectors and side-marker lamps), the reference axis of the lamp when fitted to the vehicle shall be parallel to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle, with a tolerance of ±3°.
quote: parallel to that plane in the case of all other signalling devices. In each direction a tolerance of ±3° shall be allowed.
test_case: Measure the installed reference axis relative to the vehicle median longitudinal plane and confirm it is parallel within ±3°.

text: Any specific instructions as regards fitting laid down by the manufacturer shall be complied with.
quote: In addition, any specific instructions as regards fitting laid down by the manufacturer shall be complied with.
test_case: Compare the installation against the manufacturer's fitting instructions and confirm full compliance.

text: In the absence of specific instructions, the height and orientation of the lamps shall be verified with the vehicle unladen and placed on a flat, horizontal surface, in the condition defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2.
quote: the height and orientation of the lamps shall be verified with the vehicle unladen and placed on a flat, horizontal surface
test_case: Place the unladen vehicle on a flat horizontal surface and measure the lamp height and orientation in that condition.

text: In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair shall be fitted to the vehicle symmetrically in relation to the median longitudinal plane (this estimate to be based on the exterior geometrical form of the lamp and not on the edge of its illuminating surface referred to in paragraph 2.10.3.).
quote: Be fitted to the vehicle symmetrically in relation to the median longitudinal plane (this estimate to be based on the exterior geometrical form of the lamp
test_case: Measure the left and right lamp positions from the median longitudinal plane using the exterior lamp form and confirm symmetry.

text: In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair shall be symmetrical to one another in relation to the median longitudinal plane; this requirement is not valid with regard to the interior structure of the lamp.
quote: Be symmetrical to one another in relation to the median longitudinal plane, this requirement is not valid with regard to the interior structure of the lamp
test_case: Compare the left and right lamps and confirm they are mirror-symmetrical externally.

text: In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair shall satisfy the same colorimetric requirements.
quote: Satisfy the same colorimetric requirements.
test_case: Measure the chromaticity of each function on the left and right lamps and confirm both meet the same colour requirements.

text: In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair shall have substantially identical photometric characteristics.
quote: Have substantially identical photometric characteristics. This shall not apply to a matched pair of a function and/or an AFS.
test_case: Compare the photometric data of the left and right lamps for each function and confirm they are substantially identical.

text: In case of lamps incorporating a manufacturer logo, only two lateral logos (one on each side) or one central logo can be fitted on the rear of the vehicle.
quote: only two lateral logos (one on each side) or one central logo can be fitted on the rear of the vehicle
condition: Lamp incorporates a manufacturer logo
test_case: Count the logos incorporated in rear lamps and confirm at most two lateral or one central logo.

text: In case of lamps incorporating a logo, all logos that are not vehicle manufacturer or body manufacturer logos are prohibited.
quote: All logos that are not vehicle manufacturer or body manufacturer logos are prohibited.
condition: Lamp incorporates a logo
test_case: Inspect any logo in the lamp and confirm it is a vehicle or body manufacturer logo.

text: On vehicles whose external shape is asymmetrical, the requirements for lamps constituting a pair shall be satisfied so far as is possible.
quote: On vehicles whose external shape is asymmetrical the above requirements shall be satisfied so far as is possible.
condition: Vehicle external shape is asymmetrical
test_case: Assess the pair symmetry on the asymmetrical vehicle and confirm deviations are limited to what the body shape requires.

text: The rear position, stop and reversing lamps and retro-reflector may be grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated with one another only provided that all requirements regarding colour, position, orientation, geometric visibility, electrical connections and other requirements, if any, are fulfilled.
quote: Lamps may be grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated with one another provided that all requirements regarding colour, position, orientation, geometric visibility, electrical connections
test_case: Verify for each function in the combination lamp that colour, position, orientation, geometric visibility and electrical connection requirements are met.

text: The photometric and colorimetric requirements of a lamp shall be fulfilled when all other functions with which this lamp is grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated are switched OFF.
quote: The photometric and colorimetric requirements of a lamp shall be fulfilled when all other functions with which this lamp is grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated are switched OFF.
test_case: Measure each function's photometry and colour with all other functions of the lamp switched OFF and confirm compliance.

text: When a rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with one or more other function(s) which can be switched ON together with it, the requirements regarding colour of each of these other functions shall be fulfilled when the reciprocally incorporated function(s) and the rear position lamps are switched ON.
quote: the requirements regarding colour of each of these other functions shall be fulfilled when the reciprocally incorporated function(s) and the front or rear position lamps are switched ON
condition: Rear position lamp reciprocally incorporated with another function (e.g. stop lamp)
test_case: Switch ON the rear position lamp together with the reciprocally incorporated function and measure the colour of that function for compliance.

text: Stop lamps and direction-indicator lamps shall not be reciprocally incorporated.
quote: Stop lamps and direction-indicator lamps are not permitted to be reciprocally incorporated.
condition: A direction-indicator function is integrated in the lamp
test_case: Inspect the lamp design and confirm the stop lamp does not share a common illuminating surface with a direction indicator.

text: Where stop lamps and direction-indicator lamps are grouped, any horizontal or vertical straight line passing through the projections of the apparent surfaces of these functions on a plane perpendicular to the reference axis shall not intersect more than two borderlines separating adjacent areas of different colour.
quote: shall not intersect more than two borderlines separating adjacent areas of different colour
condition: A direction-indicator function is grouped with the stop lamp
test_case: Project the apparent surfaces and check that no horizontal or vertical line crosses more than two colour borderlines.

text: Where stop lamps and direction-indicator lamps are grouped, their apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axis, based upon the areas bounded by the outline of their light emitting surfaces, shall not overlap.
quote: Their apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axis, based upon the areas bounded by the outline of their light emitting surfaces, do not overlap.
condition: A direction-indicator function is grouped with the stop lamp
test_case: Project the apparent surfaces in the reference axis direction and confirm no overlap.

text: Single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.14.11.1., subparagraph (a), the apparent surface of which is composed of two or more distinct parts, shall be installed in such a way that either the total area of the projection of the distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis on a plane tangent to the exterior surface of the outer lens and perpendicular to the reference axis occupies not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing the projection of the said apparent surface, or the minimum distance between the facing edges of two adjacent/tangential distinct parts of the apparent surface does not exceed 75 mm when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis; these requirements shall not apply to a single retro-reflector.
quote: shall occupy not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing the projection of the said apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis
condition: A function's apparent surface is composed of two or more distinct parts (e.g. separate chambers)
test_case: Project the distinct parts of the apparent surface and confirm ≥60 % fill of the circumscribing quadrilateral or ≤75 mm gap between facing edges.

text: Single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.4.11.1., subparagraph (b) or (c), composed of two lamps marked "D" or two independent retro reflectors, shall be installed in such a way that either the projection of the apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axis of the two lamps or retro reflectors occupies not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing the projections, or the minimum distance between the facing edges of the apparent surfaces of the two lamps or two independent retro reflectors does not exceed 75 mm when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis.
quote: composed of two lamps marked "D" or two independent retro reflectors, shall be installed in such a way that
condition: A function is realised by two lamps marked "D" or two independent retro-reflectors (e.g. split body/tailgate)
test_case: Project the two apparent surfaces and confirm ≥60 % fill of the circumscribing quadrilateral or ≤75 mm gap.

text: Single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.4.11.1., subparagraph (d) (interdependent lamp system) shall fulfil the requirements of paragraph 5.7.2.1.
quote: Single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.4.11.1., subparagraph (d) shall fulfil the requirements of paragraph 5.7.2.1.
condition: A function is an interdependent lamp system
test_case: Apply the 60 % / 75 mm check of paragraph 5.7.2.1 to the interdependent lamp system.

text: Where two or more lamps and/or two or more separate apparent surfaces are included into the same lamp body and/or have a common outer lens, these shall not be considered as an interdependent lamp system, except that a lamp in the shape of a band or strip may be part of an interdependent lamp system.
quote: Where two or more lamps and/or two or more separate apparent surfaces are included into the same lamp body and/or have a common outer lens these shall not be considered
test_case: Review the lamp classification and confirm separate surfaces in the common housing/lens are not declared as an interdependent lamp system unless band/strip-shaped.

text: Two lamps or an even number of lamps in the shape of a band or strip shall be placed symmetrically in relation to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle, extending on both sides to within at least 0.4 m of the extreme outer edge of the vehicle, and shall be not less than 0.8 m long.
quote: shall be placed symmetrically in relation to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle, extending on both sides to within at least 0.4 m
condition: A function is realised as a band- or strip-shaped lamp
test_case: Measure the strip position, length (≥0.8 m) and distance to the vehicle outer edge (≤0.4 m) on both sides.

text: For lamps in the shape of a band or strip, the illumination of such a surface shall be provided by not less than two light sources placed as close as possible to the ends.
quote: the illumination of such a surface shall be provided by not less than two light sources placed as close as possible to the ends
condition: A function is realised as a band- or strip-shaped lamp
test_case: Inspect the strip lamp and confirm at least two light sources located close to its ends.

text: For lamps in the shape of a band or strip whose light-emitting surface is constituted by a number of juxtaposed elements, these individual light-emitting surfaces, when projected on a transverse plane, shall fulfil the requirements of paragraph 5.7.2.1.
quote: the light-emitting surface may be constituted by a number of juxtaposed elements on condition that these individual light-emitting surfaces
condition: Band- or strip-shaped lamp with juxtaposed light-emitting elements
test_case: Project the juxtaposed elements on a transverse plane and apply the 60 % / 75 mm check.

text: The maximum height above the ground shall be measured from the highest point and the minimum height from the lowest point of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis.
quote: The maximum height above the ground shall be measured from the highest point and the minimum height from the lowest point of the apparent surface
test_case: Measure each function's highest and lowest apparent-surface points above the ground in the reference-axis direction.

text: For the purposes of reducing the geometric visibility angles, the position of a lamp with regard to height above the ground shall be measured from the H plane.
quote: For the purposes of reducing the geometric visibility angles, the position of a lamp with regard to height above the ground, shall be measured from the H plane.
condition: Reduced geometric visibility angles are claimed due to low mounting height
test_case: Measure the height of the H plane above the ground and use it to justify any reduced vertical visibility angle.

text: The position of the rear lamps, as regards width, shall be determined from that edge of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is the furthest from the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle when referred to the overall width, and from the inner edges of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis when referred to the distance between lamps.
quote: The position, as regards width, will be determined from that edge of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis
test_case: On the vehicle, measure the lateral position from the outermost edge of the apparent surface for overall width and from the inner edges for the distance between lamps.

text: In the absence of specific instructions, the photometric characteristics (e.g. intensity, colour, apparent surface, etc.) of the rear position lamp, stop lamp and reversing lamp shall not be intentionally varied during the period when the lamp is switched ON.
quote: the photometric characteristics (e.g. intensity, colour, apparent surface, etc.) of a lamp shall not be intentionally varied during the period when the lamp is switched ON
test_case: Operate each function and confirm by observation and photometric check that intensity, colour and apparent surface stay constant while switched ON.

text: Any variation of the photometric characteristics of the lamp in relation to the ambient light, as a consequence of other lamps being switched ON or OFF, or when the lamp is being used to provide another lighting function, shall be in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.
quote: provided that any variation in the photometric characteristics is in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned
condition: Lamp photometric characteristics vary (e.g. variable intensity or reciprocally incorporated position/stop function).
test_case: Check that each varied state of the lamp meets the photometric values of its device approval regulation.

text: Red light emitted by the rear position lamp, stop lamp and rear retro-reflector fitted on the rear of the vehicle (as defined in paragraph 2.1.5.) shall not be visible from the front of the vehicle.
quote: Red light emitted by a lamp fitted on the rear of the vehicle (as defined in paragraph 2.1.5.) shall not be visible from the front of the vehicle.
test_case: Inspect the vehicle from the front and confirm no red light from the rear lamp is visible.

text: For the visibility of red light towards the front of a vehicle, there shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of the red rear lamp if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 1 in a transverse plane situated 25 m in front of the vehicle (see Annex 4).
quote: there shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of a red lamp if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 1
test_case: Per Annex 4, check from Zone 1 in a transverse plane 25 m ahead of the vehicle that no part of the red apparent surface is directly visible.

text: In case of doubt, the requirement on red light visibility to the front shall be deemed fulfilled if the luminous intensity of the red light emitted to the front, as verified during type approval of the lamps, is not more than 0.25 cd per lamp taking into account the influence of the vehicle body if applicable.
quote: is not more than 0.25 cd per lamp taking into account the influence of the vehicle body if applicable
test_case: Measure the red luminous intensity emitted towards the front and confirm it is not more than 0.25 cd per lamp.

text: The electrical connections shall be such that the front and rear position lamps, the end-outline marker lamps, if they exist, the side-marker lamps, if they exist, and the rear registration plate lamp can only be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.
quote: the front and rear position lamps, the end-outline marker lamps, if they exist, the side-marker lamps, if they exist, and the rear registration plate lamp can only be switched ON and OFF simultaneously
test_case: Operate the lighting switch and verify the rear position lamps switch ON and OFF together with front position lamps, side-marker, end-outline and registration plate lamps.

text: The requirement for simultaneous switching of the rear position lamps does not apply while the front and rear position lamps are switched ON as parking lamps, side-marker lamps flash with direction indicators, daytime running lamps are switched ON, or the front position lamp function is substituted under paragraph 5.12.1.
quote: Front and rear position lamps, as well as side-marker lamps when combined or reciprocally incorporated with said lamps, are switched ON as parking lamps
test_case: Verify that any non-simultaneous switching of the rear position lamps occurs only under the listed exception conditions.

text: In the case of an interdependent lamp system, all light sources shall be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.
quote: In the case of an interdependent lamp system, all light sources shall be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.
condition: Any function of the lamp is realised as an interdependent lamp system (e.g. split body/tailgate).
test_case: Operate the function and confirm all light sources of the interdependent lamp system switch ON and OFF together.

text: The concealment of the rear position lamps, stop lamps, reversing lamps and rear retro-reflectors shall be prohibited.
