quote: The concealment of lamps shall be prohibited, with the exception of the main-beam headlamps, the dipped-beam headlamps and the front fog lamps
test_case: Inspect the installation and confirm the rear lamp functions are not concealable.

text: The colour of the light emitted by the reversing lamp shall be white.
quote: The colours of the light emitted by the lamps are the following: ... Reversing lamp: White
test_case: Measure the chromaticity of the reversing lamp and confirm it is within the white boundaries.

text: The colour of the light emitted by the stop lamp shall be red.
quote: The colours of the light emitted by the lamps are the following: ... Stop lamp: Red
test_case: Measure the chromaticity of the stop lamp and confirm it is within the red boundaries.

text: The colour of the light emitted by the rear position lamp shall be red.
quote: The colours of the light emitted by the lamps are the following: ... Rear position lamp: Red
test_case: Measure the chromaticity of the rear position lamp and confirm it is within the red boundaries.

text: The colour of the rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be red.
quote: Rear retro-reflector, non- triangular: Red
test_case: Verify the retro-reflector colour is red by colorimetric check per its device approval.

text: The number of rear position lamps, stop lamps, reversing lamps and rear retro-reflectors mounted on the vehicle shall be equal to the number indicated in the individual specifications of this Regulation.
quote: The number of lamps mounted on the vehicle shall be equal to the number indicated in the individual specifications of this Regulation.
test_case: Count the lamps of each function on the vehicle and compare against the individual specifications in paragraph 6.

text: The rear lamp may be installed on movable components only provided that the conditions specified in paragraphs 5.18., 5.19. and 5.20. are fulfilled.
quote: Any lamp may be installed on movable components provided that the conditions specified in paragraphs 5.18., 5.19. and 5.20. are fulfilled.
condition: Lamp (or part of it) is installed on a movable component such as tailgate or boot lid.
test_case: If mounted on a movable component, verify compliance with paragraphs 5.18 to 5.20.

text: Rear position lamps and rear retro-reflectors may be installed on movable components only if at all fixed positions of the movable components the lamps on the movable components meet all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for those lamps.
quote: If at all fixed positions of the movable components the lamps on the movable components meet all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements
condition: Rear position lamp or retro-reflector is installed on a movable component.
test_case: With the movable component in each fixed position, check position, geometric visibility, colour and photometry of the lamps.

text: Where the rear position lamp or rear retro-reflector function is obtained by an assembly of two lamps marked "D", only one of the lamps needs to meet the position, geometric visibility and photometric requirements for those lamps at all fixed positions of the movable components.
quote: only one of the lamps needs to meet the position, geometric visibility and photometric requirements for those lamps at all fixed positions of the movable components
condition: Function obtained by an assembly of two lamps marked "D" with one on a movable component.
test_case: With the movable component in all fixed positions, verify at least one "D" lamp meets position, geometric visibility and photometric requirements.

text: Where additional lamps for the rear position lamp or rear retro-reflector functions are fitted and switched ON when the movable component is in any fixed open position, these additional lamps shall satisfy all the position, geometric visibility and photometric requirements applicable to the lamps installed on the movable component.
quote: provided that these additional lamps satisfy all the position, geometric visibility and photometric requirements applicable to the lamps installed on the movable component
condition: Additional lamps are switched ON when the movable component carrying rear position lamps is open.
test_case: Open the movable component to each fixed position and verify the additional lamps meet position, geometric visibility and photometric requirements.

text: Where the rear position lamp function is obtained by an interdependent lamp system completely mounted on the moving component(s), the requirements of paragraph 5.18.1. shall be satisfied; additional lamps switched ON when the movable component is in any fixed open position shall satisfy all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements applicable to the lamps installed on the movable component.
quote: Should the complete interdependent lamp system be mounted on the moving component(s), the requirements of paragraph 5.18.1. shall be satisfied.
condition: Rear position lamp is an interdependent lamp system fully mounted on a movable component.
test_case: Verify compliance with paragraph 5.18.1 at all fixed positions of the movable component.

text: Where the rear position lamp function is obtained by an interdependent lamp system partly mounted on the fixed component and partly on a movable component, the interdependent lamp(s) specified by the Applicant during the device approval procedure shall meet all the position, outwards geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for those lamps, at all fixed positions of the movable component(s).
quote: the interdependent lamp(s) specified by the Applicant during the device approval procedure shall meet all the position, outwards geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements
condition: Rear position lamp is an interdependent lamp system split between fixed and movable components.
test_case: At all fixed positions of the movable component, verify the specified interdependent lamp(s) meet position, outward visibility, colour and photometry.

text: For an interdependent rear position lamp system partly mounted on a movable component, the inwards geometric visibility requirement(s) is(are) deemed to be satisfied if the specified interdependent lamp(s) still conform(s) to the photometric values prescribed in the field of light distribution for the approval of the device, at all fixed positions of the movable component(s).
quote: The inwards geometric visibility requirement(s) is(are) deemed to be satisfied if this(these) interdependent lamp(s) still conform(s) to the photometric values
condition: Rear position lamp is an interdependent lamp system split between fixed and movable components.
test_case: Check photometric values in the field of light distribution at all fixed positions of the movable component.

text: When the movable components are in a position other than a "normal position of use", the lamps installed on them shall not cause undue discomfort to road users.
quote: When the movable components are in a position other than a "normal position of use", the devices installed on them shall not cause undue discomfort to road users.
condition: Lamp installed on a movable component.
test_case: With the movable component open, assess that the lamps do not cause undue discomfort (glare) to road users.

text: When the lamp is installed on a movable component and the movable component is in the "normal position(s) of use", the lamp shall always return to the position(s) specified by the manufacturer in accordance with this Regulation.
quote: the lamp shall always return to the position(s) specified by the manufacturer in accordance with this Regulation
condition: Lamp installed on a movable component.
test_case: Operate the movable component repeatedly and confirm the lamp returns to the manufacturer-specified position.

text: The apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the rear position lamps and retro-reflectors shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component, with or without a light-signalling device installed on it, in any fixed position different from the "normal position of use".
quote: shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component, with or without a light-signalling device installed on it
condition: A movable component (e.g. tailgate, boot lid) can obstruct the lamp in an open fixed position.
test_case: With the movable component in each fixed open position, measure the hidden share of the apparent surface and confirm it does not exceed 50 per cent.

text: If the 50 per cent obscuration requirement is not practicable, additional lamps satisfying all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for the rear position lamps and retro-reflectors shall be switched ON when the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of these lamps is more than 50 per cent hidden by the movable component.
quote: Additional lamps satisfying all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for the above indicated lamps shall be switched ON
condition: Rear position lamp or retro-reflector is more than 50 per cent hidden by a movable component in a fixed open position.
test_case: Open the movable component and verify additional compliant lamps switch ON when the apparent surface is more than 50 per cent hidden.

text: Where more than 50 per cent of the apparent surface of the rear position or stop lamp in the direction of the reference axis can be hidden by movable components, a notice in the vehicle shall inform the user that in certain position(s) of the movable components other road users shall be warned of the presence of the vehicle on the road, for example by means of a warning triangle or other devices according to national requirements. This does not apply to retro-reflectors (paragraph 5.21.3.).
quote: A notice in the vehicle shall inform the user that in certain position(s) of the movable components other road users shall be warned
condition: Lamp (or part of it) mounted on a movable component such as a tailgate or boot lid, with more than 50% of the apparent surface hidden when open
test_case: Inspect the vehicle documentation and notice for the required user warning when the lamp is mounted on a movable component.

text: With the exception of retro-reflectors, the rear position, stop and reversing lamps, even bearing an approval mark, are deemed not to be present when they cannot be made to operate by the sole installation of a light source and/or a fuse.
quote: With the exception of retro-reflectors, a lamp even bearing an approval mark is deemed not to be present when it cannot be made to operate
test_case: Verify on the installed vehicle that each lamp function operates without anything other than fitting a light source and/or fuse.

text: Lamps approved with light source(s) according to UN Regulation No. 37, except when such light sources are used as non-replaceable light sources, shall be fitted in a vehicle in such a way that the light source can be correctly replaced without the need for expert assistance and without the need for special tools, other than those provided with the vehicle by the manufacturer.
quote: shall be fitted in a vehicle in such a way that the light source can be correctly replaced without the need for expert assistance
condition: Lamp uses replaceable light source(s) approved according to UN R37
test_case: Perform a light-source replacement on the installed lamp using only vehicle-supplied tools; pass if correctly replaced without expert help.

text: For lamps approved with replaceable light source(s) according to UN Regulation No. 37, the vehicle manufacturer shall provide with the vehicle a detailed description of the procedure for replacement.
quote: The vehicle manufacturer shall provide with the vehicle a detailed description of the procedure for replacement.
condition: Lamp uses replaceable light source(s) approved according to UN R37
test_case: Check the owner's documentation for a detailed light-source replacement procedure.

text: In the case where a light source module of the lamp includes a holder for an approved replaceable light source according to Regulation No. 37, this light source shall be replaceable as required in paragraph 5.23.
quote: In the case where a light source module includes a holder for an approved replaceable light source according to Regulation No. 37
condition: Light source module includes a holder for an R37 replaceable light source
test_case: Verify the R37 light source in the module can be replaced per paragraph 5.23.

text: Any temporary fail-safe replacement of the light-signalling function of the rear position lamp is allowed only provided that the replacement function in case of a failure is similar in colour, main intensity and position to the function that has ceased to operate and the replacement device remains operational in its original safety function.
quote: provided that the replacement function in case of a failure is similar in colour, main intensity and position to the function that has ceased to operate
condition: Lamp provides a temporary fail-safe replacement of the rear position lamp function
test_case: Simulate a rear position lamp failure and verify the replacement function matches colour, intensity and position while the replacement device keeps its original function.

text: During temporary fail-safe replacement of the rear position lamp function, a tell-tale on the dashboard shall indicate occurrence of a temporary replacement and need for repair.
quote: During replacement, a tell-tale on the dashboard (paragraph 2.3.5. of this Regulation) shall indicate occurrence of a temporary replacement and need for repair.
condition: Lamp provides a temporary fail-safe replacement of the rear position lamp function
test_case: Simulate failure and verify the dashboard tell-tale indicates the temporary replacement.

text: Rear position lamps of category R2 and stop lamps of category S2 with variable luminous intensity control are allowed only provided that the intensity of all such lamps, when combined, grouped or reciprocally incorporated, vary all together in the same manner and in a similar proportion.
quote: The intensity of the all lamps mentioned above, when combined, grouped or reciprocally incorporated, vary all together in the same manner and in a similar proportion.
condition: Rear position lamp of category R2 and/or stop lamp of category S2 with variable luminous intensity control
test_case: Measure intensities of the R2/S2 lamps across the variation range and verify they vary together proportionally.

text: For rear position lamps of category R2 and stop lamps of category S2 with variable luminous intensity control, in the entire intensity range, the specific prescribed ratio between the luminous intensities of two lamps, if applicable, shall be maintained throughout variation transitions.
quote: In the entire intensity range, the specific prescribed ratio between the luminous intensities of two lamps, if applicable, shall be maintained throughout variation transitions.
condition: Rear position lamp of category R2 and/or stop lamp of category S2 with variable luminous intensity control
test_case: Measure stop/position intensity ratio during transitions and verify the prescribed ratio is maintained.

text: For R2 rear position lamps and S2 stop lamps with variable luminous intensity, increase and decrease of the luminous intensity shall be in the limits prescribed in the pertinent UN Regulations and only in relation to ambient lighting, fog, snowfall, rain, spray, dust clouds or contamination of the light emitting surface.
quote: Increase and decrease of the luminous intensity, in the limits prescribed in the pertinent UN Regulations, is allowed in relation to the following conditions
condition: Variable luminous intensity control (R2/S2) responding to environmental conditions
test_case: Review control strategy and measure intensities to confirm variation stays within regulation limits and is triggered only by listed conditions.

text: For R2 rear position lamps and S2 stop lamps with variable luminous intensity, a decrease of the luminous intensity in relation to traffic conditions, in the limits prescribed in the pertinent UN Regulations, is allowed only as long as the vehicle speed is equal or less than 20 km/h or the distance to the following vehicle is equal or less than 20 m; an intensity decrease already activated may remain active as long as the vehicle speed is equal or less than 50 km/h.
quote: a decrease of the luminous intensity, in the limits prescribed in the pertinent UN Regulations, is allowed as long as the vehicle speed is equal or less than 20 km/h
condition: Variable luminous intensity control (R2/S2) responding to traffic conditions
test_case: Test intensity reduction activation versus vehicle speed and following distance; pass if only activated at ≤20 km/h or ≤20 m and deactivated above 50 km/h.

text: For lamps with variable luminous intensity, no sharp variation of intensity shall be observed during transition.
quote: No sharp variation of intensity shall be observed during transition.
condition: Variable luminous intensity control (R2/S2)
test_case: Record luminous intensity during transitions and verify no abrupt step changes.

text: For M category vehicles, when the electrical system of the vehicle is in a constant voltage operating condition, the voltage supplied at the terminals of devices which, according to their type approval documentation, have been tested by the application of a special power supply/electronic light source control gear, or in a secondary operating mode or at a voltage requested by the applicant, shall not exceed the voltage specified for the relevant devices or functions as they have been approved.
quote: shall not exceed the voltage specified for the relevant devices or functions as they have been approved
condition: Device tested with special power supply or at an applicant-requested voltage and not exempted by paragraph 5.27.3 (no electronic light source control gear, no integral variable intensity control, not only R128 light sources)
test_case: Measure terminal voltage on the vehicle in constant voltage condition and compare with the approved voltage.

text: For M category vehicles, in all cases of electric power supply conditions not covered by paragraph 5.27.1., the voltage at the terminals of the device(s) or function(s) shall not exceed 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V (24 Volt-Systems) by more than 3 per cent, unless the device includes an electronic light source control gear, a variable intensity control being part of the device, or only light source(s) approved according to UN Regulation No. 128.
quote: the voltage at the terminals of the device(s) or function(s) shall not exceed 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V
condition: Device not exempted by paragraph 5.27.3 (no electronic light source control gear, no integral variable intensity control, not only R128 light sources)
test_case: Measure terminal voltage on the vehicle; pass if ≤ nominal value +3%.

text: There shall be no obstacle on the inside of the angles of geometric visibility to the propagation of light from any part of the apparent surface of the lamp observed from infinity; no account is taken of obstacles already presented when the lamp was type-approved.
quote: There shall be no obstacle on the inside of the angles of geometric visibility to the propagation of light from any part of the apparent surface
test_case: Check on the installed vehicle that no vehicle part obstructs the apparent surface within the required angles of geometric visibility.

text: If measurements of geometric visibility are taken closer to the lamp, the direction of observation shall be shifted parallel to achieve the same accuracy.
quote: If measurements are taken closer to the lamp, the direction of observation shall be shifted parallel to achieve the same accuracy.
test_case: Verify the measurement method uses parallel-shifted observation directions when measuring close to the lamp.

text: If, when the lamp is installed, any part of the apparent surface of the lamp is hidden by any further parts of the vehicle, proof shall be furnished that the part of the lamp not hidden by obstacles still conforms to the photometric values prescribed for the approval of the device.
quote: proof shall be furnished that the part of the lamp not hidden by obstacles still conforms to the photometric values prescribed
test_case: Photometrically measure the lamp with the obscuring parts in place; pass if prescribed values are still met.

text: In the case of an interdependent lamp system the geometric visibility requirements shall be fulfilled when all its interdependent lamps are operated together.
quote: In the case of an interdependent lamp system the geometric visibility requirements shall be fulfilled when all its interdependent lamps are operated together.
condition: Any function is realised as an interdependent lamp system (e.g. split between body and tailgate)
test_case: Operate all interdependent lamps together and verify the geometric visibility angles.

text: A LED module of the lamp need not be replaceable only if so stated in the communication sheet of the component type approval.
quote: A LED module does not need to be replaceable, if so stated in the communication sheet of the component type approval.
condition: Lamp uses non-replaceable LED module(s)
test_case: Check the device approval communication sheet states the LED module is non-replaceable.

text: The rear position lamps, stop lamps, reversing lamps and rear retro-reflectors shall, where applicable, be type approved according to the corresponding device Regulations as specified in the relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 6 of this Regulation when installed on a vehicle.
quote: All lamps (devices) shall, where applicable, be type approved according to the corresponding device Regulations as specified in the relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 6
test_case: Verify each function bears a valid approval mark under the device regulation (R148/R150) specified in paragraph 6.

text: In case of light-signalling lamps incorporating a manufacturer logo, the lamp shall be type approved according to the requirements of the UN Regulation No. 148.
quote: in case of light-signalling lamps incorporating a manufacturer logo, the lamp shall be type approved according to the requirements of the UN Regulation No. 148
condition: Lamp incorporates a manufacturer logo
test_case: Verify R148 approval covering the lamp with logo.

text: Lamps installed on the vehicle and approved for one or more replaceable light source categories according to Regulations Nos. 37, 99 or 128 shall be fitted with light sources approved according to these light source categories only; this does not concern light source modules, LED modules and non-replaceable light sources, except when they are required to be approved by the applicable Regulation.
quote: shall be fitted with light sources approved according to these light source categories only
condition: Lamp approved for replaceable light source categories under R37, R99 or R128
test_case: Inspect fitted light sources and confirm they carry approval for the categories stated in the lamp approval.

text: Lamps equipped with LED substitute light source(s) shall be used only where the statement indicated in paragraph 3.2.8. is present and positive, and the presence of the marking on the lamps related to the use of LED substitute light source(s) shall be checked.
quote: The use of lamps approved for and equipped with LED substitute light source(s), is allowed exclusively in the case where the statement indicated in paragraph 3.2.8. is present and positive.
condition: Lamp approved for and equipped with LED substitute light source(s)
test_case: Inspect the lamp for the LED substitute light source marking and check the positive statement in the vehicle application.

text: The reversing lamp shall be present on motor vehicles (mandatory).
quote: Presence Mandatory on motor vehicles and on trailers of categories O2, O3 and O4.
test_case: Inspect the M1 vehicle installation and confirm at least one reversing lamp is fitted.

text: On motor vehicles of category M1, one reversing lamp device is mandatory and a second device is optional.
quote: One device mandatory and a second device optional on motor vehicles of category M1 and on all other vehicles with a length not exceeding 6,000 mm.
test_case: Count reversing lamps on the M1 vehicle; pass if one or two devices are fitted.

text: The reversing lamp devices shall be type-approved according to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 23, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
quote: These devices shall be type-approved according to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 23, or to the 00 or subsequent series
test_case: Check the approval mark on the lamp for a valid R23 or R148 reversing lamp approval.

text: In height, the reversing lamp shall be positioned not less than 250 mm and not more than 1,200 mm above the ground.
quote: In height: not less than 250 mm and not more than 1,200 mm above the ground.
test_case: Measure the apparent surface height of the reversing lamp on the unladen vehicle; pass if between 250 mm and 1,200 mm.

text: In length, the reversing lamp shall be positioned at the rear of the vehicle.
quote: In length: at the rear of the vehicle
test_case: Inspect the installation and confirm the reversing lamp is located at the rear of the vehicle.

text: For a reversing lamp installed at the rear of the vehicle, the geometric visibility defined by angles α and β as specified in paragraph 2.10.7. shall be α = 15° upwards and 5° downwards, and β = 45° to right and to left if there is only one device.
quote: α = 15° upwards and 5° downwards, β = 45° to right and to left if there is only one device
condition: Only one reversing lamp is fitted on the vehicle
test_case: Verify the apparent surface is visible over 15° up, 5° down and 45° left and right.

text: For reversing lamps installed at the rear of the vehicle, the geometric visibility defined by angles α and β as specified in paragraph 2.10.7. shall be α = 15° upwards and 5° downwards, and β = 45° outwards and 30° inwards if there are two devices.
quote: α = 15° upwards and 5° downwards, β = 45° to right and to left if there is only one device, 45° outwards and 30° inwards if there are two.
condition: Two reversing lamps are fitted on the vehicle
test_case: Verify each lamp's apparent surface is visible over 15° up, 5° down, 45° outwards and 30° inwards.

text: The reversing lamp shall be oriented rearwards.
quote: Orientation Rearwards
test_case: Inspect the installed lamp and confirm its reference axis points rearwards.

text: The electrical connections of the reversing lamp shall be such that the lamp can be switched ON only if the reverse gear is engaged and if the device which controls the starting and stopping of the propulsion system is in such a position that operation of the propulsion system is possible.
quote: They shall be such that the lamp can be switched ON only if the reverse gear is engaged and if the device which controls the starting
test_case: Functional test: lamp lights only with reverse engaged and propulsion system operable.

text: The reversing lamp shall not switch ON or remain ON if either the reverse gear is not engaged or the device which controls the starting and stopping of the propulsion system is not in a position where operation of the propulsion system is possible.
quote: It shall not switch ON or remain ON if either of the above conditions is not satisfied.
test_case: Disengage reverse or switch off the propulsion system and confirm the lamp switches OFF and cannot be switched ON.

text: A tell-tale indicating failure of the reversing lamp is mandatory if required by the component regulation.
quote: Tell-tale optional, however a tell-tale indicating failure is mandatory if required by the component regulation.
condition: The component regulation (R23/R148) requires a failure tell-tale for the reversing lamp design (e.g. electronic light source control)
test_case: Check component approval; if failure indication is required, simulate failure and confirm the tell-tale activates.

text: Stop lamp devices of S1 or S2 categories shall be mandatory on all categories of vehicles, including M1 vehicles.
quote: Devices of S1 or S2 categories: mandatory on all categories of vehicles.
test_case: Inspect the M1 vehicle installation and confirm that S1 or S2 category stop lamps are fitted.

text: Two S1 or S2 category stop lamp devices shall be installed on all categories of vehicles.
quote: Number Two S1 or S2 category devices and one S3 or S4 category device on all categories of vehicles.
test_case: Count the S1/S2 stop lamps fitted to the vehicle and check that there are exactly two, one in each rear lamp.

text: The stop lamp devices shall be type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
quote: The devices shall be type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series
test_case: Check the approval mark on the lamp and its approval certificate, and confirm an S1/S2 approval under R7 02+ or R148 00+.

text: For M1 and N1 category vehicles, for S1 or S2 categories devices (stop lamps), that point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
quote: For S1 or S2 categories devices that point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm
test_case: Measure on the vehicle the lateral distance from the outermost point of the stop lamp apparent surface to the vehicle outer edge; pass if ≤ 400 mm.

text: For S1 or S2 categories devices (stop lamps), the mounting height above the ground shall be not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and if the optional lamps are not installed).
quote: For S1 or S2 categories devices: Above the ground, not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork
test_case: Measure the height of the stop lamp apparent surface above ground per paragraph 5.8.1; pass if between 350 mm and 1,500 mm (or 2,100 mm where justified).

text: For S1 or S2 categories devices (stop lamps), the position in length shall be at the rear of the vehicle.
quote: For S1 or S2 categories devices: at the rear of the vehicle.
test_case: Inspect the installed stop lamp; pass if it is located at the rear of the vehicle.

text: For S1 or S2 categories devices (stop lamps), the horizontal angle of geometric visibility shall be 45° to the left and to the right of the longitudinal axis of the vehicle.
quote: Horizontal angle: For S1 or S2 categories devices: 45° to the left and to the right of the longitudinal axis of the vehicle.
test_case: Verify on the vehicle that the stop lamp apparent surface is visible over 45° left and right of the longitudinal axis; pass if unobstructed over the full range.

text: For stop lamps of categories S1 and S2 mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the inward horizontal angle of 45° may be reduced to no less than 20° under the H plane.
quote: for the stop lamps of categories S1 and S2 mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane
condition: Stop lamp mounted below 750 mm
test_case: Measure mounting height; if below 750 mm, verify inward visibility of at least 20° under the H plane.

text: For S1 or S2 categories devices (stop lamps), the vertical angle of geometric visibility shall be 15° above and below the horizontal.
quote: Vertical angle: For S1 or S2 categories devices: 15° above and below the horizontal.
test_case: Verify on the vehicle that the stop lamp apparent surface is visible over 15° above and below the horizontal.

text: For S1 or S2 categories stop lamps mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward vertical angle of 15° may be reduced to no less than 5°.
quote: Where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°
condition: Stop lamp mounted below 750 mm
test_case: Measure mounting height; if below 750 mm, verify downward visibility of at least 5°.

text: The stop lamps shall be oriented towards the rear of the vehicle.
quote: Orientation Towards the rear of the vehicle.
test_case: Inspect installation; pass if stop lamp reference axis points rearwards.

text: All stop lamps shall be switched ON simultaneously when the braking system provides the relevant signal defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H.
quote: All stop lamps shall be switched ON simultaneously when the braking system provides the relevant signal defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H.
test_case: Apply the braking signal on the vehicle; pass if all stop lamps switch ON simultaneously.

text: The stop lamps need not function only if the device which starts and/or stops the propulsion system is in a position that makes it impossible for the propulsion system to operate.
quote: The stop lamps need not function if the device, which starts and/or stops the propulsion system, is in a position that makes it impossible
test_case: Check stop lamp operation with propulsion system enabled; pass if functioning whenever propulsion can operate.

text: For the stop lamps, a tell-tale indicating failure is mandatory if required by the component regulation.
quote: Tell-tale optional, however a tell-tale indicating failure is mandatory if required by the component regulation.
condition: Component regulation requires failure tell-tale for the stop lamp
test_case: Simulate stop lamp failure; if required by the component regulation, verify the failure tell-tale activates.

text: The presence of rear position lamps of R or R1 or R2 categories is mandatory.
quote: Presence Devices of R or R1 or R2 categories: Mandatory
test_case: Inspect vehicle; pass if rear position lamps of category R, R1 or R2 are fitted.

text: The number of rear position lamps shall be two, type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
quote: Number Two, type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series
test_case: Check vehicle fitment and approval markings; pass if two rear position lamps approved to R7 (02+) or R148 (00+).

text: For the rear position lamps, that point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
quote: that point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm
test_case: Measure lateral distance from outermost point of rear position lamp apparent surface to vehicle outer edge; pass if ≤ 400 mm.

text: The rear position lamps shall be mounted above the ground not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and if the optional lamps are not installed).
quote: In height: above the ground, not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible
test_case: Measure height of rear position lamp apparent surface per paragraph 5.8.1; pass if within 350–1,500 mm (or 2,100 mm where justified).

text: The rear position lamps shall be positioned in length at the rear of the vehicle.
quote: In length: The rear of the vehicle.
test_case: Inspect installation; pass if rear position lamps are at the rear of the vehicle.

text: The rear position lamps shall have a horizontal angle of geometric visibility of 45° inwards and 80° outwards.
quote: Horizontal angle: 45° inwards and 80° outwards.
test_case: Verify on vehicle that the rear position lamp apparent surface is visible from 45° inwards to 80° outwards.

text: Where a rear position lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the inward horizontal angle of 45° may be reduced to no less than 20° under the H plane.
quote: where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane
condition: Rear position lamp mounted below 750 mm
test_case: If mounting height below 750 mm, verify inward visibility of at least 20° under the H plane.

text: The rear position lamps shall have a vertical angle of geometric visibility of 15° above and below the horizontal.
quote: Vertical angle: 15° above and below the horizontal.
test_case: Verify visibility of the rear position lamp apparent surface over 15° above and below horizontal.

text: Where a rear position lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward vertical angle of 15° may be reduced to no less than 5°.
quote: Where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°
condition: Rear position lamp mounted below 750 mm
test_case: If mounting height below 750 mm, verify downward visibility of at least 5°.

text: For M1 and N1 category vehicles, as an alternative to paragraph 6.10.5.1., at the discretion of the manufacturer and only if a rear side-marker lamp is installed on the vehicle, the rear position lamps shall have a horizontal angle of 45° outwards to 45° inwards (inward angle reducible to 20° under the H plane where the lamp is mounted below 750 mm).
quote: only if a rear side-marker lamp is installed on the vehicle, Horizontal angle: 45° outwards to 45° inwards.
condition: Manufacturer elects alternative visibility and a rear side-marker lamp is installed
test_case: Confirm rear side-marker lamp fitted; verify visibility from 45° outwards to 45° inwards.

text: For M1 and N1 category vehicles, under the alternative of paragraph 6.10.5.2., the rear position lamps shall have a vertical angle of 15° above and below the horizontal (downward angle reducible to 5° where the lamp is mounted below 750 mm).
quote: Vertical angle: 15° above and below the horizontal. However, where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm
condition: Manufacturer elects alternative visibility and a rear side-marker lamp is installed
test_case: Verify visibility over 15° above and below horizontal (5° downward if below 750 mm).

text: Under the alternative of paragraph 6.10.5.2., to be considered visible, the rear position lamp shall provide an unobstructed view of the apparent surface of at least 12.5 square centimetres, excluding the illuminating surface area of any retro-reflector that does not transmit light.
quote: To be considered visible, the lamp shall provide an unobstructed view of the apparent surface of at least 12.5 square centimetres.
condition: Manufacturer elects alternative visibility and a rear side-marker lamp is installed
test_case: Measure unobstructed apparent surface at the boundary angles excluding non-transmitting retro-reflector area; pass if ≥ 12.5 cm².

text: The rear position lamps shall be oriented rearwards.
quote: Orientation Rearwards.
test_case: Inspect installation; pass if reference axis points rearwards.

text: The electrical connections of the rear position lamps shall be in accordance with paragraph 5.11.
quote: Electrical connections In accordance with paragraph 5.11.
test_case: Check wiring/switching of rear position lamps against paragraph 5.11 on the vehicle.

text: For the front and rear position lamps, a closed-circuit non-flashing tell-tale is mandatory, not required if the instrument panel lighting can only switch ON simultaneously with the position lamps; a tell-tale indicating failure is mandatory if required by the component regulation.
quote: Tell-tale Closed-circuit tell-tale mandatory. This tell-tale shall be non-flashing and shall not be required if the instrument panel lighting
test_case: Switch on position lamps; verify a non-flashing closed-circuit tell-tale activates unless instrument panel lighting is coupled.

text: For the rear position lamps, a closed-circuit tell-tale is mandatory; this requirement does not apply when daytime running lamps are switched ON.
quote: Tell-tale. Closed-circuit tell-tale mandatory. It shall be combined with that of the front position lamps.
test_case: Inspect the vehicle with rear position lamps ON (DRL OFF) and verify a closed-circuit tell-tale is lit.

text: The closed-circuit tell-tale of the rear position lamps shall be combined with that of the front position lamps; this requirement does not apply when daytime running lamps are switched ON.
quote: It shall be combined with that of the front position lamps. This requirement does not apply when daytime running lamps are switched ON.
test_case: Switch on position lamps and verify a single shared tell-tale indicates both front and rear position lamps.

text: For the rear position lamps, a tell-tale indicating failure is mandatory if required by the component Regulation.
quote: However, a tell-tale indicating failure is mandatory if required by the component Regulation.
condition: Failure tell-tale required by the component Regulation (UN R148) for this rear position lamp.
test_case: Simulate rear position lamp failure and verify the failure tell-tale activates where the component Regulation requires it.

text: If a rear fog lamp is fitted, the distance between the rear fog-lamp and each stop-lamp shall be greater than 100 mm.
quote: In all cases, the distance between the rear fog-lamp and each stop-lamp shall be greater than 100 mm.
condition: A rear fog lamp is fitted on the vehicle (not integrated in this product per specification).
test_case: Measure the distance between the rear fog lamp and each stop lamp on the vehicle; pass if greater than 100 mm.

text: The rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, is mandatory on motor vehicles.
quote: Presence Mandatory on motor vehicles.
test_case: Verify the M1 vehicle is fitted with non-triangular rear retro-reflectors.

text: The number of rear retro-reflectors, non-triangular, shall be two, type-approved according to the requirements concerning Class IA or IB retro-reflectors in the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 3, or in the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 150.
quote: Two, type-approved according to the requirements concerning Class IA or IB retro-reflectors in the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 3
test_case: Check that two rear retro-reflectors are fitted and carry Class IA or IB approval marks under R3 (02+) or R150 (00+).

text: Additional retro-reflecting devices and materials (including two retro-reflectors not complying with paragraph 6.14.4.) are permitted only provided they do not impair the effectiveness of the mandatory lighting and light-signalling devices.
quote: Additional retro-reflecting devices and materials (including two retro-reflectors not complying with paragraph 6.14.4. below), are permitted provided they do not impair the effectiveness
condition: Additional retro-reflecting devices or materials are fitted.
test_case: Inspect any additional retro-reflecting devices and verify they do not impair the mandatory lighting and light-signalling devices.

text: In width, that point on the illuminating surface of the rear retro-reflector which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
quote: that point on the illuminating surface which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge
test_case: Measure the lateral distance from the outermost point of the illuminating surface to the vehicle's extreme outer edge; pass if ≤ 400 mm.

text: In height, the rear retro-reflector shall be above the ground not less than 250 mm nor more than 900 mm (not more than 1,200 mm if grouped with any rear lamp(s), 1,500 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 900 mm or 1,200 mm respectively).
quote: Above the ground, not less than 250 mm nor more than 900 mm (not more than 1,200 mm if grouped with any rear lamp(s)
test_case: Measure the mounting height of the retro-reflector above ground; pass if 250-900 mm (or ≤1,200 mm if grouped with rear lamps, ≤1,500 mm if bodywork prevents).

text: In length, the rear retro-reflector shall be at the rear of the vehicle.
quote: In length: at the rear of the vehicle.
test_case: Inspect the vehicle and verify the retro-reflector is located at the rear.

text: The geometric visibility of the rear retro-reflector shall be defined by a horizontal angle of 30° inwards and outwards.
quote: Geometric visibility Horizontal angle: 30° inwards and outwards.
test_case: Verify the illuminating surface is unobstructed over 30° inwards and outwards horizontally.

text: The geometric visibility of the rear retro-reflector shall be defined by a vertical angle of 10° above and below horizontal; where the retro-reflector is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward angle of 10° may be reduced to 5°.
quote: Vertical angle: 10° above and below horizontal. However, where a retro-reflector is mounted below 750 mm
test_case: Verify visibility over 10° up and 10° down (5° down if mounted below 750 mm).

text: The orientation of the rear retro-reflector shall be rearwards.
quote: Orientation Rearwards.
test_case: Inspect the installed retro-reflector and verify its reference axis faces rearwards.

text: Triangular rear retro-reflectors are prohibited on motor vehicles; the rear retro-reflector of this lamp for M1 vehicles shall not be triangular.
quote: Presence Mandatory on trailers. Prohibited on motor vehicles.
test_case: Inspect the retro-reflector shape and verify it is not triangular.

text: When daytime running lamps are switched ON, the rear position lamps shall be switched ON.
quote: When daytime running lamps are switched ON, the rear position lamps shall be switched ON.
test_case: On the vehicle, activate the daytime running lamps and verify that the rear position lamps are switched ON simultaneously.

text: The rear position lamps may be switched OFF when the daytime running lamps are switched ON only as long as the ambient light conditions outside the vehicle are above 7,000 lux (measured according to the requirements of Annex 13).
quote: may remain switched OFF as long as the ambient light conditions outside vehicle are above 7,000 lux (measured according to the requirements of Annex 13).
condition: Vehicle implements switching OFF of the rear position lamps while the daytime running lamps are ON
test_case: With DRL ON, vary the ambient light per Annex 13 and verify that the rear position lamps are OFF only above 7,000 lux and switch ON at or below it.

text: When the rearmost side-marker lamp is combined with the rear position lamp reciprocally incorporated with the stop lamp, the photometric characteristics of the side-marker lamp may be modified only during the entire time the stop lamp is switched ON.
quote: When the rearmost side-marker lamp is combined with the rear position lamp reciprocally incorporated with the rear fog-lamp or stop lamp
condition: A side-marker lamp is combined with the rear position lamp and the rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with the stop lamp
test_case: Measure the side-marker photometry with the stop lamp OFF and ON and verify that any modification occurs only while the stop lamp is ON.

text: On motor vehicles (M1), the emergency stop signal is mandatory and, where given by the stop lamps, shall be given by the simultaneous operation of all the stop lamps fitted as described in paragraph 6.23.7.
quote: The emergency stop signal shall be given by the simultaneous operation of all the stop or direction-indicator lamps fitted as described in paragraph 6.23.7.
condition: Emergency stop signal on the vehicle is implemented via the stop lamps rather than the direction-indicator lamps
test_case: Trigger the emergency braking logic signal on the vehicle and verify that all fitted stop lamps operate simultaneously.

text: When the emergency stop signal is given by the stop lamps, the number of lamps of the emergency stop signal shall be as specified in paragraph 6.7.2.
quote: Number As specified in paragraph 6.5.2. or 6.7.2.
condition: Emergency stop signal implemented via the stop lamps
test_case: Count the stop lamps used for the emergency stop signal and verify against paragraph 6.7.2.

text: When the emergency stop signal is given by the stop lamps, the arrangement of the lamps of the emergency stop signal shall be as specified in paragraph 6.7.3.
quote: Arrangement As specified in paragraph 6.5.3. or 6.7.3.
condition: Emergency stop signal implemented via the stop lamps
test_case: Inspect the stop lamp arrangement on the vehicle and verify against paragraph 6.7.3.

text: When the emergency stop signal is given by the stop lamps, the position of the lamps of the emergency stop signal shall be as specified in paragraph 6.7.4.
quote: Position As specified in paragraph 6.5.4. or 6.7.4.
condition: Emergency stop signal implemented via the stop lamps
test_case: Measure stop lamp width, height and length position on the vehicle and verify against paragraph 6.7.4.

text: When the emergency stop signal is given by the stop lamps, the geometric visibility of the lamps of the emergency stop signal shall be as specified in paragraph 6.7.5.
quote: Geometric visibility As specified in paragraph 6.5.5. or 6.7.5.
condition: Emergency stop signal implemented via the stop lamps
test_case: Verify the stop lamp geometric visibility angles on the vehicle against paragraph 6.7.5.

text: When the emergency stop signal is given by the stop lamps, the orientation of the lamps of the emergency stop signal shall be as specified in paragraph 6.7.6.
quote: Orientation As specified in paragraph 6.5.6. or 6.7.6.
condition: Emergency stop signal implemented via the stop lamps
test_case: Check the stop lamp orientation on the vehicle against paragraph 6.7.6.

text: All the lamps of the emergency stop signal shall flash in phase at a frequency of 4.0 ± 1.0 Hz.
quote: All the lamps of the emergency stop signal shall flash in phase at a frequency of 4.0 ± 1.0 Hz.
condition: Emergency stop signal implemented via the stop lamps
test_case: Activate the emergency stop signal and measure the flashing frequency and phase of all lamps; pass if in phase and within 3.0 to 5.0 Hz.

text: If any of the lamps of the emergency stop signal to the rear of the vehicle use filament light sources, the frequency of the emergency stop signal shall be 4.0 +0.0/-1.0 Hz.
quote: if any of the lamps of the emergency stop signal to the rear of the vehicle use filament light sources the frequency shall be 4.0 +0.0/-1.0 Hz.
condition: Any rear emergency stop signal lamp uses filament light sources (product stated as LED)
test_case: Where filament light sources are used, measure the flashing frequency; pass if between 3.0 and 4.0 Hz.

text: The emergency stop signal shall operate independently of other lamps.
quote: The emergency stop signal shall operate independently of other lamps.
condition: Emergency stop signal implemented via the stop lamps
test_case: Activate the emergency stop signal with other lamps in various states and verify its operation is unaffected.

text: The emergency stop signal shall be switched ON and OFF automatically.
quote: The emergency stop signal shall be switched ON and OFF automatically.
condition: Emergency stop signal implemented via the stop lamps
test_case: Verify by vehicle test that the emergency stop signal activates and deactivates without manual control.

text: The emergency stop signal shall be switched ON only when the vehicle speed is above 50 km/h and the braking system is providing the emergency braking logic signal defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H.
quote: The emergency stop signal shall be switched ON only when the vehicle speed is above 50 km/h and the braking system is providing the emergency braking logic signal
condition: Emergency stop signal implemented via the stop lamps
test_case: Test emergency braking below and above 50 km/h; pass if the signal activates only above 50 km/h with the emergency braking logic signal present.

text: The emergency stop signal shall be automatically switched OFF if the emergency braking logic signal as defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H is no longer provided or if the hazard warning signal is activated.
quote: The emergency stop signal shall be automatically switched OFF if the emergency braking logic signal as defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H is no longer provided
condition: Emergency stop signal implemented via the stop lamps
test_case: Remove the emergency braking logic signal and separately activate the hazard warning signal; pass if the emergency stop signal switches OFF in both cases.

text: If the motor vehicle is equipped to tow a trailer, the control of the emergency stop signal on the motor vehicle shall also be capable of operating the emergency stop signal on the trailer, and when electrically connected to a trailer the operating frequency for the combination shall be limited to the frequency specified in paragraph 6.23.7.1.1, unless the motor vehicle can detect that filament light sources are not used on the trailer.
quote: if a motor vehicle is equipped to tow a trailer, the control of the emergency stop signal on the motor vehicle shall also be capable of operating the emergency stop signal on the trailer.
condition: Vehicle is equipped to tow a trailer
test_case: Connect a trailer and verify the trailer emergency stop signal operates at the frequency of paragraph 6.23.7.1.1.

text: If the motor vehicle is equipped to tow a trailer fitted with a continuous or semi-continuous service braking system, a constant power supply shall be provided via the electrical connector for the stop lamps to such trailers while the service brake is applied.
quote: it shall be ensured that a constant power supply is provided via the electrical connector for the stop lamps to such trailers while the service brake is applied.
condition: Vehicle is equipped to tow a trailer with continuous or semi-continuous braking
test_case: Apply the service brake with such a trailer connected and verify constant power at the stop lamp connector pin.

text: Reversing lamps shall not be switched ON as exterior courtesy lamps; only approved lamps emitting white light other than main beam headlamps, daytime running lamps and reversing lamps, and rear position lamps, may be switched ON as exterior courtesy lamps.
quote: Approved lamps emitting white light with the exception of main beam head lamps, daytime running lamps and reversing lamps may be switched ON as exterior courtesy lamp(s).
condition: Vehicle uses exterior courtesy lighting functions
test_case: Activate the exterior courtesy lighting and verify the reversing lamp does not switch ON.

text: If the rear position lamps are switched ON as exterior courtesy lamps, they shall not be switched ON unless the vehicle is stationary and the propulsion system is stopped, or a driver or passenger door or a load compartment door is opened or after being closed, and they shall be switched OFF when the vehicle is no longer stationary.
quote: The exterior courtesy lamp(s) shall not be switched ON unless the vehicle is stationary and one or more of the following conditions is satisfied
condition: Rear position lamps are used as exterior courtesy lamps
test_case: Verify courtesy activation only when stationary under the listed conditions and deactivation once the vehicle moves.

text: If the rear position lamps are switched ON as exterior courtesy lamps, they shall not flash.
quote: The exterior courtesy lamp(s) shall not flash.
condition: Rear position lamps are used as exterior courtesy lamps
test_case: Observe the rear position lamps in courtesy mode and verify steady burning without flashing.

text: If the lamps of the rear combination lamp (rear position lamp or reversing lamp) are used for the answer-back signal, the answer-back signal shall only operate under the park condition of a vehicle.
quote: The answer-back signal shall only operate under the park condition of a vehicle.
condition: Rear position lamp or reversing lamp of the product is used to provide an answer-back signal
test_case: Activate the answer-back signal with the vehicle parked and not parked; verify it operates only in the park condition.

text: If the lamps of the rear combination lamp used for the answer-back signal flash, the frequency shall not exceed 2.0 Hz.
quote: If the answer-back signal flashes, the frequency shall not exceed 2.0 Hz.
condition: Lamp of the product is used for a flashing answer-back signal
test_case: Measure the flash frequency of the answer-back signal; verify it is not more than 2.0 Hz.

text: If the lamps of the rear combination lamp are used for the answer-back signal, the answer-back signal shall be provided by approved lighting and light-signalling devices where the maximum luminous intensity per lamp does not exceed 700 cd on or above the HH line.
quote: the maximum luminous intensity per lamp does not exceed 700 cd on or above the HH line
condition: Lamp of the product is used to provide an answer-back signal
test_case: Check approval of the lamp and measure intensity in answer-back mode on or above HH; verify not more than 700 cd.

text: The stop lamp of the rear combination lamp shall not be used to provide the answer-back signal.
quote: However, front fog lamps, rear fog lamps and stop lamps are not permitted to be used.
condition: Vehicle provides an answer-back signal
test_case: Activate the answer-back signal and verify the stop lamp does not illuminate as part of it.

text: If the lamps of the rear combination lamp are used for the answer-back signal, the answer-back signal may only be activated automatically in conjunction with the locking and unlocking of the door(s) and/or the detection of the vehicle user in proximity to the vehicle.
quote: The answer-back signal may only be activated automatically in conjunction with the locking and unlocking of the door(s)
condition: Lamp of the product is used to provide an answer-back signal
test_case: Verify by functional test that the answer-back signal activates only on locking/unlocking or user-proximity detection.

text: If the lamps of the rear combination lamp are used for the answer-back signal, the duration of the optical indication of the answer-back signal shall not exceed 3 seconds, irrespective of whether it contains flashes, variations of intensity or variations in apparent surface.
quote: The duration of the optical indication of the answer-back signal shall not exceed 3 seconds.
condition: Lamp of the product is used to provide an answer-back signal
test_case: Time the answer-back signal from beginning to end; verify it is not more than 3 s.

text: If reversing projections are provided on the vehicle, the reversing projections shall be switched ON only when the reversing lamp(s) is/are switched ON.
quote: If provided, the reversing projections shall be switched ON only when the reversing lamp(s) is/are switched ON.
condition: Vehicle is fitted with reversing projectors in addition to the product's reversing lamp
test_case: Operate the reversing projection with reversing lamp ON and OFF; verify projection only ON when reversing lamp is ON.

text: For the verification of the visibility of a red lamp to the front (paragraph 5.10.4.), zone 1 explored by the eye of the observer shall be bounded in height by two horizontal planes 1 m and 2.2 m respectively above the ground, and in width by two vertical planes which, forming to the front an angle of 15° outwards from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane, pass through the point or points of contact of vertical planes parallel to the vehicle's median longitudinal plane delimiting the vehicle's overall width; if there are several points of contact, the foremost shall correspond to the forward plane.
quote: In height, by two horizontal planes 1 m and 2.2 m respectively above the ground
test_case: With the lamp installed on the vehicle, observe from zone 1 (1 m to 2.2 m height, 15° outward planes to the front) and confirm that no red light from the rear position lamp, stop lamp or retro-reflector is directly visible.

text: For the verification of the visibility of a white lamp to the rear (paragraph 5.10.4.), zone 2 explored by the eye of the observer shall be bounded in height by two horizontal planes 1 m and 2.2 m respectively above the ground, and in width by two vertical planes which, forming to the rear an angle of 15° outwards from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane, pass through the point or points of contact of vertical planes parallel to the vehicle's median longitudinal plane delimiting the vehicle's overall width; if there are several points of contact, the rearmost shall correspond to the rearward plane.
quote: if there are several points of contact, the foremost shall correspond to the forward plane and the rearmost to the rearward plane
test_case: With the lamp installed on the vehicle, observe from zone 2 (1 m to 2.2 m height, 15° outward planes to the rear) and check the white-light visibility against paragraph 5.10.4., taking into account the reversing lamp exemption.

text: In the case of reciprocally incorporated functions where the non-textured outer lens is excluded and "7b" is the apparent surface according to paragraph 2.10.2., function F1 shall not be transparent to function F2.
quote: "7b" is the apparent surface according to paragraph 2.10.2. and F1 shall not be transparent to F2
condition: Rear position and stop lamps are reciprocally incorporated with the arrangement shown in the Annex 3 Part 7 example
test_case: Inspect the optical design of the reciprocally incorporated functions and confirm that the F1 optic is not transparent to light of F2.

text: The position of the rear position lamps, stop lamps, reversing lamps and rear retro-reflectors, as defined in paragraph 2.1.6., in width, in height and in length shall be checked in accordance with the general requirements set out in paragraphs 2.10.2., 2.10.3., 2.10.4., 2.3.3. and 5.4. of this Regulation.
quote: The position of lamps, as defined in paragraph 2.1.6. of this Regulation, in width, in height and in length shall be checked
test_case: Measure lamp position in width, height and length on the vehicle per paragraphs 2.10.2.-2.10.4., 2.3.3. and 5.4.; pass if measurements are recorded per those definitions.

text: The values measured for the distances of the rear position lamps, stop lamps, reversing lamps and rear retro-reflectors shall be such that the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled.
quote: The values measured for the distances shall be such that the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled.
test_case: Compare measured distances with the individual position specifications for each function; pass if all are within limits.

text: The angles of geometric visibility of the rear position lamps, stop lamps, reversing lamps and rear retro-reflectors shall be checked in accordance with paragraph 2.10.7. of this Regulation.
quote: The angles of geometric visibility shall be checked in accordance with paragraph 2.10.7. of this Regulation.
test_case: Check geometric visibility angles of each function on the vehicle per paragraph 2.10.7.; pass if check is performed per that method.

text: The values measured for the angles of geometric visibility shall be such that the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled, except that the limits of the angles may have an allowance corresponding to the ±3° variation permitted in paragraph 5.3. for the mounting of the light-signalling devices.
quote: The values measured for the angles shall be such that the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled except that the limits
test_case: Compare measured visibility angles with each lamp's individual specification allowing ±3°; pass if all angles are met.

text: The visibility of red light towards the front and of white light towards the rear (including from the reversing lamp) shall be checked in accordance with paragraph 5.10. of this Regulation.
quote: The visibility of red light towards the front and of white light towards the rear shall be checked in accordance with paragraph 5.10.
test_case: Inspect the vehicle per paragraph 5.10.; pass if no red light is visible from the front and white light to the rear only as permitted (reversing lamp).

text: The electrical connections of the rear position lamps, stop lamps and reversing lamps shall be checked by switching on every lamp supplied by the electrical system of the vehicle.
quote: The electrical connections shall be checked by switching on every lamp supplied by the electrical system of the vehicle.
test_case: Switch on each lamp function via the vehicle electrical system; pass if each function activates as intended.

text: The rear position lamps, stop lamps, reversing lamps and associated tell-tales shall function in accordance with the provisions set out in paragraphs 5.11. to 5.14. of this Regulation and with the individual specifications applicable to each lamp.
quote: The lamps and tell-tales shall function in accordance with the provisions set out in paragraphs 5.11. to 5.14. of this Regulation
test_case: Operate lamps and tell-tales and verify against paragraphs 5.11.-5.14. and individual specifications; pass if all behave as required.

text: The presence, number, colour, arrangement and, where applicable, the category of the rear position lamps, stop lamps, reversing lamps and rear retro-reflectors shall be checked by visual inspection of the lamps and their markings.
quote: The presence, number, colour, arrangement and, where applicable, the category of lamps shall be checked by visual inspection of the lamps and their markings.
test_case: Visually inspect the lamps and their approval markings on the vehicle; pass if presence, number, colour, arrangement and category are recorded.

text: The presence, number, colour, arrangement and, where applicable, the category of the rear position lamps, stop lamps, reversing lamps and rear retro-reflectors shall be such that the requirements set out in paragraphs 5.15. and 5.16. as well as in the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled.
quote: These shall be such that the requirements set out in paragraphs 5.15. and 5.16. as well as in the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled.
test_case: Compare inspection results with paragraphs 5.15., 5.16. and individual specifications; pass if all requirements are met.

text: A separate approval is required for each lamp (rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp) listed in paragraph 1.
quote: A separate approval is required for each lamp listed in paragraph 1.
test_case: Check the approval documentation covers each function (R1/R2, S1/S2, AR) with its own approval.

text: When two or more lamps are part of the same unit of grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, approval may be granted only if each of these lamps satisfy the provisions set out in this Regulation or in another Regulation.
quote: approval may be granted only if each of these lamps satisfy the provisions set out in this Regulation or in another Regulation
test_case: Verify test reports show each function of the combination lamp (position, stop, reversing, retro-reflector) complies with its applicable Regulation.

text: Lamps not satisfying the provisions of any of those Regulations shall not be part of the unit of grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps.
quote: Lamps not satisfying the provisions of any of those Regulations shall not be part of such unit of grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps.
test_case: Review the lamp content list; confirm no function in the housing lacks compliance with an applicable Regulation.

text: In the case of an interdependent lamp system, all the devices of the interdependent lamp system must be submitted for type approval by the same applicant.
quote: All the devices of an interdependent lamp system must be submitted for type approval by the same applicant.
condition: Lamp is part of an interdependent lamp system (e.g. split body/tailgate)
test_case: Check application records show all interdependent lamps submitted by the same applicant.

text: The rear position lamp shall be identified by the symbol R1 (steady) or R2 (variable), the stop lamp by the symbol S1 (steady) or S2 (variable), and the reversing lamp by the symbol AR, as listed in Table 1.
quote: Rear position lamp (steady) R1 5.2. ... Stop lamp (steady) S1 5.5. Stop lamp (variable) S2 5.5.
test_case: Inspect the marking for the correct function symbols R1/R2, S1/S2 and AR matching the approved intensity variant.

text: Every device belonging to an approved type shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the approval marking and other markings as defined in paragraphs 3.3.3.2. to 3.3.3.6.
quote: Every device belonging to an approved type shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the approval marking and other markings
test_case: Inspect drawing and sample for a marking area large enough for all required markings.

text: All markings shall be clearly legible and indelible.
quote: All markings shall be clearly legible and indelible,
test_case: Visually inspect markings and perform rub/durability check; markings remain legible.

text: With regard to the size of the approval marking, the value for "a" shall be at least 5 mm.
quote: With regard to the size of the approval marking the value for “a” shall be at least 5 mm.
test_case: Measure the approval mark dimension a; pass if ≥ 5 mm.

text: The approval marking shall consist of the approval mark, i.e. a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval.
quote: The approval mark, i.e. a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval.
test_case: Inspect the marking for circle with E and country number.

text: The approval marking shall consist of the four to six-digit sequential number, being part of the approval number prescribed in paragraph 3.2.3.2., and this sequential number shall be placed close to the approval mark.
quote: The four to six-digit sequential number, being part of the approval number prescribed in paragraph 3.2.3.2. This sequential number shall be placed close to the approval mark.
test_case: Inspect the marking for a 4-6 digit sequential number adjacent to the E-mark.

text: The approval marking shall consist of the symbols identifying the light signalling lamps prescribed in paragraph 3.2.4.
quote: The symbols identifying the light signalling lamps prescribed in paragraph 3.2.4.
test_case: Inspect the marking for the function symbols of all approved functions.

text: The approval marking shall consist of the number of this Regulation followed by the letter 'R' and the two digits indicating the series of amendments in force at the time of issue of the approval.
quote: The number of this Regulation followed by the letter 'R' and the two digits indicating the series of amendments in force
test_case: Inspect the marking for '148R' followed by the series digits (e.g. 01).

text: On lamps which cannot be mounted on either side of the vehicle indiscriminately, the approval marking shall include a horizontal arrow showing in which position the lamp is to be mounted.
quote: On lamps which cannot be mounted on either side of the vehicle indiscriminately, a horizontal arrow showing in which position the lamp is to be mounted.
condition: Lamp is handed (left/right specific)
test_case: Inspect handed lamp samples for a horizontal arrow in the marking.

text: For rear position lamps which cannot be mounted on either side of the vehicle indiscriminately, the horizontal arrow shall be directed outwards from the vehicle.
quote: The arrow shall be directed outwards from the vehicle in the case of: ... (b) Front or rear position lamps
condition: Lamp is handed (left/right specific)
test_case: Verify arrow points outboard when lamp is in its mounting position.

text: For reversing lamps in case of reduced light distribution of two reversing lamps, the horizontal arrow shall be directed outwards from the vehicle.
quote: The arrow shall be directed outwards from the vehicle in the case of: ... (c) Reversing lamps in case of reduced light distribution of two reversing lamps.
condition: Reversing lamp approved with reduced light distribution of two reversing lamps
test_case: Verify arrow on reversing lamp marking points outboard.

text: If applicable, the additional letter "D" shall be placed to the right side of the symbol mentioned in paragraph 3.2.4. on lamps which may be used as part of an assembly of two independent lamps.
quote: The additional letter "D", on lamps which may be used as part of an assembly of two independent lamps;
condition: Lamp may be used as part of an assembly of two independent lamps
test_case: Inspect marking for 'D' to the right of the function symbol.

text: If applicable, the additional letter "Y" shall be placed to the right side of the symbol mentioned in paragraph 3.2.4. on lamps which are used as part of an interdependent lamps system.
quote: The additional letter "Y", on lamps which are used as part of an interdependent lamps system.
condition: Lamp is part of an interdependent lamp system
test_case: Inspect marking for 'Y' to the right of the function symbol.

text: On lamps with reduced light distribution (see paragraph 1.1. of Annex 3), the approval marking shall include a vertical arrow starting from a horizontal segment and directed downwards.
quote: On lamps with reduced light distribution, see paragraph 1.1. of Annex 3, a vertical arrow starting from a horizontal segment and directed downwards.
condition: Lamp approved with reduced light distribution
test_case: Inspect marking for the downward vertical arrow from a horizontal segment.

text: Lamps shall bear the approval marking.
quote: Lamps shall bear the approval marking.
test_case: Inspect sample for presence of the complete approval marking.

text: Lamps shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
quote: Lamps shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant
test_case: Inspect sample for applicant trade name or mark.

text: Lamps, with the exception of lamps with non-replaceable light sources, shall bear a marking indicating the category or categories of light source(s) prescribed.
quote: Lamps shall, with the exception of lamps with non-replaceable light sources, bear a marking indicating: (a) The category or categories of light source(s) prescribed;
condition: Lamp uses replaceable light sources
test_case: If replaceable light sources are used, inspect for light source category marking.

text: In the case where the lamp has been approved for LED substitute light source(s), the lamp shall also bear a marking indicating the category or categories of the LED substitute light source(s).
quote: in the case where the lamp has been approved for LED substitute light source(s), also the category or categories of the LED substitute light source(s);
condition: Lamp approved for LED substitute light sources
test_case: Inspect for LED substitute light source category marking.

text: Lamps with an electronic light source control gear, and/or a variable luminous intensity control, and/or a secondary operating mode, and/or non-replaceable light sources shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage.
quote: Lamps shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage, in the case of lamps with:
condition: Lamp has electronic control gear, variable intensity control, secondary operating mode or non-replaceable light sources (likely for LED modules)
test_case: Inspect sample for rated voltage or voltage range marking.

text: In case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, the light source module(s) shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
quote: In case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, bear the following markings. (a) On the light source module(s): (i) The trade name or mark of the applicant;
condition: Replaceable light source module(s) used
test_case: Inspect module for applicant trade name or mark.

text: In case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, the light source module(s) shall bear the specific identification code of the module, comprising the starting letters "MD" followed by the approval mark without the circle as prescribed in paragraph 3.3.2.1.1., followed by additional symbols or characters in case several non-identical light source modules are used.
quote: This specific identification code shall comprise the starting letters “MD” for “MODULE” followed by the approval mark without the circle
condition: Replaceable light source module(s) used
test_case: Inspect module for 'MD' code with approval mark without circle.

text: In case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, the approval mark of the module and that on the lamp shall be from the same applicant.
quote: The approval mark does not have to be the same as the one on the lamp in which the module is used, but both marks shall be from the same applicant;
condition: Replaceable light source module(s) used
test_case: Compare module and lamp approval marks; verify same applicant.

text: In case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, the light source module(s) shall bear the rated voltage(s) or the range of voltage.
quote: (iii) The rated voltage(s) or the range of voltage.
condition: Replaceable light source module(s) used
test_case: Inspect module for rated voltage marking.

text: In case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, the lamp shall bear the specific identification code of the module as prescribed in paragraph 3.3.3.5. (a), (ii).
quote: (b) On the lamp: (i) The specific identification code of the module as prescribed in paragraph 3.3.3.5. (a), (ii);
condition: Replaceable light source module(s) used
test_case: Inspect lamp for module identification code.

text: In case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, the lamp shall bear the rated voltage(s) or the range of voltage.
quote: (b) On the lamp: ... (ii) The rated voltage(s) or the range of voltage.
condition: Replaceable light source module(s) used
