test_case: Inspect lamp for rated voltage marking.

text: An electronic light source control gear or variable luminous intensity control being part of the lamp, but not included into the lamp body, shall be marked with its identification number and the name of the manufacturer.
quote: An electronic light source control gear or variable luminous intensity control being part of the lamp, but not included into the lamp body, shall be marked
condition: External electronic control gear or variable intensity control is part of the lamp
test_case: Inspect external control gear for identification number and manufacturer name.

text: The approval marking shall be placed on an inner or outer part (transparent or not) of the lamp which is not designed to be separated from the transparent part of the lamp emitting the light.
quote: The approval marking shall be placed on an inner or outer part (transparent or not) of the lamp which is not designed to be separated
test_case: Verify marking location is on a part not separable from the light-emitting outer lens.

text: The approval marking shall be visible when the lamp is fitted on the vehicle or when a movable part such as the hood or boot lid or a door is opened.
quote: the approval marking ... shall be visible when the lamp is fitted on the vehicle or when a movable part such as the hood or boot lid or a door is opened.
test_case: Check on vehicle (or mock-up) that the marking is visible fitted or with boot lid/door open.

text: The category or categories of LED substitute light source(s) prescribed, if any, shall be visible when the lamp is fitted on the vehicle or when a movable part such as the hood or boot lid or a door is opened.
quote: the category or categories of LED substitute light source(s) prescribed, if any, shall be visible when the lamp is fitted on the vehicle
condition: Lamp approved for LED substitute light sources
test_case: Check visibility of LED substitute category marking on fitted lamp.

text: If the outer lens of the device is designed to be separated from the main body, the approval marking shall be placed on both the detachable lens and the main body.
quote: If the outer lens of a device is designed to be separated from the main body, the approval marking shall be placed on both
condition: Outer lens designed to be separable from the housing
test_case: If lens is detachable, inspect both lens and housing for approval marking.

text: In case an outer lens is used for several devices and bearing different approval markings, the main body of each device shall bear only the approval marking of the function(s) of that device.
quote: the main body of each device shall bear only the approval marking of the function(s) of that device.
condition: Outer lens shared by several devices with different approval markings
test_case: Inspect each device body for only its own function markings.

text: The approval marking and the markings in paragraphs 3.3.3.2., 3.3.3.3., 3.3.3.4., 3.3.3.5. (b) and 3.3.3.6. shall be affixed on the lamp.
quote: The approval marking and the markings in paragraphs 3.3.3.2., 3.3.3.3., 3.3.3.4., 3.3.3.5. (b) and 3.3.3.6. shall be affixed on the lamp.
test_case: Inspect lamp sample for all required markings affixed on the lamp.

text: The markings in paragraphs 3.3.3.5.(a) shall be affixed on the light source module component.
quote: The markings in paragraphs 3.3.3.5.(a) shall be affixed on the component.
condition: Replaceable light source module(s) used
test_case: Inspect module for its required markings.

text: Where a single approval mark is affixed to grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps that comply with several UN Regulations, the marking shall be visible after installation of the lamps.
quote: This marking may be located anywhere on the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, provided that: It is visible after their installation;
condition: A single approval mark is used for the combined rear lamp functions
test_case: Inspect the lamp installed or in its installation position and confirm the single approval mark is visible.

text: Where a single approval mark is affixed to grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, no part of the lamps that transmits light can be removed without at the same time removing the approval mark.
quote: No part of the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps that transmits light can be removed without at the same time removing the approval mark.
condition: A single approval mark is used for the combined rear lamp functions
test_case: Check the mark location (e.g. on the outer lens or housing part carrying the lens) so that removing any light-transmitting part also removes the mark.

text: The size of the components of a single approval mark shall not be less than the minimum size required for the smallest of the individual marks by the pertinent UN Regulations under which approval has been granted.
quote: The size of the components of a single approval mark shall not be less than the minimum size required for the smallest of the individual marks
condition: A single approval mark is used for the combined rear lamp functions
test_case: Measure the mark component dimensions and compare with the minimum sizes required by each applicable Regulation.

text: Each lamp submitted for approval shall conform to the requirements set forth in paragraphs 4. and 5.
quote: Each lamp submitted for approval shall conform to the requirements set forth in paragraphs 4. and 5.
test_case: Verify by test report that the rear position, stop and reversing lamps meet all requirements of paragraphs 4 and 5.

text: The requirements contained in sections 5 "General specifications" and 6 "Individual specifications" (and in the Annexes referenced) of UN Regulation No. 48 and its series of amendments in force at the time of application for the lamp type approval, pertinent to each lamp and to the category of vehicle on which the lamp is intended to be installed (M1), shall be applied where its verification at the moment of lamp type approval is feasible.
quote: The requirements pertinent to each lamp and to the category/ies of vehicle on which the lamp is intended to be installed shall be applied
test_case: Check the R48 sections 5 and 6 requirements verifiable on the device (e.g. geometric visibility, colour) for each function during type approval testing.

text: The lamps must be so designed and constructed that in normal conditions of use, and notwithstanding the vibrations to which they may be subjected in such use, their satisfactory operation remains assured and they retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation.
quote: The lamps must be so designed and constructed that in normal conditions of use, and notwithstanding the vibrations to which they may be subjected
test_case: Perform vibration/durability evaluation and confirm photometric and colorimetric characteristics are retained afterwards.

text: In the case of a rear position lamp reciprocally incorporated with a stop lamp, these functions shall either be provided by multiple light sources (for instance, a double filament light source) or be intended for use in a vehicle equipped with a tell-tale indicating failure for the lamps.
quote: in the case of a rear position lamp reciprocally incorporated with a stop lamp, these functions shall either: (a) be provided by multiple light sources
condition: Rear position and stop lamps are reciprocally incorporated
test_case: Review the circuit design to confirm multiple light sources provide the functions, or that the lamp is restricted to vehicles with a failure tell-tale.

text: If a manufacturer logo is incorporated in the internal structure of the optical components and/or the texture of the outer lens inside the apparent surface of a lamp (function), only one logo shall be incorporated and all requirements for the specific function of this Regulation shall be fulfilled.
quote: may incorporate only one manufacturer logo build by transparent or non-transparent components provided that all requirements for the specific function of this Regulation are fulfilled
condition: A manufacturer logo is incorporated in the rear position lamp
test_case: Inspect the lamp for a single logo and verify the function still meets all photometric and colorimetric requirements.

text: If a logo is incorporated in a lamp, irrespective of the marking requirements in paragraph 3.3., only the logo of the brand name of the vehicle manufacturer or the body manufacturer is allowed.
quote: Irrespective of the marking requirements in paragraph 3.3., only the logo of the brand name of the vehicle manufacturer or the body manufacturer is allowed.
condition: A manufacturer logo is incorporated in the rear position lamp
test_case: Check the logo is the vehicle or body manufacturer brand logo, as confirmed by the applicant statement.

text: If a logo is incorporated in a lamp, the enclosed light emitting surface of the logo (incorporating transparent and non-transparent components of the logo) in the direction of the reference axis shall not exceed 100 cm2.
quote: the enclosed light emitting surface of the logo (incorporating transparent and non-transparent components of the logo) of such a lamp in the direction of the reference axis shall not exceed 100 cm2.
condition: A manufacturer logo is incorporated in the rear position lamp
test_case: Measure the logo enclosed light emitting surface projected along the reference axis; pass if ≤ 100 cm2.

text: The stop lamps and reversing lamps shall not incorporate a logo.
quote: Stop lamps, direction indicator lamps, and reversing lamps shall not incorporate a logo.
test_case: Inspect the stop and reversing lamp optics and lens areas and confirm no logo is present.

text: In a single lamp containing more than one light source, a group of light sources, wired so that the failure of any one of them causes all of them to stop emitting light, shall be considered to be one light source.
quote: a group of light sources, wired so that the failure of any one of them causes all of them to stop emitting light, shall be considered to be one light source.
condition: A lamp function contains more than one light source (e.g. multiple LEDs)
test_case: Review the LED wiring to identify groups that fail together and treat each as one light source in the failure assessment.

text: In case of failure of any one light source in a single lamp containing more than one light source, either the light intensity shall comply with the minimum intensity required in the pertinent table of standard light distribution as shown in Annex 3 (with the maximum intensities not exceeded when all light sources are illuminated), or a signal for activation of a tell-tale indicating failure, as indicated in paragraphs 6.4.8., 6.7.8., 6.9.8, 6.10.8., 6.11.8., 6.12.8., 6.13.8. and 6.18.8. of UN Regulation No. 48, shall be produced.
quote: In case of failure of any one light source in a single lamp containing more than one light source, at least one of the following provisions shall apply
condition: A lamp function contains more than one light source (e.g. multiple LEDs)
test_case: Simulate failure of each light source and measure intensities against Annex 3 minimum values, or verify the failure tell-tale signal is generated.

text: In case of failure of the variable intensity control of a rear position lamp category R2 emitting more than the maximum value of category R1, requirements of steady luminous intensity of the respective category shall be fulfilled automatically.
quote: A rear position lamp category R2 emitting more than the maximum value of category R1;
condition: The rear position lamp is category R2 (variable intensity)
test_case: Simulate failure of the variable intensity control and verify the lamp automatically reverts to steady intensity within the category limits.

text: In case of failure of the variable intensity control of a stop lamp category S2 emitting more than the maximum value of category S1, requirements of steady luminous intensity of the respective category shall be fulfilled automatically.
quote: A stop lamp category S2 emitting more than the maximum value of category S1;
condition: The stop lamp is category S2 (variable intensity)
test_case: Simulate failure of the variable intensity control and verify the stop lamp automatically reverts to steady intensity within the category limits.

text: The lamp shall only be equipped with replaceable light source(s) approved according to UN Regulations Nos. 37, 99 and/or 128 (provided that no restriction on the use is made at the time of application for type approval), and/or light source module(s) and/or non-replaceable light source(s).
quote: The lamp shall only be equipped with: - replaceable light source(s) approved according to UN Regulations Nos. 37, 99 and/or 128
test_case: Review the bill of materials and confirm the LED light sources are non-replaceable, light source modules or UN-approved replaceable light sources.

text: In case of replaceable UN approved light source(s), the design of the lamp shall be such that the light source(s) can be fixed in no other position but the correct one.
quote: The design of the lamp shall be such that the light source(s) can be fixed in no other position but the correct one;
condition: The lamp uses replaceable UN approved light sources
test_case: Attempt to fit the light source in alternative positions; pass if only the correct position is possible.

text: In case of replaceable UN approved light source(s), the light source(s) holder shall conform to the characteristics given in IEC Publication 60061, the holder data sheet relevant to the category of light source(s) prescribed applying, and where a category of LED substitute light source(s) is also prescribed, the holder data sheet relevant to that category also applying.
quote: The light source(s) holder shall conform to the characteristics given in IEC Publication 60061.
condition: The lamp uses replaceable UN approved light sources
test_case: Gauge the holder against the relevant IEC 60061 data sheet dimensions.

text: Light Signalling Devices shall not generate radiated or power line disturbances, which cause a malfunction of other electric/electronic systems of the vehicle.
quote: Light Signalling Devices shall not generate radiated or power line disturbances, which cause a malfunction of other electric/electronic systems of the vehicle.
test_case: Verify by EMC emission testing (e.g. UN R10) that no disturbances causing malfunction of vehicle systems are generated.

text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that it can only be fitted in the designated and correct position and can only be removed with the use of tool(s).
quote: it can only be fitted in the designated and correct position and can only be removed with the use of tool(s);
condition: The lamp uses replaceable light source modules
test_case: Attempt fitting in incorrect positions and removal without tools; pass if neither is possible.

text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that it is tamperproof.
quote: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that
condition: The lamp uses replaceable light source modules
test_case: Inspect the module design for tamperproof construction.

text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), regardless of the use of tool(s), the light source module shall not be interchangeable with any replaceable UN approved light source and/or any other replaceable light source module having different characteristics that is located in the same lamp housing.
quote: regardless of the use of tool(s), it is not interchangeable with: - any replaceable UN approved light source
condition: The lamp uses replaceable light source modules
test_case: Attempt to interchange the module with approved light sources and other modules in the housing; pass if not possible.

text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), when the light source module is removed and replaced by another module provided by the applicant and bearing the same light source module identification code, the photometric requirements of the device shall be met.
quote: when the light source module is removed and replaced by another module provided by the applicant and bearing the same light source module identification code
condition: The lamp uses replaceable light source modules
test_case: Replace the module with another of the same identification code and re-measure photometry against the requirements.

text: All measurements, photometric and colorimetric, shall be made with respect to the conditions of paragraph 4.8., with the methods of measurement given in Annex 3.
quote: All measurements, photometric and colorimetric, shall be made with respect to the following conditions.
test_case: Confirm the test report states measurements were performed per paragraph 4.8 conditions and Annex 3 methods.

text: In the case of replaceable UN approved light sources, all measurements shall be made using standard light sources as specified in R.E.5.
quote: In the case of replaceable UN approved light sources, all measurements shall be made using standard light sources as specified in R.E.5.
condition: The lamp uses replaceable UN approved light sources
test_case: Verify the test report records use of R.E.5 standard light sources.

text: In the case of replaceable UN approved light source(s) controlled by an electronic light source control gear or variable intensity control, the standard light source(s) shall have a luminous flux value that does not deviate more than 5 per cent from its reference/objective luminous flux value when test voltage is applied.
quote: the standard light source(s) shall have a luminous flux value that does not deviate more than 5 per cent from its reference/objective luminous flux value
condition: Lamp uses replaceable UN approved light sources controlled by electronic control gear or variable intensity control
test_case: Measure the standard light source flux at test voltage and confirm it is within ±5 % of the reference/objective flux.

text: In the case of a lamp equipped with light source module(s) or non-replaceable light source(s), all measurements shall be made with the light source(s) present in the lamp.
quote: all measurements shall be made with the light source(s) present in the lamp
condition: Lamp uses LED light source modules or non-replaceable light sources
test_case: Check the test report confirms photometric and colorimetric measurements were taken with the lamp's own LED sources fitted.

text: In case of a lamp (function) using light sources which are subject to more than one of the conditions prescribed in paragraph 4.8., the photometric measurements shall be made separately, in accordance with each applicable condition(s) set forth in paragraph 4.8.
quote: the photometric measurements shall be made separately, in accordance with each applicable condition(s) set forth in paragraph 4.8.
condition: A lamp function uses light sources subject to more than one condition of paragraph 4.8.
test_case: Review the test report for separate photometric measurements for each light source condition.

text: In case of a lamp (function) using light sources which are subject to more than one of the conditions prescribed in paragraph 4.8., all separate measurement results shall be added together.
quote: All separate measurement results shall be added together.
condition: A lamp function uses light sources subject to more than one condition of paragraph 4.8.
test_case: Verify the reported intensities are the sum of the separate measurement results.

text: During photometric measurements, stray reflections shall be avoided by appropriate masking.
quote: During photometric measurements, stray reflections shall be avoided by appropriate masking.
test_case: Inspect the photometric set-up for masking preventing stray reflections.

text: In the case where the lamp may be installed on the vehicle in more than one or in a field of different positions, the photometric measurements shall be repeated for each position or for the extreme positions of the field of the reference axis specified by the manufacturer.
quote: the photometric measurements shall be repeated for each position or for the extreme positions of the field of the reference axis specified by the manufacturer
condition: Lamp may be installed in more than one position or in a field of positions
test_case: Confirm photometric measurements were repeated for each declared installation position or the extreme positions.

text: In the case where the lamp, at the discretion of the applicant, also has to be approved with LED substitute light source(s), all measurements, photometric and colorimetric, shall be repeated using the LED substitute light source(s) prescribed.
quote: all measurements, photometric and colorimetric, shall be repeated using the LED substitute light source(s) prescribed
condition: Lamp is also to be approved with LED substitute light sources
test_case: Verify a complete repeat of photometric and colorimetric tests with the prescribed LED substitute light sources.

text: If not otherwise specified, the intensities shall be measured with the light source continuously lit.
quote: If not otherwise specified, the intensities shall be measured with the light source continuously lit.
test_case: Confirm intensity measurements of each function were made with the light sources continuously lit.

text: In case the results of measurements should be challenged, the distance of measurement shall be such that the law of the inverse of the square of the distance is applicable.
quote: The distance of measurement shall be such that the law of the inverse of the square of the distance is applicable
test_case: Check the measurement distance ensures inverse-square law validity.

text: In case the results of measurements should be challenged, the measuring equipment shall be such that the angular aperture of the receiver viewed from the reference centre of the light is comprised between 10' and 1 degree.
quote: the angular aperture of the receiver viewed from the reference centre of the light is comprised between 10' and 1 degree
test_case: Verify the receiver angular aperture is between 10' and 1°.

text: In case the results of measurements should be challenged, the intensity requirement for a particular direction of observation shall be deemed to be satisfied if that requirement is met in a direction deviating by not more than one-quarter of a degree from the direction of observation.
quote: if that requirement is met in a direction deviating by not more than one-quarter of a degree from the direction of observation
test_case: Assess intensity compliance allowing a deviation of at most 0.25° from the direction of observation.

text: The limits of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the light-signalling lamp shall be determined.
quote: The limits of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of a light-signalling lamp shall be determined.
test_case: Check that the apparent surface limits for each function in the direction of the reference axis are determined and documented.

text: In the case of a lamp which is intended to be mounted inside the vehicle, a sample plate or sample plates as supplied shall be positioned in front of the lamp to be tested, in the geometrical position(s) as described in the application drawing(s).
quote: a sample plate or sample plates (in case of different possibilities) as supplied (see paragraph 3.1.2.8.) shall be positioned in front of the lamp to be tested
condition: Lamp is intended to be mounted inside the vehicle
test_case: Verify testing used the supplied sample plate in the drawn geometrical position.

text: Unless otherwise specified, the voltage supplied at the lamp for testing shall be either 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V (24 Volt-Systems).
quote: the voltage supplied at the lamp shall be either 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V (24 Volt-Systems)
test_case: Verify the test supply voltage at the lamp is 13.5 V for a 12 V system (or 6.75 V / 28 V as applicable).

text: In case of a lamp controlled by an electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control, the lamp shall be operated as specified by the applicant.
quote: In case of a lamp controlled by an electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control, the lamp shall be operated as specified by the applicant
condition: Lamp is controlled by electronic light source control gear or variable intensity control
test_case: Confirm the lamp was operated during testing per the applicant's specified operating conditions.

text: In case of a lamp not controlled by an electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control, in the case of light source module(s) or non-replaceable light source(s), the lamp shall be operated as specified by the applicant.
quote: in the case of light source module(s) or non-replaceable light source(s) the lamp shall be operated as specified by the applicant
condition: Lamp has LED modules/non-replaceable sources without electronic control gear or variable intensity control
test_case: Confirm operating conditions during testing match the applicant's specification.

text: In case of a lamp not controlled by an electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control, in the case of replaceable UN approved light source(s), the light sources shall be operated at the reference/objective luminous flux or alternatively at a different luminous flux with a proportional correction on the measured luminous intensities.
quote: the light sources shall be operated at the reference/objective luminous flux or alternatively at a different luminous flux with a proportional correction
condition: Lamp uses replaceable UN approved light sources without electronic control gear
test_case: Check the light sources were operated at reference flux or results were proportionally corrected.

text: In case of lamps equipped with multiple replaceable UN approved light sources, the light sources shall be operated at a voltage or electrical current setting such that the actual luminous fluxes of the light sources do not deviate by more than 5 per cent from the average luminous flux of the light sources.
quote: shall be operated at a voltage or electrical current setting such that the actual luminous fluxes of the light sources do not deviate by more than 5 per cent
condition: Lamp has multiple replaceable UN approved light sources
test_case: Measure each source flux and verify deviation from the average is ≤5 %.

text: In case of lamps equipped with multiple replaceable UN approved light sources, the measured luminous intensities shall be corrected proportionally for the difference between the average luminous flux and the applicable reference/objective luminous flux.
quote: The measured luminous intensities shall be corrected proportionally for the difference between the average luminous flux and the applicable reference/objective luminous flux.
condition: Lamp has multiple replaceable UN approved light sources
test_case: Verify the reported intensities include the proportional flux correction.

text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, on the reference axis (HV), be not less than the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
quote: On the reference axis (HV), be not less than the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
test_case: Measure the intensity at HV on both samples for each function and verify it is not below the paragraph 5 minimum.

text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, in no direction where the lamp is visible, exceed the maximum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
quote: In no direction where the lamp is visible, exceed the maximum, specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
test_case: Scan all visible directions on both samples and verify no value exceeds the paragraph 5 maximum.

text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, outside the reference axis, be not less than the product of the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5. by the percentage specified in the pertinent light distribution figure in Annex 3, or not less than the intensity value specified in the pertinent light distribution figure in Annex 3, for each direction in question.
quote: be not less than the product of the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5., by the percentage specified
test_case: Measure at each grid point of the Annex 3 figure and verify intensity ≥ minimum × percentage (or the stated value).

text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, within the angles of geometric visibility defined in the tables in Annex 2, be not less than the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
quote: Within the angles of geometric visibility defined in the tables in Annex 2, be not less than the minimum specified in the table
test_case: Measure across the Annex 2 geometric visibility angles and verify intensity is not below the specified minimum.

text: The provisions of the relevant paragraphs of Annex 3 on local variations of intensity shall be observed.
quote: The provisions of the relevant paragraphs of Annex 3 on local variations of intensity shall be observed.
test_case: Evaluate the light distribution against the Annex 3 local variation provisions.

text: When an assembly of two independent lamps, to be type approved as lamps marked "D" and having the same function, is deemed to be a single lamp, it shall comply with the requirements for maximum intensity if all lamps together are lit.
quote: it shall comply with the requirements for: (a) Maximum intensity if all lamps together are lit
condition: Lamp is an assembly of two independent lamps marked "D" of the same function
test_case: Light both lamps together and verify the maximum intensity limit is met.

text: When an assembly of two independent lamps, to be type approved as lamps marked "D" and having the same function, is deemed to be a single lamp, it shall comply with the requirements for minimum intensity if either lamp has failed.
quote: (b) Minimum intensity if either lamp has failed.
condition: Lamp is an assembly of two independent lamps marked "D" of the same function
test_case: Switch off either lamp and verify the remaining lamp meets the minimum intensity.

text: An interdependent lamp system shall meet the requirements when all its interdependent lamps are operated together.
quote: An interdependent lamp system shall meet the requirements when all its interdependent lamps are operated together.
condition: Function is provided by an interdependent lamp system (e.g. split body/tailgate)
test_case: Operate all interdependent lamps together and verify photometric compliance.

text: If the interdependent lamp system providing the rear position lamp is partly mounted on the fixed component and partly mounted on a movable component, the interdependent lamp(s) specified by the applicant shall meet the outboard geometric visibility colorimetric and photometric requirement, at all fixed positions of the movable component(s).
quote: the interdependent lamp(s) specified by the applicant shall meet the outboard geometric visibility colorimetric and photometric requirement, at all fixed positions of the movable component(s)
condition: Rear position lamp is an interdependent lamp system split between fixed and movable components
test_case: Test the specified interdependent lamps at all fixed positions of the movable component for outboard visibility, colour and photometry.

text: If the interdependent lamp system providing the rear position lamp is partly mounted on the fixed and partly on a movable component, the inboard geometric visibility requirement is deemed to be satisfied if the specified interdependent lamp(s) still conform to the photometric values prescribed in the field of light distribution for the approval of the device, at all fixed positions of the moveable component(s).
quote: the inboard geometric visibility requirement is deemed to be satisfied if this (these) interdependent lamp(s) still conform to the photometric values prescribed
condition: Rear position lamp is an interdependent lamp system split between fixed and movable components
test_case: Verify the light distribution field values are met at all fixed positions of the movable component.

text: The variable intensity control shall not generate signals which cause luminous intensities outside the range specified in paragraph 5.
quote: The variable intensity control shall not generate signals which cause luminous intensities: Outside the range specified in paragraph 5.
condition: Lamp has variable intensity (e.g. R2/S2)
test_case: Drive the variable intensity control across its signal range and verify intensities stay within the paragraph 5 range.

text: For systems depending only on daytime and night-time conditions, the variable intensity control shall not generate signals which cause luminous intensities exceeding the respective steady luminous intensity maximum specified in paragraph 5. for the specific lamp under night-time conditions.
quote: For systems depending only on daytime and night-time conditions: under night-time conditions
condition: Lamp has variable intensity control depending only on day/night conditions
test_case: Under night-time setting, verify intensities do not exceed the steady-lamp maximum.

text: For other variable intensity systems, the variable intensity control shall not generate signals which cause luminous intensities exceeding the respective steady luminous intensity maximum specified in paragraph 5. for the specific lamp under standard conditions (good visibility, MOR > 2,000 m, and clean lens).
quote: Exceeding the respective steady luminous intensity maximum specified in paragraph 5. for the specific lamp
condition: Lamp has variable intensity control other than day/night-only systems
test_case: Under standard conditions, verify intensities do not exceed the steady-lamp maximum.

text: If a rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with a stop lamp producing either steady or variable luminous intensity, the ratio between the luminous intensities actually measured of the two lamps when turned on simultaneously to the intensity of the rear position lamp when turned on alone should be at least 5:1 in the field delimited by the straight horizontal lines passing through ±5° V and the straight vertical lines passing through ±10° H of the light distribution table.
quote: the ratio between the luminous intensities actually measured of the two lamps when turned on simultaneously at the intensity of the rear position lamp
condition: Rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with the stop lamp
test_case: Measure stop+position together and position alone in the ±5° V / ±10° H field and verify ratio ≥5:1.

text: If one or both of the reciprocally incorporated rear position and stop lamps contain(s) more than one light source and is (are) considered as a single lamp, the values to be considered for the 5:1 ratio are those obtained with all sources in operation.
quote: the values to be considered are those obtained with all sources in operation
condition: Rear position lamp reciprocally incorporated with stop lamp and containing multiple light sources
test_case: Confirm the ratio measurement was done with all light sources operating.

text: Tests for compliance of the luminous intensities shall be carried out according to Annex 8.
quote: Tests for compliance of the luminous intensities shall be carried out according to Annex 8.
test_case: Verify luminous intensity testing follows the Annex 8 procedure.

text: The colour of the light emitted shall be measured inside the field of the light distribution grid defined for the specific function in the relevant paragraph of Annex 3.
quote: The colour of the light emitted shall be measured inside the field of the light distribution grid defined for the specific function
test_case: Measure chromaticity within the Annex 3 grid field for each function.

text: To check the colorimetric characteristics, the test procedure described in paragraph 4.8. shall be applied.
quote: To check these colorimetric characteristics, the test procedure described in paragraph 4.8. shall be applied.
test_case: Confirm colorimetric testing uses the paragraph 4.8 operating and measurement conditions.

text: Outside the field of the light distribution grid no sharp variation of colour shall be observed.
quote: Outside this field no sharp variation of colour shall be observed.
test_case: Visually/colorimetrically inspect outside the grid for absence of sharp colour variation.

text: For lamps equipped with non-replaceable light sources, the colorimetric characteristics should be verified with the light sources present in the lamp, in accordance with relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 4.8.
quote: for lamps equipped with non-replaceable light sources, the colorimetric characteristics should be verified with the light sources present in the lamp
condition: Lamp uses non-replaceable light sources
test_case: Confirm colour measurements were made with the lamp's own non-replaceable LEDs.

text: For lamps (functions) using different light source technologies, the colorimetric characteristics shall be checked for each light source technology separately according to the applicable provisions in paragraphs 4.8.1. and 4.8.2.
quote: the colorimetric characteristics shall be checked for each light source technology separately according to the applicable provisions
condition: A function uses different light source technologies
test_case: Verify separate colour measurements per light source technology.

text: For rear position lamps of category R1 (steady), the light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall have a minimum luminous intensity of 4∙10^0 cd on the reference axis (Par. 4.8.3.1. (a)), as specified in Table 4.
quote: R1, MR or RM1 (steady) 4∙100 1.7∙101 8.5∙100 Figure A3-I Table A2-1 5∙10-2
condition: Rear position lamp is category R1 (steady intensity)
test_case: Measure HV intensity on both samples and verify ≥4 cd.

text: For rear position lamps of category R1 (steady), the maximum luminous intensity (Par. 4.8.3.1. (b)) shall be 1.7∙10^1 cd when used as a single lamp and 8.5∙10^0 cd when used as a lamp marked "D", as specified in Table 4.
condition: Rear position lamp is category R1 (steady intensity); "D" value applies if marked D
test_case: Scan all visible directions and verify ≤17 cd (≤8.5 cd if marked D).

text: For rear position lamps of category R1 (steady), the standard light distribution (Par. 4.8.3.1. (c)) shall meet Figure A3-I, as specified in Table 4.
quote: R1, MR or RM1 (steady) 4∙100 1.7∙101 8.5∙100 Figure A3-I
condition: Rear position lamp is category R1 (steady intensity)
test_case: Measure at Figure A3-I grid points and verify the percentage minima are met.

text: For rear position lamps of category R1 (steady), within the angles of geometric visibility defined in Table A2-1 (Par. 4.8.3.1. (d)), the luminous intensity shall be not less than 5∙10^-2 cd, as specified in Table 4.
quote: Figure A3-I Table A2-1 5∙10-2
condition: Rear position lamp is category R1 (steady intensity)
test_case: Measure across Table A2-1 visibility angles and verify ≥0.05 cd.

text: For rear position lamps of category R2 (variable), the light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall have a minimum luminous intensity of 4∙10^0 cd on the reference axis (Par. 4.8.3.1. (a)), as specified in Table 4.
quote: R2 or RM2 (variable) 4∙100 4.2∙101 2.1∙101 Figure A3-I Table A2-1 5∙10-2
condition: Rear position lamp is category R2 (variable intensity)
test_case: Measure HV intensity on both samples and verify ≥4 cd.

text: For rear position lamps of category R2 (variable), the maximum luminous intensity (Par. 4.8.3.1. (b)) shall be 4.2∙10^1 cd when used as a single lamp and 2.1∙10^1 cd when used as a lamp marked "D", as specified in Table 4.
condition: Rear position lamp is category R2 (variable intensity); "D" value applies if marked D
test_case: Verify maximum intensity ≤42 cd (≤21 cd if marked D) in all visible directions.

text: For rear position lamps of category R2 (variable), the standard light distribution (Par. 4.8.3.1. (c)) shall meet Figure A3-I, and within the angles of geometric visibility of Table A2-1 (Par. 4.8.3.1. (d)) the luminous intensity shall be not less than 5∙10^-2 cd, as specified in Table 4.
quote: R2 or RM2 (variable) 4∙100 4.2∙101 2.1∙101 Figure A3-I Table A2-1 5∙10-2
condition: Rear position lamp is category R2 (variable intensity)
test_case: Verify Figure A3-I distribution and ≥0.05 cd across Table A2-1 angles.

text: For rear position lamps reciprocally incorporated with stop lamps, a luminous intensity of up to 6.0∙10^1 cd shall be permitted only below a plane forming an angle of 5° with and downward from the horizontal plane.
quote: a luminous intensity of 6.0∙101 cd shall be permitted for rear position lamps reciprocally incorporated with stop lamps below a plane forming an angle of 5°
condition: Rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with the stop lamp
test_case: Verify intensities above the table maximum occur only below 5° down and do not exceed 60 cd.

text: The minimum luminous intensity of the rear position lamp within the angles of geometric visibility shall be as given in Table 4.
quote: Minimum luminous intensity within the angles of geometric visibility: See Table 4
test_case: Verify geometric visibility minimum of 0.05 cd per Table 4.

text: The rear position lamp shall meet the failure provisions of paragraph 4.6.
quote: Failure provisions: See paragraph 4.6.
test_case: Assess rear position lamp failure behaviour against paragraph 4.6.

text: The colour of light emitted by the rear position lamp shall be red.
quote: Colour: The colour of light emitted shall be red.
test_case: Measure chromaticity coordinates of the rear position lamp and verify they fall in the red colour boundaries.

text: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied of the stop lamp shall meet the requirements in Table 7.
quote: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 7.
test_case: Goniophotometric measurement of both samples; all Table 7 values for the declared category met.

text: For a stop lamp of category S1 (steady), the minimum luminous intensity shall be 6.0∙10^1 cd and the maximum luminous intensity shall be 2.60∙10^2 cd when used as a single lamp or 1.30∙10^2 cd when used as a lamp marked "D", with the standard light distribution of Figure A3-I and the angles of geometric visibility of Table A2-1, as given in Table 7.
condition: Stop lamp is category S1 (steady intensity); D-marking value applies only if lamp is marked "D".
test_case: Measure intensity on the reference axis and across Figure A3-I grid; min ≥ 60 cd, max ≤ 260 cd (≤ 130 cd if marked D).

text: For a stop lamp of category S2 (variable), the minimum luminous intensity shall be 6.0∙10^1 cd and the maximum luminous intensity shall be 7.30∙10^2 cd when used as a single lamp or 3.65∙10^2 cd when used as a lamp marked "D", with the standard light distribution of Figure A3-I and the angles of geometric visibility of Table A2-1, as given in Table 7.
condition: Stop lamp is category S2 (variable intensity); D-marking value applies only if lamp is marked "D".
test_case: Measure intensity under variable-intensity conditions; min ≥ 60 cd, max ≤ 730 cd (≤ 365 cd if marked D).

text: For a stop lamp of category S1, the minimum luminous intensity within the angles of geometric visibility of Table A2-1 shall be 3∙10^-1 cd, as given in Table 7.
quote: Minimum luminous intensity within the angles of geometric visibility See Table 7.
condition: Stop lamp is category S1.
test_case: Measure intensity at the boundary of the Table A2-1 geometric visibility angles; each value ≥ 0.3 cd.

text: For a stop lamp of category S2, the minimum luminous intensity within the angles of geometric visibility of Table A2-1 shall be 3∙10^-1 cd (day) and 7∙10^-2 cd (night), as given in Table 7.
quote: Minimum luminous intensity within the angles of geometric visibility See Table 7.
condition: Stop lamp is category S2.
test_case: Measure intensity within the Table A2-1 geometric visibility angles in day and night modes; ≥ 0.3 cd day and ≥ 0.07 cd night.

text: The stop lamp shall comply with the failure provisions of paragraph 4.6.
quote: Failure provisions: See paragraph 4.6.
test_case: Simulate light source failure per paragraph 4.6 and verify the specified behaviour.

text: The colour of light emitted by the stop lamp shall be red.
quote: Colour: The colour of light emitted shall be red.
test_case: Measure chromaticity coordinates of the stop lamp light; within the red colour boundaries.

text: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied of the reversing lamp shall meet the requirements in Table 10.
quote: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 10.
test_case: Goniophotometric measurement of both samples against Table 10 values.

text: For a reversing lamp of category AR, the minimum luminous intensity shall be 8.0∙10^1 cd, with the standard light distribution of Figure A3-V, as given in Table 10.
test_case: Measure intensity on the reference axis and over Figure A3-V grid; minimum ≥ 80 cd.

text: For a reversing lamp of category AR, the maximum luminous intensity shall not exceed 3.00∙10^2 cd in or above the H-plane, 6.00∙10^2 cd below the H-plane down to 5°D, and 8.00∙10^3 cd below 5°D, as given in Table 10.
test_case: Scan intensity in the three vertical zones; ≤ 300 cd at/above H, ≤ 600 cd down to 5°D, ≤ 8000 cd below 5°D.

text: Where the reversing lamp is intended to be installed on a vehicle exclusively in a pair of devices and the photometric intensity is verified only up to an angle of 30° inwards, a photometric value of at least 2.5∙10^1 cd shall be satisfied, and this condition shall be clearly explained in the application for approval and relating documents.
quote: the photometric intensity may be verified only up to an angle of 30° inwards where a photometric value of at least 2.5∙101 cd shall be satisfied
condition: Reversing lamp intended to be installed exclusively in a pair of devices.
test_case: Measure intensity up to 30° inwards; ≥ 25 cd; check the pair condition is declared in the application.

text: Where type approval of the reversing lamp is granted applying the pair-only condition, the device shall only be installed in a pair.
quote: a statement in paragraph 9.1.3. of the communication form (see Annex 1) will inform that the device shall only be installed in a pair
condition: Reversing lamp approved under the pair-only condition.
test_case: Verify vehicle installation uses two reversing lamps when the approval carries the pair-only statement.

text: The reversing lamp shall comply with the failure provisions of paragraph 4.6.
quote: Failure provisions: See paragraph 4.6.
test_case: Simulate light source failure per paragraph 4.6 and verify the specified behaviour.

text: The colour of light emitted by the reversing lamp shall be white.
quote: Colour: The colour of light emitted shall be white.
test_case: Measure chromaticity of the reversing lamp light through its lens zone; within the white colour boundaries.

text: The rear position lamp (R1, R2) shall have minimum horizontal angles of geometric visibility of 45° inboard / 80° outboard and minimum vertical angles of 15° above / 15° below, as given in Table A2-1 (angles shown for lamps mounted on the right side of the vehicle).
test_case: Check the lamp in its mounting position: the light-emitting surface is visible throughout 45° inboard / 80° outboard horizontally and 15° above / 15° below vertically.

text: For a rear position lamp (R1, R2) mounted with the H-plane below 750 mm, the minimum horizontal angles of geometric visibility below the H-plane may be reduced to 20° inboard / 80° outboard.
quote: a Reduced angles used only below the H-plane for lamps mounted with the H-plane below 750 mm.
condition: Rear position lamp H-plane mounting height below 750 mm (mounting height not stated)
test_case: Confirm the H-plane height is below 750 mm and verify visibility of at least 20° inboard / 80° outboard below the H-plane.

text: For a rear position lamp (R1, R2) to be installed with the H-plane of the lamp at a mounting height of less than 750 mm, the minimum vertical angles of geometric visibility may be reduced to 15° above / 5° below.
quote: b For lamps to be installed with the H-plane of the lamp at a mounting height of less than 750 mm.
condition: Rear position lamp H-plane mounting height below 750 mm (mounting height not stated)
test_case: Confirm the H-plane height is below 750 mm and verify vertical visibility of at least 15° above / 5° below.

text: The stop lamp (S1, S2) shall have minimum horizontal angles of geometric visibility of 45° inboard / 45° outboard and minimum vertical angles of 15° above / 15° below, as given in Table A2-1 (angles shown for lamps mounted on the right side of the vehicle).
test_case: Check the lamp in its mounting position: the light-emitting surface is visible throughout 45° inboard / 45° outboard horizontally and 15° above / 15° below vertically.

text: For a stop lamp (S1, S2) mounted with the H-plane below 750 mm, the minimum horizontal angles of geometric visibility below the H-plane may be reduced to 20° inboard / 45° outboard.
quote: a Reduced angles used only below the H-plane for lamps mounted with the H-plane below 750 mm.
condition: Stop lamp H-plane mounting height below 750 mm (mounting height not stated)
test_case: Confirm the H-plane height is below 750 mm and verify visibility of at least 20° inboard / 45° outboard below the H-plane.

text: For a stop lamp (S1, S2) to be installed with the H-plane of the lamp at a mounting height of less than 750 mm, the minimum vertical angles of geometric visibility may be reduced to 15° above / 5° below.
quote: b For lamps to be installed with the H-plane of the lamp at a mounting height of less than 750 mm.
condition: Stop lamp H-plane mounting height below 750 mm (mounting height not stated)
test_case: Confirm the H-plane height is below 750 mm and verify vertical visibility of at least 15° above / 5° below.

text: For optional rear position lamps (R1, R2) and stop lamps (S1, S2) to be installed with the H-plane of the lamp at a mounting height of more than 2,100 mm, the minimum vertical angles of geometric visibility shall be 5° above / 15° below.
quote: c Optional lamps to be installed with the H-plane of the lamp at a mounting height of more than 2,100 mm.
condition: Lamp is an optional lamp mounted with H-plane above 2,100 mm (unlikely for M1)
test_case: Where the H-plane is above 2,100 mm, verify vertical visibility of at least 5° above / 15° below.

text: The direction H = 0° and V = 0° shall correspond to the reference axis, which passes through the centre of reference and, on the vehicle, is horizontal, parallel to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle and oriented in the required direction of visibility.
quote: The direction H = 0° and V = 0° corresponds to the reference axis.
test_case: Check that the goniometric measurements of each function are referenced to the manufacturer-declared reference axis and centre of reference.

text: Unless specified otherwise, the values shown in Figures A3-I to A3-XV give, for the various directions of measurement, the minimum intensities as a percentage of the minimum intensities required, which shall be mathematically rounded down to three significant digits.
quote: the minimum intensities as a percentage of the minimum intensities required, which shall be mathematically rounded down to three significant digits
test_case: Compute the required minimum at each grid point as the percentage of the minimum, rounded down to three significant digits, and compare with the measured intensities.

text: Where the rear position lamp is intended to be installed at a mounting height (using the H plane specified by the manufacturer) equal to or less than 750 mm above the ground, the photometric intensity is verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards.
quote: equal to or less than 750 mm above the ground, the photometric intensity is verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards
condition: Rear position lamp intended mounting height ≤ 750 mm above ground (not stated)
test_case: For a declared mounting height ≤ 750 mm, verify the photometric grid of the rear position lamp down to 5° below H only.

text: Where the stop lamp of category S1, S2 or MS is intended to be installed at a mounting height (using the H plane specified by the manufacturer) equal to or less than 750 mm above the ground, the photometric intensity is verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards.
quote: equal to or less than 750 mm above the ground, the photometric intensity is verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards
condition: Stop lamp intended mounting height ≤ 750 mm above ground (not stated)
test_case: For a declared mounting height ≤ 750 mm, verify the photometric grid of the stop lamp down to 5° below H only.

text: Within the field of light distribution schematically shown as a grid, the light intensity in each direction of a part of the field formed by the grid lines shall meet at least the lowest minimum value being shown on the grid lines surrounding the questioned direction as a percentage.
quote: the light intensity in each direction of a part of the field formed by the grid lines shall meet at least the lowest minimum value
test_case: Measure intensities between grid points of each function and verify each is at least the lowest surrounding grid-line minimum.

text: In the case of reversing lamps, if visual examination of a lamp appears to reveal substantial local variations of intensity, a check shall be made to ensure that no intensity measured between two of the directions of measurement is below 50 per cent of the lower minimum intensity of the two prescribed for these directions of measurement.
quote: no intensity measured between two of the directions of measurement referred to above is below 50 per cent of the lower minimum intensity
test_case: If local variations are seen on the reversing lamp, measure between measurement directions and verify no value is below 50% of the lower of the two prescribed minima.

text: The rear position lamp shall meet, for the various directions of measurement, the minimum intensities given as a percentage of the minimum intensities required (see Table 4) in the standard light distribution of Figure A3-I.
quote: The values shown give, for the various directions of measurement, the minimum intensities as a percentage of the minimum intensities required (see Tables 3, 4, 5, 7 and 8).
test_case: Goniophotometric measurement of the rear position lamp at the Figure A3-I grid points; each value ≥ the stated percentage of the required minimum.

text: The stop lamp of category S1 or S2 shall meet, for the various directions of measurement, the minimum intensities given as a percentage of the minimum intensities required (see Table 7) in the standard light distribution of Figure A3-I.
quote: The values shown give, for the various directions of measurement, the minimum intensities as a percentage of the minimum intensities required (see Tables 3, 4, 5, 7 and 8).
condition: Stop lamp is of category S1 or S2 (category not stated)
test_case: Goniophotometric measurement of the stop lamp at the Figure A3-I grid points; each value ≥ the stated percentage of the required minimum.

text: The reversing lamp shall meet, at the measuring points expressed in degrees of angle with the axis of reference, the minimum intensities in cd given in Figure A3-V.
quote: The values shown in figure A3-V give, for the various directions of measurement, the minimum intensities in cd.
test_case: Goniophotometric measurement of the reversing lamp at the Figure A3-V points; each value ≥ the minimum in cd shown.

text: For the reversing lamp, the directions H = 0° and V = 0° shall correspond to the axis of reference, which on the vehicle is horizontal, parallel to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle, oriented in the required direction of visibility and passing through the centre of reference.
quote: The directions H = O° and V = O° correspond to the axis of reference. On the vehicle they are horizontal
test_case: Verify the reversing lamp photometry is referenced to the declared axis and centre of reference.

text: From a mechanical and geometric standpoint, the conformity requirements shall be considered satisfied if the differences of the mass-produced lamps do not exceed inevitable manufacturing deviations within the requirements of this Regulation.
quote: The conformity requirements shall be considered satisfied from a mechanical and geometric standpoint, if the differences do not exceed inevitable manufacturing deviations
test_case: Compare production samples against approved drawings; pass if deviations stay within inevitable manufacturing tolerances.

text: With respect to photometric performances, the conformity of mass-produced lamps shall not be contested when testing photometric performances of any lamp chosen at random according to paragraph 4.8. of this Regulation.
quote: the conformity of mass-produced lamps shall not be contested, when testing photometric performances of any lamp chosen at random according to paragraph 4.8.
test_case: Measure a randomly chosen production lamp per paragraph 4.8.; pass if photometric values meet the CoP tolerances.

text: In the case of a lamp equipped with a replaceable light source, if the results of the photometric test do not meet the requirements, tests on lamps shall be repeated using another standard light source.
quote: in the case of a lamp equipped with a replaceable light source and if results of the test described above do not meet the requirements
condition: Lamp is equipped with a replaceable light source
test_case: If a CoP photometric test fails, repeat with another standard light source and check compliance.

text: The chromaticity coordinates of the mass-produced lamps shall be complied with when tested under conditions of paragraph 4.9. of this Regulation.
quote: The chromaticity coordinates shall be complied with when tested under conditions of paragraph 4.9. of this Regulation.
test_case: Measure chromaticity of production lamps (red and white zones) per paragraph 4.9.; pass if within the colour boundaries.

text: The sampled lamp shall be subjected to photometric measurements for the minimum values at the points listed in Annex 3 and the required chromaticity coordinates.
quote: The sampled lamp shall be subjected to photometric measurements for the minimum values at the points listed in Annex 3.and the required chromaticity coordinates.
test_case: Measure sampled lamp at Annex 3 points and chromaticity; pass if minimum values and coordinates are met.

text: The conformity requirements shall be considered satisfied from a mechanical and a geometric standpoint, in accordance with the requirements of this Regulation, if the differences do not exceed inevitable manufacturing deviations.
quote: The conformity requirements shall be considered satisfied from a mechanical and a geometric standpoint, in accordance with the requirements of this Regulation
test_case: Compare mass-produced lamps with the approved type; pass if mechanical and geometric differences do not exceed inevitable manufacturing deviations.

text: With respect to photometric performance, when testing the photometric performances set forth in paragraph 4.8. of any lamp chosen at random, no measured value shall deviate from the values prescribed in paragraph 6.1.3. of this Regulation.
quote: when testing the photometric performances set forth in paragraph 4.8. of this Regulation of any lamp chosen at random: (a) No measured value deviates
test_case: Measure photometry of a randomly chosen production lamp per paragraph 4.8.; pass if no value deviates from paragraph 6.1.3. limits.

text: In the case of a lamp equipped with a replaceable light source, if the results of the photometric test do not meet the requirements, tests on lamps shall be repeated using another standard light source.
quote: in the case of a lamp equipped with a replaceable light source and if results of the test described above do not meet the requirements
condition: Lamp is equipped with a replaceable light source
test_case: If photometric results fail, repeat the test with another standard light source and check compliance.

text: The chromaticity coordinates of the lamps shall be complied with when tested under conditions of paragraph 4.9. of this Regulation.
quote: The chromaticity coordinates shall be complied when tested under conditions of paragraph 4.9. of this Regulation.
test_case: Measure chromaticity of production red and white functions under paragraph 4.9. conditions; pass if within the prescribed colour boundaries.

text: The approval marking arrangement of the rear combination lamp (rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp) shall be made in accordance with paragraph 3.3. of this Regulation; the arrangements in Annex 7 are examples only.
quote: any other arrangement made in accordance with paragraph 3.3. of this Regulation is acceptable.
test_case: Inspect the approval marking layout on the lamp and check it conforms to paragraph 3.3. (e.g. as in Annex 7 examples).

text: If the lamp is equipped with light source modules, the light source module shall bear an identification code (e.g. MD E3 17325) indicating that it has been approved together with the lamp and the lamp's approval number.
quote: The light source module bearing the identification code shown above has been approved together with a lamp approved in Italy (E3)
condition: Lamp is equipped with light source module(s)
test_case: Inspect each light source module for an identification code of the form MD + approval country + lamp approval number.

text: For lamps (functions) using incandescent technology only, the luminous intensities measured after photometric stability shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.
quote: For lamps (functions) using incandescent technology only, the luminous intensities measured after photometric stability shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.
condition: Applies only if any lamp function uses incandescent (filament) light sources only; the specification states LED modules.
test_case: Measure luminous intensities after photometric stability and verify all values are within the minimum and maximum limits.

text: For the reversing lamp using light source technologies other than incandescent technology only, the luminous intensities measured after 1 minute and after 10 minutes of operation shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.
quote: For reversing lamps and manoeuvring lamps, the luminous intensities measured after 1 minute and after 10 minutes of operation, shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.
test_case: Operate the LED reversing lamp and measure (or calculate via HV ratio) intensities at 1 min and 10 min; verify all test points within minimum and maximum limits.

text: If the luminous intensity distribution of the reversing lamp after 1 and after 10 minutes of operation is calculated from the distribution measured after photometric stability, it shall be calculated by applying at each test point the ratio of luminous intensities measured at HV after 1 minute, after 10 minutes and after photometric stability has occurred.
quote: may be calculated from the luminous intensity distribution measured after photometric stability has occurred by applying at each test point the ratio of luminous intensities measured at HV
condition: Applies only if the calculation method is used instead of direct measurement at 1 and 10 minutes.
test_case: Check that HV values at 1 min, 10 min and stability were measured and the ratio was applied at each test point.

text: For the rear position lamp and the stop lamp using light source technologies other than incandescent technology only, the luminous intensities measured after 1 min and either after 30 minutes of operation or after photometric stability has occurred shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.
quote: For all other lamps, the luminous intensities measured after 1 min and either - after 30 minutes of operation, or - after photometric stability has occurred shall comply
test_case: Operate the LED rear position and stop lamps and measure intensities at 1 min and at 30 min (or photometric stability); verify all test points within minimum and maximum limits.

text: If the luminous intensity distribution of the rear position lamp or stop lamp after 1 min of operation is calculated, it shall be calculated from the distribution either after 30 min of operation or after photometric stabilization by applying at each test point the ratio of luminous intensities measured at HV after 1 min and either after 30 min of operation or after photometric stabilization.
quote: by applying at each test point the ratio of luminous intensities measured at HV after 1 min and either after 30 min of operation or after photometric stabilization
condition: Applies only if the calculation method is used instead of direct measurement at 1 min.
test_case: Verify the HV ratio method was applied correctly at each test point.

text: Depending on the light source technology, the luminous intensity distribution of the rear position lamp shall, in addition to paragraph 1, be checked for compliance at 4 seconds after switch ON, using HV as reference coordinate, as listed in Table A8-1.
quote: the luminous intensity distribution is, in addition to paragraph 1, checked for compliance at the point in time listed in Table A8-1.
test_case: Measure rear position lamp intensity at HV 4 s after switch ON and scale the distribution; verify compliance with limits (or deemed compliant per 2.1.2 for LED only).

text: Depending on the light source technology, the luminous intensity distribution of the stop lamp shall, in addition to paragraph 1, be checked for compliance at 0.2 seconds after switch ON, using HV as reference coordinate, as listed in Table A8-1.
quote: the luminous intensity distribution is, in addition to paragraph 1, checked for compliance at the point in time listed in Table A8-1.
test_case: Measure stop lamp intensity at HV 0.2 s after switch ON and scale the distribution; verify compliance with limits (or deemed compliant per 2.1.2 for LED only).

text: Depending on the light source technology, the luminous intensity distribution of the reversing lamp shall, in addition to paragraph 1, be checked for compliance at 0.2 seconds after switch ON, using HV as reference coordinate, as listed in Table A8-1.
quote: the luminous intensity distribution is, in addition to paragraph 1, checked for compliance at the point in time listed in Table A8-1.
test_case: Measure reversing lamp intensity at HV 0.2 s after switch ON and scale the distribution; verify compliance with limits (or deemed compliant per 2.1.2 for LED only).

text: In case a lamp (function) uses LED technology only, the lamp (function) is deemed to comply with the corresponding intensity requirements at all points in time, if the values measured according to paragraph 1.2. are compliant.
quote: In case a lamp (function) uses LED technology only, a lamp (function) is deemed to comply with the corresponding intensity requirements at all points in time
test_case: Confirm each function uses LED only and that values measured per paragraph 1.2 comply; then compliance at all points in time is deemed.

text: In case a lamp (function) uses incandescent technology only, the lamp (function) is deemed to comply with the corresponding intensity requirements at all points in time, if the values measured according to paragraph 1.1. are compliant.
quote: In case a lamp (function) uses incandescent technology only, a lamp (function) is deemed to comply with the corresponding intensity requirements at all points in time
condition: Applies only if any function uses incandescent light sources only.
test_case: Verify values measured per paragraph 1.1 comply.

text: In case a lamp (function) uses any other light generating technology, the corresponding intensity requirements of the lamp (function) shall be tested and checked for compliance at the corresponding point in time listed in Table A8-1 and ending when photometric stability is reached.
quote: the corresponding intensity requirements of a lamp (function) are tested and checked for compliance at the corresponding point in time listed in Table A8-1
condition: Applies only if any function uses a light generating technology other than LED or incandescent.
test_case: Measure intensities from the Table A8-1 time until photometric stability and verify compliance throughout.

text: In case a lamp (function) uses more than one light generating technology, the corresponding intensity requirements of the lamp (function) shall be tested following the strictest time requirements according to paragraphs 2.1.1. to 2.1.3. for the combination of them and checked for compliance.
quote: the corresponding intensity requirements of a lamp (function) are tested following the strictest time requirements according to paragraphs 2.1.1. to 2.1.3.
condition: Applies only if a function combines more than one light generating technology.
test_case: Identify strictest time requirement among applicable technologies and verify intensities comply at those times.

text: In case of doubt (e.g. unexpected run-up behaviour), the corresponding minimum intensity requirements of the lamp (function) shall be tested and checked for compliance at all points in time starting at the corresponding point in time listed in Table A8-1 and ending when photometric stability is reached.
quote: In case of doubt (e.g. unexpected run-up behaviour), the corresponding minimum intensity requirements of a lamp (function) are tested and checked for compliance at all points in time
condition: Applies only in case of doubt such as unexpected run-up behaviour.
test_case: Record intensity continuously from the Table A8-1 time until photometric stability and verify minimum values are met throughout.

text: A separate approval is required for the retro-reflector (Class IA or IB) as a retro-reflective device listed in paragraph 1.
quote: A separate approval is required for each retro-reflective device listed in paragraph 1.
test_case: Check that a separate UN R150 approval exists for the retro-reflector of the rear lamp.

text: The approval number assigned to the approved retro-reflector type shall be marked on the device following the requirements of paragraph 3.3.
quote: An approval number shall be assigned to each type approved and shall be marked on the device following the requirements of paragraph 3.3.
test_case: Inspect the device and confirm the approval number is marked per paragraph 3.3.

text: The retro-reflector shall be identified by the symbol IA if it is an independent retro-reflector for motor vehicles, or IB if it is combined with other signal lamps which are not watertight, as given in Table 1.
quote: Retro-reflector for motor vehicles (independent) IA 5 5.1. Retro-reflector for motor vehicles (combined with other signal lamps which are not watertight) IB
condition: Retro-reflector class (IA or IB) depends on whether the combined lamp housing is watertight; not stated.
test_case: Verify the class symbol marked and documented matches the construction (IA independent/watertight, IB combined with non-watertight lamps).

text: The retro-reflector belonging to an approved type shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the Unique Identifier and other markings as defined in paragraph 3.3.4.2., or the approval marking and other markings as defined in paragraph 3.3.4.2.
quote: Every device belonging to an approved type shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the Unique Identifier as referred to in the 1958 Agreement
test_case: Inspect the device drawing/sample for a marking space large enough for the UI or approval marking and other markings.

text: All markings on the retro-reflector shall be clearly legible and indelible.
quote: All markings shall be clearly legible and indelible.
test_case: Visually inspect markings for legibility and perform a rub/indelibility check; markings must remain legible.

text: The size of the approval marking shall comply with the value for "a" defined in Table 1 (minimum 5 mm for Class IA and IB retro-reflectors).
quote: With regard to the size of the approval marking the value for “a” is defined in Table 1.
test_case: Measure the approval mark dimension "a"; it must be at least 5 mm.

text: The approval marking shall consist of the approval mark, i.e. a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval.
quote: The approval mark, i.e. a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval.
condition: Applies if the approval marking is used instead of the Unique Identifier.
test_case: Inspect the marking for a circle enclosing E and the country number.

text: The approval marking shall consist of the four to six-digit sequential number being part of the approval number prescribed in paragraph 3.2.3.2, placed close to the approval mark.
quote: The four to six-digit sequential number being part of the approval number prescribed in paragraph 3.2.3.2. This sequential number shall be placed close to the approval mark.
condition: Applies if the approval marking is used instead of the Unique Identifier.
test_case: Check the 4-6 digit sequential number is present and adjacent to the approval mark.

text: The approval marking shall consist of the symbols identifying the retro-reflective device prescribed in paragraph 3.2.5. (IA or IB).
quote: The symbols identifying the retro-reflective device prescribed in paragraph 3.2.5.
condition: Applies if the approval marking is used instead of the Unique Identifier.
test_case: Check the class symbol IA or IB is part of the marking.

text: The approval marking shall consist of the number of this Regulation followed by the letter "R" and the two digits indicating the series of amendments in force at the time of issue of the approval.
quote: The number of this Regulation followed by the letter “R” and the two digits indicating the series of amendments in force
condition: Applies if the approval marking is used instead of the Unique Identifier.
test_case: Check the marking contains "150R" followed by the series of amendments digits.

text: Where the approval marking is replaced by the Unique Identifier, the Unique Identifier mark shall follow the format in the example shown in Figure I.
quote: The Unique Identifier mark shall follow the format in the example shown below: Figure I Unique Identifier (UI)
condition: Applies if the Unique Identifier is used instead of the approval marking.
test_case: Compare the UI marking on the device with the Figure I format.

text: The retro-reflector shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
quote: Retro-reflective devices shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
test_case: Inspect the device for the applicant's trade name or mark.

text: The retro-reflector of Class IA or IB shall bear the word "TOP" inscribed horizontally on the highest part of the illuminating surface, if such an indication is necessary to determine without ambiguity the angle or angles of rotation prescribed by the manufacturer.
quote: the word “TOP” inscribed horizontally on the highest part of the illuminating surface, if such an indication is necessary to determine without ambiguity
condition: Applies if a TOP indication is needed to determine unambiguously the angle(s) of rotation prescribed by the manufacturer.
test_case: Check whether rotation is ambiguous; if so, verify "TOP" is horizontal on the highest part of the illuminating surface.

text: The approval marking or the Unique Identifier and the markings in paragraph 3.3.4. shall be clearly legible on the retro-reflective device.
quote: The approval marking or the Unique Identifier and the markings in paragraphs 3.3.4. shall be clearly legible on the retroreflective device.
test_case: Visually inspect the device to confirm approval marking/UI, trade name and TOP marking are clearly legible.

text: Where a single approval mark with the four to six-digit sequential number or Unique Identifier is affixed to the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, it shall be visible after their installation.
quote: This marking may be located anywhere on the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, provided that: It is visible after their installation.
condition: Applies if a single approval mark is used for the rear combination lamp and integrated retro-reflector.
test_case: Check on the installed lamp that the single approval mark is visible.

text: Where a single approval mark is affixed to the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, no part of these lamps that transmits light can be removed without at the same time removing the approval mark with the four to six-digit sequential number or the Unique Identifier.
quote: No part of the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps that transmits light can be removed without at the same time removing the approval mark
condition: Applies if a single approval mark is used for the rear combination lamp and integrated retro-reflector.
test_case: Inspect construction: verify the mark is on a part (e.g. outer lens) such that no light-transmitting part can be removed without removing the mark.

text: The size of the components of a single approval mark shall not be less than the minimum size required for the smallest of the individual marks by the pertinent UN Regulations under which approval has been granted.
quote: The size of the components of a single approval mark shall not be less than the minimum size required for the smallest of the individual marks
condition: Applies if a single approval mark is used for the rear combination lamp and integrated retro-reflector.
test_case: Measure the single approval mark components and compare with the smallest minimum size required by R150/R148.

text: The requirements contained in sections 5. "General specifications" and 6. "Individual specifications" and in the Annexes referenced in the said sections of UN Regulations Nos. 48, 53, 74 or 86, and their series of amendments in force at the time of application for the retro-reflecting device type approval, shall apply to the retro-reflector, where their verification at the moment of type approval is feasible.
