quote: The requirements pertinent to each retro-reflecting device and to the category/ies of vehicle on which the retro-reflecting device is intended to be installed shall be applied
test_case: Review the R48 general and individual specifications relevant to rear retro-reflectors on M1 vehicles and confirm the device meets those verifiable at type approval.

text: The retro-reflector shall be so constructed that it functions satisfactorily and will continue to do so in normal use.
quote: Retro-reflective devices shall be so constructed that they function satisfactorily and will continue to do so in normal use.
test_case: Inspect the design and confirm satisfactory function after the prescribed test sequence.

text: The retro-reflector shall not have any defect in design or manufacture that is detrimental to its efficient operation or to its maintenance in good condition.
quote: they must not have any defect in design or manufacture that is detrimental to their efficient operation or to their maintenance in good condition
test_case: Visually inspect the samples for design or manufacturing defects; none shall be found.

text: The components of the retro-reflector or parts thereof shall not be capable of being easily dismantled.
quote: The components of retro-reflective devices or parts thereof shall not be capable of being easily dismantled.
test_case: Attempt to dismantle the retro-reflector by hand without tools; the components shall not separate easily.

text: The outer surface of the retro-reflector shall be easy to clean.
quote: The outer surface of retro-reflective devices shall be easy to clean.
test_case: Inspect the outer lens surface over the retro-reflector and confirm it can be cleaned easily.

text: The outer surface of the retro-reflector shall not be rough and any protuberances the outer surface may exhibit shall not prevent easy cleaning.
quote: The surface shall therefore not be rough and any protuberances they may exhibit shall not prevent easy cleaning.
test_case: Inspect the surface by sight and touch; it shall not be rough and no protuberance shall hinder cleaning.

text: There shall be no access to the inner surface of the retro-reflector when in normal use.
quote: There shall be no access to the inner surface of the retro-reflectors when in normal use.
test_case: Inspect the assembled lamp and confirm the inner (prism) surface of the retro-reflector is not accessible in normal use.

text: If the retro-reflector consists of a combined retro-reflecting optical unit and filter, the optical unit and filter shall be so designed that they cannot be separated under normal conditions of use.
quote: Retro-reflectors may consist of a combined retro-reflecting optical unit and filter, which must be so designed that they cannot be separated
condition: Retro-reflector consists of a combined retro-reflecting optical unit and filter
test_case: Inspect the construction; the optical unit and filter shall not be separable under normal conditions of use.

text: The colouring of the retro-reflecting optical units and filters of the retro-reflector shall not be made by means of paint or varnish.
quote: The colouring of retro-reflecting optical units and filters by means of paint or varnish is not permitted.
test_case: Check material specification and inspect the red retro-reflector; colour shall be in the mass, not painted or varnished.

text: For testing the colour of the retro-reflector, the device shall be illuminated by CIE Standard Illuminant A, with an angle of divergence of 1/3° and an illumination angle of β1 = β2 = 0° or, if this produces a colourless surface reflection, an angle as specified in Annex 4, Part 1, paragraph 1.1.
quote: the device shall be illuminated by CIE Standard Illuminant A, with an angle of divergence of 1/3° and an illumination angle of β1= β2= 0°
test_case: Set up colorimetric measurement with Illuminant A, 1/3° divergence, β1=β2=0° (or Annex 4 angle) and record trichromatic coordinates.

text: The trichromatic coordinates of the reflected luminous intensity of the retro-reflector shall be within the limits for the night-time colour of the light retro-reflected from that device, as defined in UN Regulation No. 48.
quote: The trichromatic coordinates of the reflected luminous intensity shall be within the limits for the night-time colour of the light retro-reflected
test_case: Measure the chromaticity of the reflected light and confirm it lies within the R48 night-time red boundaries.

text: When tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., every retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB shall meet the dimensions and shape requirements set forth in Annex 5.
quote: Every retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB, when tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., shall meet: (a) The dimensions and shape requirements set forth in Annex 5
test_case: Measure the retro-reflector shape and dimensions against Annex 5 (e.g. non-triangular shape); conform.

text: When tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., every retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB shall meet the photometric and colorimetric requirements as specified in paragraphs 5.1.4. to 5.1.5.
quote: (b) The photometric and colorimetric requirements as specified in paragraphs 5.1.4. to 5.1.5.
test_case: Perform photometric and colorimetric tests per 5.1.4 and 5.1.5; all values within limits.

text: When tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., every retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB shall meet the physical and mechanical requirements set forth in paragraph 5.1.7., depending on the nature of the materials and construction of the retro-reflective devices.
quote: (c) The physical and mechanical requirements set forth in paragraph 5.1.7., depending on the nature of the materials and construction
test_case: Perform the physical and mechanical tests per 5.1.7 / Annex 6 and 7; samples pass.

text: After verification of the general specifications (paragraph 4.) and the specifications of shape and dimensions (Annex 5), the ten samples of the retro-reflector shall be subjected to the heat resistance test described in Part 1 of Annex 6 and at least one hour after this test examined as to their colorimetric characteristics in paragraph 5.1.5. and RI in paragraph 5.1.4., for an angle of divergence of 20' and an illumination angle β1 = β2 = 0° or if necessary, in the position defined in Part 1 of Annex 4, paragraphs 1.1. and 1.2.
quote: the ten samples shall be subjected to the heat resistance test described in Part 1 of Annex 6 and at least one hour after this test examined
test_case: Perform the Annex 6 Part 1 heat test on ten samples and, after at least one hour, check colour and RI at 20'/0°; values within limits.

text: The two retro-reflectors giving the minimum and maximum values after the heat resistance test shall then be fully tested as shown in paragraph 5.1.4.
quote: The two retro-reflectors giving the minimum and maximum values shall then be fully tested as shown in paragraph 5.1.4.
test_case: Perform full photometric test per 5.1.4 on min and max samples; all points meet Table 3.

text: The first group of two retro-reflector samples shall be subjected successively to the water penetration test (Part 2 of Annex 6) and then, if this test is satisfactory, to the tests for resistance to fuels and lubricants (Parts 1 and 2 of Annex 7).
quote: First group: The two samples shall be subjected successively to the water penetration test (Part 2 of Annex 6)
test_case: Perform the water penetration test and then the fuel and lubricant resistance tests on two samples; samples pass.

text: The second group of two retro-reflector samples shall, if necessary, be subjected to the corrosion test in Part 4 of Annex 6, and then to the abrasive-strength test of the rear face of the retro-reflective device in Part 5 of Annex 6.
quote: Second group: The two samples shall, if necessary, be subjected to the corrosion test in Part 4 of Annex 6
test_case: Perform the corrosion test (if applicable) and the rear-face abrasion test on two samples; samples pass.

text: The third group of two retro-reflector samples shall be subjected to the test for stability in time of the optical properties of retro-reflective device in Part 3 of Annex 4.
quote: Third group: The two samples shall be subjected to the test for stability in time of the optical properties
test_case: Perform the Annex 4 Part 3 stability test on two samples; samples pass.

text: The fourth group of two retro-reflector samples shall be subjected to the resistance to weathering test (Part 6 of Annex 6).
quote: Fourth group: The two samples shall be subjected to the resistance to weathering test (Part 6 of Annex 6).
test_case: Perform the Annex 6 Part 6 weathering test on two samples; samples pass.

text: After undergoing the tests referred to in paragraph 5.1.3.1., the retro-reflectors in each group must have a colour which satisfies the conditions laid down in paragraph 5.1.5.
quote: After undergoing the tests referred to in the paragraph 5.1.3.1., the retro-reflectors in each group must have: A colour which satisfies
test_case: Measure the colour of each post-test sample; within R48 night-time red limits.

text: After undergoing the tests referred to in paragraph 5.1.3.1., the retro-reflectors in each group must have a RI which satisfies the conditions laid down in paragraph 5.1.4., verified only for an angle of divergence of 20' and an illumination angle of β1 = β2 = 0° or, if necessary, in all positions specified in Part 1 of Annex 4, paragraphs 1.1. and 1.2.
quote: A RI which satisfies the conditions laid down in paragraph 5.1.4. The verification shall be performed only for an angle of divergence of 20'
test_case: Measure RI of each post-test sample at 20', β1=β2=0°; value ≥ 300 mcd/lx for red.

text: In the case where more than one or a range of different axis of reference are specified by the manufacturer, the photometric measurements of the retro-reflector shall be repeated making reference each time to a different axis of reference or to the extreme axis of reference of the range specified by the manufacturer.
quote: the photometric measurements shall be repeated making reference each time to a different axis of reference or to the extreme axis of reference
condition: Manufacturer specifies more than one or a range of axes of reference
test_case: Repeat the photometric measurements for each specified axis (or extreme axes); all meet Table 3.

text: For photometric measurements, only the illuminating surface defined by the planes contiguous to the outermost parts of the optical system of the retro-reflector as indicated by the manufacturer and contained within a circle of 200 mm diameter for Class IA or IB shall be considered, and the illuminating surface itself shall be limited to 100 cm2.
quote: contained within a circle of 200 mm diameter for Class IA or IB shall be considered, and the illuminating surface itself shall be limited to 100 cm2
test_case: Mask the retro-reflector to the declared illuminating surface within a 200 mm circle and ≤ 100 cm2 during photometry.

text: The manufacturer shall specify the perimeter of the area of the retro-reflector to be used for photometric measurements.
quote: The manufacturer shall specify the perimeter of the area to be used.
test_case: Check the drawings for the declared perimeter of the retro-reflecting area.

text: When measured as described in paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4, the RI values for red retro-reflectors of Class IA or IB at an angle of divergence of 20' shall be equal to or greater than 300 mcd/lx at β1 = 0°, β2 = 0°; 200 mcd/lx at β1 = ±10°, β2 = 0°; and 100 mcd/lx at β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20°, as given in Table 3.
quote: the RI values for red retro-reflectors must be equal to or greater than those in Table 3, expressed in millicandelas per lux
test_case: Measure RI at 20' divergence at the Table 3 illumination angles; values ≥ 300/200/100 mcd/lx.

text: When measured as described in paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4, the RI values for red retro-reflectors of Class IA or IB at an angle of divergence of 1°30' shall be equal to or greater than 5 mcd/lx at β1 = 0°, β2 = 0°; 2.8 mcd/lx at β1 = ±10°, β2 = 0°; and 2.5 mcd/lx at β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20°, as given in Table 3.
quote: the RI values for red retro-reflectors must be equal to or greater than those in Table 3, expressed in millicandelas per lux
test_case: Measure RI at 1°30' divergence at the Table 3 illumination angles; values ≥ 5/2.8/2.5 mcd/lx.

text: RI values of the retro-reflector lower than those shown in the last two columns of Table 3 are not permissible within the solid angle having the centre of reference as its apex and bounded by the planes intersecting along the lines (β1 = ±10°, β2 = 0°) (β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20°).
quote: RI values lower than those shown in the last two columns of Table 3 are not permissible within the solid angle having the centre of reference
test_case: Scan RI within the bounded solid angle; no value below the corresponding Table 3 minimum.

text: Where a retro-reflector of Class IA or Class IB is intended to be installed with its H plane at a mounting height less than 750 mm above the ground, the RI values are verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards.
quote: is intended to be installed with its H plane at a mounting height less than 750 mm above the ground, the RI values are verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards
condition: Retro-reflector intended to be mounted with H plane below 750 mm above ground
test_case: Confirm the declared mounting height; if < 750 mm, verify the downward RI points only to 5° and check that they meet Table 3.

text: The testing of the colour of the retro-reflector (night-time colour) shall be carried out according to the method described in paragraph 4.2.1.
quote: The testing of the colour for retro-reflector (night-time colour) shall be carried out according to the method described in paragraph 4.2.1.
test_case: Perform the night-time colour measurement using the 4.2.1 set-up.

text: The trichromatic coordinates of the reflected luminous flux of the retro-reflector must be within the limits for the night-time colour red as specified in UN Regulation No. 48.
quote: The trichromatic coordinates of the reflected luminous flux must be within the limits for the night-time colours red, amber or white
test_case: Measure the chromaticity of the reflected light; coordinates lie within the R48 night-time red limits.

text: The retro-reflectors of Classes IA and IB shall be tested in the chronological order of tests given in Table 4.
quote: Chronological order of tests Table 4 Chronological order of tests (Classes IA, IB, IIIA and IIIB)
test_case: Review the test report and confirm that samples a to j were tested in the sequence of Table 4.

text: For retro-reflectors of Classes IA and IB, all samples (a to j) shall undergo a visual inspection of the general specifications and a visual inspection of shapes and dimensions according to Annex 5.
quote: -General specifications: visual inspection x x x x x x x x x x Annex 5 Shapes and dimensions: visual inspection
test_case: Visually inspect all ten samples against paragraph 4 and Annex 5; pass if no non-conformity is found.

text: For retro-reflectors of Classes IA and IB, the samples shall be subjected to the heat test of Part 1 of Annex 6 (48 h at 65 °C ± 2 °C), followed by a visual inspection for distortion.
quote: Part 1 of Annex 6 Heat: 48 h at 65° ± 2°C Visual inspection for distortion
test_case: Expose the samples for 48 h at 65 ± 2 °C and inspect them; pass if no distortion is visible.

text: For retro-reflectors of Classes IA and IB, colorimetry shall be checked according to paragraph 4.2. by visual inspection, with trichromatic coordinates measured in case of doubt, after each conditioning stage in Table 4.
quote: Par. 4.2. Colorimetry: visual inspection Trichromatic coordinates in case of doubt
test_case: Inspect the colour visually and measure the trichromatic coordinates if in doubt; pass if they are within the red limits.

text: For retro-reflectors of Classes IA and IB, photometry according to Part 1 of Annex 4, limited to 20' and β1 = β2 = 0°, shall be performed on the samples after each conditioning stage in Table 4.
quote: Part 1 of Annex 4 Photometry: limited to 20' and β1 = β2 = 0°
test_case: Measure the CIL at 20' and β1 = β2 = 0° after each stage; pass if the values meet the required minimum.

text: For retro-reflectors of Classes IA and IB, complete photometry according to Part 1 of Annex 4 shall be performed on two samples.
quote: Part 1 of Annex 4 Complete photometry x x
test_case: Perform the full photometric measurement on two samples; pass if all values are met.

text: For retro-reflectors of Classes IA and IB, the samples shall be subjected to the water test of Part 3 of Annex 6 (10 min in normal position and 10 min in inverted position), followed by a visual inspection.
quote: Part 3 of Annex 6 Water: 10 min. in normal position 10 min. in inverted position visual inspection
test_case: Immerse the samples 10 min upright and 10 min inverted, then inspect; pass if no water has penetrated.

text: For retro-reflectors of Classes IA and IB, the samples shall be subjected to the motor fuels test of Part 1 of Annex 7 (5 min), followed by a visual inspection.
quote: Part 1 of Annex 7 Motor fuels: 5 min. visual inspection
test_case: Expose the samples to the test fuel for 5 min and inspect them; pass if no visible degradation is found.

text: For retro-reflectors of Classes IA and IB, the samples shall be subjected to the oils test of Part 2 of Annex 7 (5 min), followed by a visual inspection.
quote: Part 2 of Annex 7 Oils: 5 min. visual inspection
test_case: Expose the samples to the test oil for 5 min and inspect them; pass if no visible degradation is found.

text: For retro-reflectors of Classes IA and IB, the samples shall be subjected to the corrosion test of Part 4 of Annex 6 (24 hours, 2 hours interval, 24 hours), followed by a visual inspection.
quote: Part 4 of Annex 6 Corrosion: 24 hours 2 hours interval 24 hours visual inspection
test_case: Run the salt-spray cycle of 24 h, 2 h interval and 24 h, then inspect; pass if no detrimental corrosion is visible.

text: For retro-reflectors of Classes IA and IB, the samples shall be subjected to the rear face test of Part 4 of Annex 6 (1 min), followed by a visual inspection.
quote: Part 4 of Annex 6 Rear face: 1 min. visual inspection
test_case: Apply the rear-face test for 1 min and inspect; pass if the rear face shows no damage.

text: For retro-reflectors of Classes IA and IB, the samples shall be subjected to the stability in time test of Part 3 of Annex 4, followed by colorimetry (visual inspection or trichromatic coordinates) and photometry limited to 20' and β1 = β2 = 0°.
quote: Part 3 of Annex 4 Stability in time Par. 4.2. Colorimetry: Visual inspection or trichromatic coordinates
test_case: After the stability test, check colour and the CIL at 20' and β1 = β2 = 0°; pass if both are within limits.

text: For retro-reflectors of Classes IA and IB, the samples shall be subjected to the resistance to weathering test of Part 6 of Annex 6, followed by colorimetry (visual inspection or trichromatic coordinates) and photometry limited to 20' and β1 = β2 = 0°.
quote: Part 6 of Annex 6 Resistance to weathering Par. 4.2. Colorimetry: Visual inspection or trichromatic coordinates
test_case: After weathering, check colour and the CIL at 20' and β1 = β2 = 0°; pass if both are within limits.

text: Any omission of unnecessary tests of Part 3 of Annex 4 or Parts 4, 5 and 6 of Annex 6, authorised depending on the nature of the retro-reflector materials, must be mentioned under "Remarks" on the form notifying approval.
quote: subject to the express reservation that such omission must be mentioned under "Remarks" on the form notifying approval
condition: Applies only if the Type Approval Authority authorises omission of tests based on the retro-reflector materials.
test_case: Check the approval communication form; pass if every omitted test is listed under Remarks.

text: The conformity requirements for the retro-reflective device shall be considered satisfied from a mechanical and geometric standpoint if the differences do not exceed inevitable manufacturing deviations within the requirements of this Regulation.
quote: The conformity requirements shall be considered satisfied from a mechanical and geometric standpoint, if the differences do not exceed inevitable manufacturing deviations
test_case: Compare dimensions and geometry of production retro-reflectors with the approved type; pass if deviations stay within inevitable manufacturing tolerances and Regulation requirements.

text: With respect to photometric performances, no measured value of any mass-produced retro-reflective device chosen at random shall deviate unfavourably by more than 20 per cent from the minimum values prescribed in this Regulation.
quote: no measured value deviates unfavourably by more than 20 per cent from the minimum values prescribed in this Regulation
test_case: Measure the CIL of randomly selected production retro-reflectors; pass if no value is more than 20 % below the prescribed minimum.

text: The chromaticity coordinates of mass-produced retro-reflective devices shall be complied with.
quote: The chromaticity coordinates shall be complied with.
test_case: Measure the chromaticity coordinates of production retro-reflectors; pass if they lie within the red colour boundaries prescribed by the Regulation.

text: From a mechanical and a geometric standpoint, the differences of the mass-produced retro-reflective devices from the requirements of this Regulation shall not exceed inevitable manufacturing deviations.
quote: The conformity requirements shall be considered satisfied from a mechanical and a geometric standpoint, in accordance with the requirements of this Regulation, if any,
test_case: Compare dimensions and geometry of production samples with the approved type; pass if differences are within inevitable manufacturing deviations.

text: When testing photometric performances of any mass-produced retro-reflective device chosen at random, no measured value shall deviate unfavourably by more than 20 per cent from the minimum values prescribed in this Regulation.
quote: No measured value deviates unfavourably by more than 20 per cent from the minimum values prescribed in this Regulation.
test_case: Measure CIL of randomly chosen production retro-reflectors; pass if no value is more than 20 per cent below the prescribed minimum.

text: For mass-produced retro-reflective devices, the chromaticity coordinates shall be complied with.
quote: The chromaticity coordinates shall be complied with.
test_case: Measure chromaticity of production samples; pass if coordinates lie within the prescribed red boundaries.

text: One of the retro-reflectors of sample A after the sampling procedure shall be tested for resistance to water penetration according to the procedure described in paragraph 1. of Part 2 of Annex 6, and if it does not comply, the two retro-reflective devices of sample B shall be subjected to the same procedure and both shall pass the test.
quote: One of the retro-reflectors of sample A after the sampling procedure in paragraph 2. shall be tested according to the procedure described in paragraph 1. of Part 2 of Annex 6
test_case: Perform the Annex 6 Part 2 paragraph 1 water penetration test on a production sample; pass if no water penetration is observed.

text: When the RI of the retro-reflective device is measured for an angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, it shall be ascertained whether any mirror effect is produced by slightly turning the device.
quote: When the RI of a retro-reflective device is measured for an angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, it shall be ascertained whether any mirror effect is produced
test_case: During RI measurement at β1 = β2 = 0°, turn the device slightly and check for any mirror effect.

text: If any mirror effect is produced when measuring the RI at β1 = β2 = 0°, a reading of the retro-reflective device shall be taken with an angle β of β1 = -5°, β2 = 0°.
quote: If there is any such effect, a reading shall be taken with an angle β of β1 = -5°, β2 = 0°.
test_case: Where a mirror effect is found, take the RI reading at β1 = -5°, β2 = 0° and verify it meets the specified value.

text: With an illumination angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, or the angle specified in paragraph 5. of this Regulation, and an angle of divergence of 20', retro-reflective devices which are not marked "TOP" shall be rotated about their axes of reference to the position of minimum RI, which must conform to the value specified in paragraph 5. of this Regulation.
quote: retro-reflective devices which are not marked "TOP" shall be rotated about their axes of reference to the position of minimum RI, which must conform to the value specified
condition: Retro-reflector is not marked "TOP"
test_case: Rotate the device at β = 0°, α = 20' to find minimum RI and verify it meets the paragraph 5 value.

text: When the RI of a retro-reflective device not marked "TOP" is measured for the other angles of illumination and divergence, the retro-reflective device shall be placed in the position corresponding to the value of ε of minimum RI; if the specified values are not attained, the device may be rotated about its axis of reference only ±5° from that position.
quote: When the RI is measured for the other angles of illumination and divergence, the retro-reflective device shall be placed in the position corresponding to this value of ε.
condition: Retro-reflector is not marked "TOP"
test_case: Measure RI at all other angles with the device at the minimum-RI ε position (±5° allowed) and verify compliance.

text: With an illumination angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, or the angle specified in paragraph 4. of this Regulation, and an angle of divergence of 20', retro-reflective devices marked "TOP" shall be rotated about their axes ±5°, and the RI must not fall below the prescribed value in any position assumed by the device during this rotation.
quote: retro-reflective devices marked "TOP" shall be rotated about their axes ±5°. The RI must not fall below the prescribed value in any position
condition: Retro-reflector is marked "TOP"
test_case: Rotate the TOP-marked device ±5° at β = 0°, α = 20' and verify RI never falls below the prescribed value.

text: If for the direction β1 = β2 = 0°, and for ε = 0° the RI of the retro-reflective device exceeds the specified value by 50 per cent or more, all measurements for all angles of illumination and divergence shall be made for ε = 0°.
quote: If for the direction β1 = β2 = 0°, and for ε = 0° the RI exceeds the specified value by 50 per cent or more, all measurements
test_case: Check RI at β = 0°, ε = 0°; if ≥150 % of specified value, perform all measurements at ε = 0°.

text: The CIE-angular system as shown in Figure A4-I shall be used for specifying and measuring the retro-reflective device.
quote: The CIE-angular system as shown in Figure A4-I shall be used for specifying and measuring retro-reflective device and marking materials.
test_case: Verify the test report specifies angles in the CIE angular system.

text: For testing the retro-reflection the retro-reflective devices shall be illuminated with a CIE Standard Illuminant A (ISO 11664-2:2007(E)/CIE S 014-2/E:2006) and measured as described in Part 1 of Annex 4.
quote: For testing the retro-reflection the retro-reflective devices shall be illuminated with a CIE Standard Illuminant A
test_case: Verify the test lab used CIE Standard Illuminant A for retro-reflection measurement.

text: For the measurement of the retro-reflective device, the measuring geometry limits shall apply: angular diameter of the source δ ≤ 10', angular diameter of the measuring device γ ≤ 10', angular diameter of the illuminated area η ≤ 80'.
quote: The following limits apply: Angular diameter of the source -δ≤10' Angular diameter of the measuring device -γ≤10'
test_case: Check the test setup angular apertures δ ≤ 10', γ ≤ 10', η ≤ 80'.

text: The measuring distance for the retro-reflective device shall be chosen such that at least the limits for the angles δ, γ and η given in Figure A4-III are respected, but not lower than 10 m.
quote: The measuring distance shall be chosen in such an order that at least the limits for the angles δ, γ and η given above
test_case: Verify the measuring distance is ≥ 10 m and respects the δ, γ, η limits.

text: The illuminance over the useful area of the retro-reflective device, measured perpendicular to the incident light, shall be sufficiently uniform, with the variation complying with max/min ≤ 1.05.
quote: The illuminance over the useful area of the retro-reflective device, measured perpendicular to the incident light shall be sufficiently uniform.
test_case: Measure illuminance across the useful area with a sensor ≤ 1/10 of the area and verify max/min ≤ 1.05.

text: The residual stray light value, measured with the sample covered, shall be subtracted from that measured on the retro-reflective device.
quote: This value shall be subtracted from that measured on the retro-reflective device
test_case: Verify the reported RI values have the measured residual stray light subtracted.

text: For testing the daytime colour and luminance factor of the retro-reflective material, illumination by CIE Standard Illuminant D65 (ISO 11664-2:2007(E)/CIE S 014-2/E:2006) using geometry (45a:0) shall be used.
quote: For testing the daytime colour and luminance factor of the material, illumination by CIE Standard Illuminant D65 (ISO 11664-2:2007(E)/CIE S 014-2/E:2006) using geometry (45a:0) shall be used.
condition: Only if the retro-reflector is retro-reflective material subject to daytime colour and luminance factor requirements; a Class IA/IB retro-reflector normally is not.
test_case: Check the test report: daytime colour and luminance factor were measured under D65 illumination with 45a:0 geometry.

text: The daytime colour measurements of the retro-reflective material shall be done with a spectrophotometer in accordance with Publication CIE 15:2004, illuminated with CIE Standard Illuminant D65 at an angle of 45° to the normal and viewed along the normal (geometry 45/0).
quote: Measurements shall be done with a spectrophotometer in accordance with the provisions of Publication CIE 15:2004, Recommendations on Colorimetry - Second Edition
condition: Only if the retro-reflector is retro-reflective material subject to daytime colour requirements.
test_case: Review the measurement set-up: a spectrophotometer per CIE 15:2004 with D65 at 45° illumination and normal viewing was used.

text: When a monochromator is used for the daytime colour measurement of the retro-reflective material, the stepwise resolution Δλ shall be not larger than 10 nm.
quote: In the latter case, the stepwise resolution Δλ shall be not larger than 10 nm.
condition: Only if daytime colour measurement of retro-reflective material applies and a monochromator is used.
test_case: Verify from the instrument settings that the monochromator step is ≤ 10 nm.

text: For the daytime colour measurement of the retro-reflective material, the spectral distribution of the Illuminant shall be in category BC (CIELAB) or better.
quote: The spectral distribution of the Illuminant shall be in category BC (CIELAB) or better.
condition: Only if daytime colour measurement of retro-reflective material applies.
test_case: Check the D65 simulator assessment per ISO 23603: the category is BC or better.

text: For the daytime colour measurement of the retro-reflective material, the measurement area shall be at least 4.0 cm².
quote: The measurement area shall be at least minimum 4.0 cm².
condition: Only if daytime colour measurement of retro-reflective material applies.
test_case: Measure the sample aperture area and confirm it is ≥ 4.0 cm².

text: The shape of the illuminating surfaces of retro-reflective devices of Class IA or IB shall not be easily confused with the triangular shape, as prescribed for retro-reflectors mentioned in paragraph 2.1., from an observation distance of 10 metres.
quote: The shape of the illuminating surfaces shall not be easily confused with the triangular shape, as prescribed for retro-reflectors mentioned in paragraph 2.1.
test_case: Visually inspect the retro-reflector illuminating surface from 10 m; pass if it cannot easily be confused with a triangular shape.

text: Compliance of the retro-reflective device with the shape and dimension specifications shall be verified by visual inspection.
quote: Compliance with the above specifications shall be verified by visual inspection.
test_case: Perform a visual inspection of the retro-reflector shape against Annex 5 specifications; pass if conformity is confirmed.

text: In the case of moulded plastics reflectors of retro-reflecting devices of Classes IA or IB, the retro-reflective device shall be kept for 48 consecutive hours in a dry atmosphere at a temperature of 65 °C ± 2 °C, after which the sample shall be allowed to cool for 1 hour at 23 °C ± 2 °C.
quote: The retro-reflective device shall be kept for 48 consecutive hours in a dry atmosphere at a temperature of 65 °C ± 2 °C
condition: Retro-reflector class (IA or IB) not stated
test_case: Expose the retro-reflector to 65 °C ± 2 °C dry atmosphere for 48 h, then cool 1 h at 23 °C ± 2 °C, and proceed to inspection.

text: After the resistance to heat test, no cracking or appreciable distortion of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, of its optical component must be visible.
quote: After this test, no cracking or appreciable distortion of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, of its optical component must be visible.
test_case: Visually inspect the retro-reflector after the heat test; pass if no cracking or appreciable distortion of the optical component is visible.

text: The retro-reflective device, whether part of a lamp or not, shall be stripped of all removable parts and immersed for 10 minutes in water at a temperature of 50 °C ± 5 °C, the highest point of the upper part of the illuminating surface being 20 mm below the surface of the water.
quote: Retro-reflective devices whether part of a lamp or not, or a sample unit of retro-reflective marking, shall be stripped of all removable parts and immersed for 10 minutes
test_case: Immerse the stripped retro-reflector (lamp) for 10 min in 50 °C ± 5 °C water with the illuminating surface top 20 mm below the water surface.

text: The water penetration test shall be repeated after turning the retro-reflective device through 180°, so that the illuminating surface is at the bottom and the rear face is covered by about 20 mm of water.
quote: This test shall be repeated after turning the retro-reflective device through 180°, so that the illuminating surface is at the bottom
test_case: Repeat the 10 min immersion at 50 °C with the device inverted and rear face under about 20 mm of water.

text: The retro-reflective device sample units shall then be immediately immersed in the same conditions in water at a temperature of 25 °C ± 5 °C.
quote: These sample units shall then be immediately immersed in the same conditions in water at a temperature of 25 °C ± 5 °C.
test_case: Immediately after the 50 °C immersions, immerse the device under the same conditions in 25 °C ± 5 °C water.

text: No water shall penetrate to the reflecting surface of the retro-reflecting optical unit; if visual inspection clearly reveals the presence of water, the device shall not be considered to have passed the test.
quote: No water shall penetrate to the reflecting surface of the retro-reflecting optical unit.
test_case: Visually inspect the reflecting surface after immersion; fail if water is clearly present.

text: If visual inspection does not reveal the presence of water or in case of doubt, in the case of retro-reflectors, the RI shall be measured by the method described in paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation, the retro-reflective device being first lightly shaken to remove excess water from the outside.
quote: In the case of retro-reflectors, the RI shall be measured by the method described in paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation
test_case: After shaking off excess water, measure RI per paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. and check it meets the applicable requirements.

text: For retro-reflective devices of Class IB, at the request of the manufacturer, the moisture and dust tests of Annex 6 Part 3 shall be applied as an alternative test procedure of resistance to water penetration.
quote: As an alternative, at the request of the manufacturer, the following tests (moisture and dust test) shall be applied.
condition: Retro-reflector is Class IB and the manufacturer requests the alternative moisture and dust tests
test_case: Check the test report confirms that both the moisture test and the dust test were performed when the alternative procedure was requested.

text: For the alternative moisture test, the water spray cabinet shall be equipped with nozzle(s) providing a solid cone water spray of sufficient angle to completely cover the sample device, with the centreline of the nozzle(s) directed downward at an angle of 45° ± 5° to the vertical axis of the rotating test platform.
quote: The centreline of the nozzle(s) shall be directed downward at an angle of 45° ± 5° to the vertical axis of a rotating test platform.
condition: Retro-reflector is Class IB and the manufacturer requests the alternative moisture and dust tests
test_case: Check the test set-up record shows full spray coverage of the device and a nozzle angle within 45° ± 5°.

text: For the alternative moisture test, the rotating test platform shall have a minimum diameter of 140 mm and rotate about a vertical axis in the centre of the cabinet.
quote: The rotating test platform shall have a minimum diameter of 140 mm and rotate about a vertical axis in the centre of the cabinet.
condition: Retro-reflector is Class IB and the manufacturer requests the alternative moisture and dust tests
test_case: Check the test equipment record shows a centred platform with a diameter of at least 140 mm.

text: For the alternative moisture test, the precipitation rate of the water spray at the device shall be 2.5 (+1.6/-0) mm/min, measured with a vertical cylindrical collector 100 mm high with an inside diameter of at least 140 mm, centred on the vertical axis of the rotating test platform.
quote: The precipitation rate of the water spray at the device shall be 2.5 (+1.6/-0) mm/min as measured with a vertical cylindrical collector
condition: Retro-reflector is Class IB and the manufacturer requests the alternative moisture and dust tests
test_case: Check the collector measurement in the test report gives a precipitation rate between 2.5 and 4.1 mm/min.

text: For the alternative moisture test, a sample device mounted on a test fixture, with initial RI measured and recorded, shall be subjected to a water spray.
quote: A sample device mounted on a test fixture, with initial RI measured and recorded shall be subjected to a water spray as follows:
condition: Retro-reflector is Class IB and the manufacturer requests the alternative moisture and dust tests
test_case: Check the test report records the initial RI of the fixture-mounted sample before the water spray.

text: During the water spray test, all drain holes and other openings of the device shall remain open.
quote: All drain holes and other openings shall remain open.
condition: Retro-reflector is Class IB and the manufacturer requests the alternative moisture and dust tests
test_case: Inspect the test sample to confirm that no drain hole or opening was sealed during the water spray test.

text: During the water spray test, drain wicks, when used, shall be tested in the device.
quote: Drain wicks, when used, shall be tested in the device.
condition: Retro-reflector is Class IB, the manufacturer requests the alternative tests, and the device uses drain wicks
test_case: Inspect the sample to confirm that any drain wicks were fitted in the device during the water spray test.

text: During the water spray test, the device shall be rotated about its vertical axis at a rate of 4.0 ± 0.5 min-1.
quote: The device shall be rotated about its vertical axis at a rate of 4.0 ± 0.5 min -1.
condition: Retro-reflector is Class IB and the manufacturer requests the alternative moisture and dust tests
test_case: Check the test record shows a platform rotation rate within 3.5 to 4.5 min-1.

text: If the retro-reflector is reciprocally incorporated or grouped with signalling or lighting functions, these functions shall be operated during the water spray test at design voltage according to a cycle of 5 min ON (in flashing mode, where appropriate) and 55 min OFF.
quote: these functions shall be operated at design voltage according to a cycle of 5 min ON (in flashing mode, where appropriate), 55 min OFF.
condition: Retro-reflector is Class IB and the manufacturer requests the alternative moisture and dust tests
test_case: Check the test log shows the rear position, stop and reversing lamps operated at design voltage on a 5 min ON / 55 min OFF cycle.

text: The water spray test shall last 12 hours (12 cycles of 5/55 min).
quote: The water spray test shall last 12 hours (12 cycles of 5/55 min).
condition: Retro-reflector is Class IB and the manufacturer requests the alternative moisture and dust tests
test_case: Check the test log shows 12 complete 5/55 min cycles over 12 hours.

text: After the water spray test, the rotation and the water spray shall be turned OFF and the device allowed to drain for 1 hour with the cabinet door closed.
quote: The rotation and the water spray shall be turned OFF and the device allowed to drain for 1 hour with the cabinet door closed.
condition: Retro-reflector is Class IB and the manufacturer requests the alternative moisture and dust tests
test_case: Check the test log records a 1 hour drain period with the cabinet door closed.

text: Upon completion of the drain period, the interior of the device shall be observed for moisture accumulation.
quote: Upon completion of the drain period. The interior of the device shall be observed for moisture accumulation.
condition: Retro-reflector is Class IB and the manufacturer requests the alternative moisture and dust tests
test_case: Visually inspect the device interior after the drain period and record any moisture accumulation.

text: Upon completion of the drain period, no standing pool of water shall be formed in the device, or be capable of being formed by tapping or tilting the device.
quote: No standing pool of water shall be allowed to be formed, or which can be formed by tapping or tilting the device.
condition: Retro-reflector is Class IB and the manufacturer requests the alternative moisture and dust tests
test_case: Tap and tilt the device after the drain period; pass if no standing pool of water is present or forms.

text: After the moisture test, the RI shall be measured according to the method specified in Part 1 of Annex 4 after the exterior of the device has been dried with a dry cotton cloth.
quote: The RI shall be measured according to the method specified in Part 1 of Annex 4 after having dried the exterior of the device
condition: Retro-reflector is Class IB and the manufacturer requests the alternative moisture and dust tests
test_case: Dry the exterior with a cotton cloth, measure the RI per Annex 4 Part 1 and record it against the initial value.

text: For the dust exposure test, the test chamber shall be cubical with 0.9 to 1.5 m per side and an internal volume (excluding any hopper-shaped bottom) of 2 m3 maximum, shall be charged with 3 to 5 kg of the test dust, and shall be able to agitate the test dust by compressed air or blower fans so that the dust is diffused throughout the chamber.
quote: The internal chamber volume, not including a "hopper shaped" bottom shall be 2 m3 maximum and shall be charged with 3 to 5 kg of the test dust.
condition: Retro-reflector is Class IB and the manufacturer requests the alternative moisture and dust tests
test_case: Check the chamber dimensions, volume and dust charge recorded in the test report.

text: The test dust used for the dust exposure test shall be fine powdered cement in accordance with standard ASTM C 150-84.
quote: The test dust used shall be fine powdered cement in accordance with standard ASTM C 150-84.
condition: Retro-reflector is Class IB and the manufacturer requests the alternative moisture and dust tests
test_case: Check the test report identifies the dust as fine powdered cement to ASTM C 150-84.

text: For the dust exposure test, a sample device mounted on a test fixture, with the initial RI measured and recorded, shall be exposed to dust.
quote: A sample device, mounted on a test fixture, with the initial RI measured and recorded, shall be exposed to dust as follows:
condition: Retro-reflector is Class IB and the manufacturer requests the alternative moisture and dust tests
test_case: Check the test report records the initial RI of the fixture-mounted sample before dust exposure.

text: During the dust exposure test, all drain holes and other openings of the device shall remain open.
quote: All drain holes and other openings shall remain open.
condition: Retro-reflector is Class IB and the manufacturer requests the alternative moisture and dust tests
test_case: Inspect the sample to confirm that no opening was sealed during dust exposure.

text: During the dust exposure test, drain wicks, when used, shall be tested in the device.
quote: Drain wicks, when used, shall be tested in the device.
condition: Retro-reflector is Class IB, the manufacturer requests the alternative tests, and the device uses drain wicks
test_case: Inspect the sample to confirm that any drain wicks were fitted in the device during dust exposure.

text: For the dust exposure test, the mounted device shall be placed in the dust chamber no closer than 150 mm from a wall, and devices with a length exceeding 600 mm shall be horizontally centred in the test chamber.
quote: The mounted device shall be placed in the dust chamber no closer than 150 mm from a wall.
condition: Retro-reflector is Class IB and the manufacturer requests the alternative moisture and dust tests
test_case: Check the set-up record shows at least 150 mm wall clearance, and horizontal centring if the device is longer than 600 mm.

text: During the dust exposure test, the test dust shall be agitated as completely as possible by compressed air or blower(s) at intervals of 15 min for a period of 2 to 15 s for the duration of 5 hours, and the dust shall be allowed to settle between the agitation periods.
quote: The test dust shall be agitated as completely as possible by compressed air or blower(s) at intervals of 15 min for a period of 2 to 15 s
condition: Retro-reflector is Class IB and the manufacturer requests the alternative moisture and dust tests
test_case: Check the test log shows agitation bursts of 2 to 15 s every 15 min over 5 hours, with settling between bursts.

text: Upon completion of the dust exposure test, the exterior of the device shall be cleaned and dried with a dry cotton cloth and the RI measured according to the method specified in paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation.
quote: the exterior of the device shall be cleaned and dried with a dry cotton cloth and the RI measured according to the method specified in paragraph 5.1.3.2.2.
condition: Retro-reflector is Class IB and the manufacturer requests the alternative moisture and dust tests
test_case: Clean and dry the exterior, measure the RI per paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. and compare it with the initial value against the applicable criterion.

text: The retro-reflective devices must be so designed that they retain the prescribed photometric and colorimetric characteristics despite the humidity and corrosive influences to which they are normally exposed.
quote: Retro-reflective devices must be so designed that they retain the prescribed photometric and colorimetric characteristics despite the humidity and corrosive influences
test_case: Perform the ISO 9227:2017 saline mist test and verify that the photometric and colorimetric characteristics remain within the prescribed limits.

text: The resistance of the front surface of the retro-reflective device to tarnishing and of the protection of the rear face to deterioration shall be checked, particularly when an essential metal component seems liable to be attacked.
quote: The resistance of the front surface to tarnishing and of the protection of the rear face to deterioration shall be checked
test_case: After the corrosion test, inspect the front surface for tarnishing and the rear face protection for deterioration; neither shall be present to a degree impairing function.

text: The retro-reflective device, or the lamp if the device is combined with a light, shall be stripped of all removable parts and subjected to the action of a saline mist for a period of 50 hours, comprising two periods of exposure of 24 hours each, separated by an interval of two hours during which the sample is allowed to dry.
quote: shall be stripped of all removable parts and subjected to the action of a saline mist for a period of 50 hours
test_case: Expose the lamp with integrated retro-reflector, stripped of removable parts, to saline mist for 2 x 24 h with a 2 h drying interval and record the test log.

text: In the case of retro-reflective devices with essential metal components susceptible to corrosion, the saline mist shall be produced by atomizing, at a temperature of 35 °C ± 2 °C, a saline solution obtained by dissolving 5 parts by weight of sodium chloride in 95 parts of distilled water containing not more than 0.02 per cent of impurities.
quote: the saline mist shall be produced by atomizing, at a temperature of 35 °C ± 2 °C, a saline solution
condition: The retro-reflector has essential metal components susceptible to corrosion.
test_case: Verify the test chamber records show 35 °C ± 2 °C and a 5 % NaCl solution in distilled water with not more than 0.02 % impurities.

text: Immediately after completion of the corrosion test, the sample shall not show signs of excessive corrosion liable to impair the efficiency of the device.
quote: Immediately after completion of the test, the sample shall not show signs of excessive corrosion liable to impair the efficiency of the device.
test_case: Visually inspect the sample immediately after the saline mist test; pass if there is no excessive corrosion impairing efficiency.

text: After the corrosion test, the coefficient of retro-reflection RA of the retro-reflective areas, when measured after a recovery period of 48 hours as specified in Part 2 of Annex 6, at an entrance angle of β2 = 5° and an observation angle of α = 20', shall be not less than the value in Table 9 or more than the value in Table 10 respectively.
quote: at an entrance angle of β2 = 5° and an observation angle of α = 20', shall be not less than the value in Table 9
test_case: After 48 h recovery measure the retro-reflection value at β2 = 5°, α = 20' and compare with the Table 9 minimum and Table 10 maximum.

text: Before measuring the coefficient of retro-reflection after the corrosion test, the surface shall be cleaned to remove salt deposits from the saline mist.
quote: Before measuring, the surface shall be cleaned to remove salt deposits from the saline mist.
test_case: Confirm that the test record shows the surface was cleaned of salt deposits before the photometric measurement.

text: For moulded plastics reflectors of Classes IA and IB with an accessible mirror-backed rear face, the reverse side of the retro-reflective device shall be brushed with a hard nylon brush.
quote: The reverse side of the retro-reflective device shall be brushed with a hard nylon brush.
condition: The retro-reflector is a mirror-backed moulded plastics reflector of Class IA or IB with an accessible rear face.
test_case: Verify that the test record shows the rear face was brushed with a hard nylon brush.

text: After having brushed the rear face of a moulded plastics reflector of Class IA or IB, a cotton cloth soaked in the mixture defined in Part 1 of Annex 7 shall be applied to the said rear face for one minute, then removed and the retro-reflective device left to dry.
quote: a cotton cloth soaked in the mixture, defined in Part 1 of Annex 7 shall be applied to the said rear face for one minute
condition: The retro-reflector is a mirror-backed moulded plastics reflector of Class IA or IB with an accessible rear face.
test_case: Apply a cotton cloth soaked in the Annex 7 Part 1 mixture to the rear face for 1 min, then remove it and let the device dry; check the test record.

text: For mirror-backed retro-reflective devices with an accessible rear face, as soon as evaporation is completed, the reverse side shall be brushed with the same brush as before.
quote: As soon as evaporation is completed, the reverse side shall be brushed with the same brush as before.
condition: The retro-reflector is a mirror-backed moulded plastics reflector of Class IA or IB with an accessible rear face.
test_case: Verify that the rear face was re-brushed with the same nylon brush after evaporation.

text: For mirror-backed retro-reflective devices with an accessible rear face, the RI shall then be measured, according to paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation, after the whole surface of the mirror-backed rear face has been covered with Indian ink.
quote: The RI shall then be measured, according to paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation, after the whole surface of the mirror-backed rear face
condition: The retro-reflector is a mirror-backed moulded plastics reflector of Class IA or IB with an accessible rear face.
test_case: Cover the whole rear face with Indian ink, measure the RI per paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. and compare it with the required values.

text: For the resistance to fuels test, a test mixture of 70 vol. per cent of n-heptane and 30 vol. per cent of toluol shall be applied to the retro-reflective device.
quote: A test mixture of 70 vol. per cent of n-heptane and 30 vol. per cent of toluol shall be applied for either:
test_case: Check the test report confirms that a 70/30 vol.% n-heptane/toluol mixture was used on the retro-reflector.

text: For the resistance to fuels test of a retro-reflective device, the outer surface of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, of the illuminating surface, shall be lightly wiped with a cotton cloth soaked in the test mixture.
quote: The outer surface of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, of the illuminating surface, shall be lightly wiped with a cotton cloth soaked in the test mixture.
test_case: Lightly wipe the retro-reflector outer and illuminating surface with a cotton cloth soaked in the n-heptane/toluol mixture, as recorded in the test report.

text: After about five minutes following the fuel wipe, the surface of the retro-reflective device shall be inspected visually and must not show any apparent surface changes, except that slight surface cracks will not be objected to.
quote: After about five minutes, the surface shall be inspected visually. It must not show any apparent surface changes, except that slight surface cracks will not be objected to.
test_case: Inspect the surface visually about 5 min after the wipe; pass if there is no apparent surface change other than slight surface cracks.

text: In the case of retro-reflective devices, the samples shall be exposed to accelerated artificial weathering in accordance with EN ISO 4892-2:2013, using the parameters given in Table A6-1, for a period of 500 hours.
quote: The samples shall be exposed in accordance with EN ISO 4892-2:2013 using the parameters given in Table A6-1: in case of retro-reflective devices for a period of 500 hours,
condition: Only if the resistance to weathering test applies to the retro-reflector class under the main text of R150
test_case: Expose the samples for 500 h in a xenon apparatus per EN ISO 4892-2 using cycle 1 (TM1) or cycle 4 (TM2) of Table A6-1, then verify the post-test requirements.

text: When using the black-standard thermometer (TM1), the accelerated weathering exposure shall use cycle No. 1 of EN ISO 4892-2:2013 (102 min dry / 18 min water spray), irradiance 60 ± 2 W/m² broadband (300 to 400 nm) and 0.51 ± 0.02 W/m² narrowband (340 nm), black-standard temperature 65 ± 3 °C and relative humidity 50 ± 10 %, as given in Table A6-1.
quote: TM1 - Black-standard thermometer Cycle No. according to EN ISO 4892-2:2013 Exposure period Irradiance Black-standard temperature °C Relative humidity %
condition: Only if the weathering test applies and TM1 is used
test_case: Review the weathering test log for the cycle 1 parameters within the tolerances of Table A6-1.

text: When using the black-panel thermometer (TM2), the accelerated weathering exposure shall use cycle No. 4 of EN ISO 4892-2:2013 (102 min dry / 18 min water spray), irradiance 60 ± 2 W/m² broadband (300 to 400 nm) and 0.51 ± 0.02 W/m² narrowband (340 nm), black-panel temperature 63 ± 3 °C and relative humidity 50 ± 10 %, as given in Table A6-1.
quote: TM2 - Black-panel thermometer Cycle No. according to EN ISO 4892-2:2013 Exposure period Irradiance Black-panel temperature °C Relative humidity %
condition: Only if the weathering test applies and TM2 is used
test_case: Review the weathering test log for the cycle 4 parameters within the tolerances of Table A6-1.

text: For moulded plastics reflectors of Classes IA and IB, the outer surface of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, the illuminating surface, shall be lightly wiped with a cotton cloth soaked in a detergent lubricating oil.
quote: The outer surface of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, the illuminating surface, shall be lightly wiped with a cotton cloth soaked in a detergent lubricating oil.
condition: Retro-reflector is a moulded plastics reflector of Class IA or IB (class not stated)
test_case: Wipe the outer and illuminating surface of the retro-reflector lightly with a cotton cloth soaked in detergent lubricating oil and record the procedure.

text: For moulded plastics reflectors of Classes IA and IB, after about 5 minutes following the application of the detergent lubricating oil, the surface of the retro-reflective device shall be cleaned.
quote: After about 5 minutes, the surface shall be cleaned.
condition: Retro-reflector is a moulded plastics reflector of Class IA or IB (class not stated)
test_case: After about 5 minutes of oil exposure, clean the surface and confirm by inspection that no oil residue remains before measurement.

text: For moulded plastics reflectors of Classes IA and IB, after the lubricating oil resistance test, the RI of the retro-reflective device shall be measured according to paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation.
quote: The RI shall then be measured according to paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation.
condition: Retro-reflector is a moulded plastics reflector of Class IA or IB (class not stated)
test_case: Measure the CIL/RI after cleaning per paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. and verify it meets the specified limits of that paragraph.

text: The approval number of the retro-reflective device must be placed close to, but in any position in relation to, the circle surrounding the letter "E".
quote: The above approval number must be placed close to, but in any position in relation to, the circle surrounding the letter "E".
test_case: Inspect the approval mark on the retro-reflector and confirm the approval number is adjacent to the circle surrounding the letter E.

text: The digits constituting the approval number of the retro-reflective device must face the same way as the "E".
quote: The digits constituting the approval number must face the same way as the "E".
test_case: Inspect the approval mark and confirm the approval number digits are oriented the same way as the letter E.

text: The group of symbols indicating the class of the retro-reflective device must be diametrically opposite the approval number.
quote: The group of symbols indicating the class must be diametrically opposite the approval number.
test_case: Inspect the approval mark and confirm the class symbol (e.g. IA or IB) is placed diametrically opposite the approval number relative to the circle.
